chapters.title: Chapter 5630: Authorities and Fluff!
paragraphs: The embodiment ended grandly.

Dark gold drained back out of the crimson, the tyrant’s stature settled into the emperor’s, and the burning gold eyes cooled to endless blue as THE Provenance of the Closed Crown withdrew to its small folded-arm seat at his temple, looking satisfied with itself.
|The embodiment has ended. All attributes have returned to 20.|
And behind that prompt, more rose, and they did not stop rising!
|Your VERITAS has risen tremendously. Your PONDUS has risen tremendously. Your PROVENANCE has risen tremendously.|

|Cause: your current actions, weighed as truth lived at the deep Transfinite, and THE Infinite Provenance Baryogenesis, which has not paused once through battle, embodiment, rewriting, or erasure. Quarks remade within THE PROVENANCE REVERIE continue to exceed all prior conversions.|
|Assessment: the wall past 20 was meant to be hard. It was meant to be arduous, and long, and to break most of those who ever reached it.|
|At your current pace, it will likely be climbed within the next few minutes. Hours, at most.|
Grand actions gave grand results!

And Noah, restored and unhurried, looked around the ruined celebration hall of a sealed pocket Dimension, at seven kneeling Veiled and one kneeling Enforcer and one kneeling instrument, and decided that since nothing could leave this box, nothing needed to leave it just yet.
There was one more piece of work to do here.
"Up," he said. "All of you. And you..."
He looked at the thing that had been Warden Yrsa.
"Come here. Hands and knees."

She came, and folded, and Noah seated himself upon the back of the Warden of THE PAX the way kings seat themselves on thrones they have not finished judging, one ankle across the opposite knee, entirely comfortable.
Among the Descendants, no one objected. Why would they?

"Now." Noah settled back. "The battle was too fast. Multiple Descendants of Those Who Remain moved in my service and I saw perhaps a tenth of what any of you are. That will not do. I intend to know my instruments to the last thread."
His cold blue gaze traveled the hall. "Show me your lineages. One at a time. Baelgrim."
The mountain grinned, and rolled his shoulders, and looked around the cluttered hall for something worth the showing.
He chose a Loomwrought Shroud.
"My line runs from THE Sleepless Fiend," he rumbled, walking toward the slumped artificial soldier. "And our Father’s gift is simple, Cure-Giver. He owns everything he has ever touched."
Both huge hands closed around the Shroud’s wrapped frame. "So do we. For a while."
HUUM!

White light shuddered through the Shroud’s body, and its core, a thing grown and keyed and sworn to THE PAX across centuries, simply changed hands. It stood at Baelgrim’s gesture. It knelt at Baelgrim’s gesture. It turned its wrapped head toward its own racks of collars with an obedience its makers had never installed, and Baelgrim released it, and the ownership drained away over a few breaths, and the Shroud slumped back into the Pax’s inventory none the wiser.
"Touch, and tithe," Baelgrim said. "Weapons. Armaments. Authorities, if my grip is deeper than their seat. My cousins can do it to stranger things."
The two Fiend-line loungers demonstrated. The first laid her palm flat against the ambient dark and claimed the sliver of Infinity threaded through it, blue rising off her skin in a brief stolen sea.
The second pressed one finger to the marble floor, and for ten long seconds the entire terraced garden was his the way a hand is his, stone flexing when he flexed.
"The Fiend’s blood claims...okay" Noah observed from his seat.
"Kharvel."
The watcher rose, rested and terrible!
"My line runs from THE Unblinking Shepherd,"he said quietly. "And the Shepherd’s gift is that the flock is always found."
His eyes closed. And every Loomwrought Shroud in the pocket Dimension straightened at once.
"I am seeing through all of them," Kharvel said, eyes still shut. "Forty-one Shrouds, nine functional. I am seeing through all of them."
His eyes opened, and they were pale-rimmed now, ringed in faint white. "Anything that has ever been watched, my line can watch from. And anything I have marked..."
He looked at Noah, and inclined his head slightly. "...I would find across Dimensions, until one of us ceased. The Shepherd does not lose sheep. THE Argent Loom itself is a trail to us."

Othrys followed his lineage-brother, and his display was the inversion of eleven thousand years of sentence. He walked the length of the hall and was not noticed doing it, not by the seven, not by the instruments, a presence folded out of every attention in the room at will, and then he stood at its center and unfolded, and every eye arrived on him at once.
"They cursed me with the broken half of my own gift,"he said, and for once he did not perform the words. "Attention, with the ownership stripped out. Thousands of years of it."
He bowed low to the man seated on the Warden."It is mine again."
Noah nodded and looked at the next one.
"Sylvaine."
She drew no blade. Instead she raised one hand, and reached into the unseen, and pulled.
Threads of THE Argent Loom came down into the visible.

White rivers, the same authority that ran the collars and the roads and the Inhibitors of the whole towering institution outside, gathered into her palms in obedient skeins, and she began to build. Blades first, a hundred of them, forged of braided loomlight.

Then the blades became ribs, and the ribs became an architecture, a vaulted lattice of white edges assembling itself above the hall, vast and precise and strangely beautiful, a cathedral-frame of pure cutting authority filling the pretend sky.
And it keened.
A low note ran through every strut of it, soft and unresolved, a construction that mourned its own standing, and Sylvaine looked up into her own work with an expression that held old questions.

"My line runs from THE Weeping Architect," she said. "We build with THE Argent Loom the way our Father built before us. And everything we build... grieves. We have never learned why. Our messages arrive as sorrows. Our works arrive singing them."
Her hand closed, and the lattice folded itself away into nothing, and the keening stopped.
The shadow-cursed lounger built after her, a fortress of layered dark raised and razed in half a minute, its walls weeping slow black light at every seam.
And through all of it, Noah sat on the back of a Warden and watched.
"Claim, watch, build," said the Crown. "The Fiend takes, the Shepherd finds, the Architect makes. Three weavings, and THE PAX runs on all three of them..."
At last, Noah’s gaze settled on the final kneeling figure.
"Enforcer. Your turn."
Mahishasura rose with his torn coat and his quiet old hate, and did not choose a Shroud or a thread or a trick.
He simply opened his hands.
And the entire pocket Dimension’s Loom answered.

Every river of white in the sealed abode rose at once, out of the collars and the racks and the slumped Shrouds and the seams of the walls, an ocean of authority lifting into the air in perfect surgical order, and it turned above them all, and where it turned it worked: a broken Shroud on the far table unmade itself to threads and remade itself whole, the shattered colonnades of the Yrsa battle knitted stone by stone, hairline order sweeping the ruin out of the hall in a single conducted pass.
He closed his hands. The ocean settled home. The hall stood repaired.
"My display,"he said flatly, "is that Those Who Remain use THE Argent Loom, and I understand it immensely. If not for being swarmed and sneak attacked, I would have not been defeated..."
It was straightforward and grand!
Noah rose from his seat, unhurried, and stood at the center of the repaired hall, and delivered the lesson.
"You have all shown me wonders, but..."

"Existence is terribly fond of novelty. It offers an endless, glittering weaving of abilities, authorities, and specialized tricks, all of it designed to make us feel clever. But in the grand, infinite weavings of existence, all those infinite variations are usually just theatrical fluff. When the curtain falls, the entity with the sheer, crushing weight of raw power wins the battle. Nine times out of ten... mass breaks nuance."
WAA!

"Except, of course, for that rare, terrifying creature who carries the one authority that unmakes everything entirely. A truly unique authority will rewrite the rules before you even realize you have sat down at the table."

His endless blue eyes moved slowly across seven reverent faces and one hateful one and one empty one. "I mean... look at what happened to all of you, when put against me. You were more powerful than me. You had more abilities than me. Every one of you, deeper, older, richer in gifts."
He spread his hands slightly, taking in the hall, the kneeling, the grammar none of them could see.
"And here we are."
No one answered!
Noah looked down at the Warden still waiting on her hands and knees, patted her head once, twice, the maintenance of furniture, and turned for the sealed door with his hands loose at his sides.
"Prepare, all of you. Soon, we begin corrupting THE PAX."

chapters.title: Chapter 5631: A Torn Wall!
paragraphs: As Noah continued to scheme on exactly how things could unfold in THE Serenaros, he asked...
"The vessels of THE Sealed One. Where are they kept?"
Mahishasura stood beside the repaired long table with his hands folded behind his back, and answered.
"Two are held in this Dimension. The others are distributed. THE PAX...does not warehouse its rarest stock in one vault."
Noah weighed it in silence.
Two of them, a short walk from this place. Pinned pieces of the enemy who, in some future, attained IT!
A visit would have to be made, and made carefully.
Could he learn anything more of THE Sealed One from shackled vessels? He would find out soon enough.
For now, Noah turned his gaze inward and far away, to THE Infiniverse, where one Hearthshift after another had been completed while a pocket Dimension held its coup.
And his own progress had been immense.
The fifth Hearthshift settled.
And a few hundred million lifeforms now pulled upon Noah Osmont without knowing his name.

A few hundred million was not large, as Dimensions counted the living. In a single Dimension there could be countless Folds, and within them countless Domains of Existence, and within those countless Cosmos holding Universes and Galaxies and Worlds beyond any counting, filled with decillions upon decillions of beings who held no connection to Infinity or THE Primordial Source at all, who would live and end without once touching mana or knowing it existed.
No. The few hundred million were something else entirely.

They were the powerful. The connected. The lifeforms in every Dimension with the immensity to effect tremendous change, the sovereigns and cultivators and ancients whose draws moved the fates of everything beneath them. Rulership of them was rulership of every hand!
And yet.
He was still THE True Human Emperor, and the decillions mattered to the title as much as the millions did. Because behind his wellsprings came his home.

The authority of THE Infiniverse flowed out across every bound Dimension in rivers of crimson that no eye would ever find, THE CRIMSON WEFT latching quietly onto Folds and Domains and Cosmos entirely, and even if none of them knew, even if not one being from the greatest True Lifeform to the smallest child in the smallest World ever learned it...
They were, effectively, under his rule. All of them.l
The fifth Dimension was blue.

Noah floated at the middle of it, and in every direction, radiant Infinity trees stretched away for light years. Yggdrasils of pure deep blue, trunks wider than Worlds, crowns of azure light spreading across the dark in canopies that whole civilizations navigated by, roots drinking from wells of blue so bright they made the void around them look painted.

Blue permeated everything here. The light was blue, the drifting seeds were blue, the very texture of the ambient dark ran blue at its edges, because this was a Dimension that had given itself to Infinity entirely.
And near the great trees, dozens of True Infinite Lifeforms floated with their eyes closed.
They hung still and reverent in the branches’ light, ancient beings wrapped in oceans of blue, and every one of them was sensing the same impossible thing!
The Infinity they had drawn upon for entire Ages, the Infinity they knew the way they knew their own names, had suddenly become... so much grander.
Sweeter in the draw and deeper in the well, and not one of them could say why, and not one of them could stop drinking!
Noah watched them from the open sky, unperceived!
|Your rulership has extended across multiple bound Dimensions.|

|89,412,506 Infinite Lifeforms of this Dimension now draw, in part or in whole, upon your Infinite Sanguine Mana as the wellspring of their Infinity. 84 True Infinite Lifeforms now draw upon you. 12 among them pursue the fusion of Infinity and THE Primordial Source, and their pursuit has been eased.|
|They perceive nothing. They will perceive nothing.|
|Total, across THE Ymnaros and five bound Dimensions: 396,208,441 lifeforms now draw upon you as the source beneath their sources.|
|Provenance Essence expenditure has risen accordingly: 0.0000009% per second. The rate remains negligible.|
And behind those prompts, the deeper count arrived.
|1,000,000,000 Provenance Telos Quarks converted.|
|THE Infinite Provenance Baryogenesis proceeds at the greatest pace yet recorded.|
|The wall at 20 is being torn apart.|
BOOM!
The breakthrough arrived, and no one saw it!

Across the blue vastness, not a single ancient stirred. No skies split for watching crowds. No phenomenon announced itself to the dozens of True Infinite Lifeforms hanging in the branches light years away, because the being at the center of it stood at a depth their senses did not reach, and what they could not perceive, they could not witness.
But existence itself attended.

Around the floating figure of Noah, rivers of Infinite Sanguine Mana rose out of him and coiled, crimson gold serpents of blood-light winding through the empty sky in slow colossal spirals, dozens of them, then hundreds, a storm of rivers turning around a single man.

Glimmers of Provenance Essence kindled among them, stellar blue-gold points igniting one after another until the space around him held its own constellation, and the weight of everything came down, THE Primordial Source and Infinity and THE Argent Loom and Time and all the imperceivable rest, pouring through his frame into quarks that drank and drank and did not burst.
His hair lifted in a wind that touched nothing else.

His endless blue eyes burned brighter, and the twenty singularities of his depths turned as one, and somewhere far beneath perception, a membrane that had been meant to hold for months or years simply came apart.
|Your attributes have crossed the wall.|
|VERITAS: 25.|
|PONDUS: 24.|
|PROVENANCE: 23.|
|POTENTIA: INFINITE.|
The rivers settled slowly back into him. The constellation dimmed and went home.
And in the branches of a blue yggdrasil light years away, one ancient True Infinite Lifeform opened her eyes and turned her head toward the empty middle sky, frowning faintly at nothing at all.
She closed her eyes, and went back to drinking from a well she did not know had a king.
|THE Infiniverse reports: her Dimensionality is rising at a tremendously rapid rate.|

|Cause: THE CRIMSON WEFT now binds her authority across many Dimensions, and Observable Existences continue to rise within her without pause. A Dimension that contains a thousand foundations and touches six more Dimensions is being weighed by existence as something no framework has a shelf for.|
|And her rising lifts you. Your Dimensionality now runs far higher than what your attributes express.|
|Effect: THE PRECEPT OF SOLIPSISM has deepened. You may now render yourself unperceivable to lifeforms whose attributes reach into the 30s.|
Noah read the last prompt twice, and a slow!
The 30s. Mahishasura himself sat in the low thirties. Which meant that as of this moment, the Enforcer could not find him if he did not wish to be found!

Which meant that as of this moment, the Enforcer could not find him if he did not wish to be found!

chapters.title: Chapter 5632: Rage. Rage. Rage!
paragraphs: The wall was torn, and Noah was already thinking past it.
His current level of immensity was a floor, not a ceiling, and the road to raising it rapidly had already proven itself five Dimensions over.

More Hearthshifts. More wells laid beneath more draws. More rulership extended along roads no instrument could register, until the count beneath him stopped being millions and started being measured the way Dimensions were measured!
The plan needed no revision. It only needed repetition, and time, and he held infinite quantities of exactly one of those.
But at such a time... something connected to him trembled!
HUUUM!

It was not an attack. It was not the Weft, and it was not a thread of rulership, and for one strange moment he could not place it at all, because the trembling came from a connection he had given away.
It came from THE Infiniverse.

From the bubble chamber. From the backbone of THE Infinite Scales he had cast out on obsidian sands, the framework he had built across a small time in mimicry of Vakochev’s Scales of Existence, the ladder his old power had climbed before Provenance replaced every rung of it.
He had been thinking, only recently, about how to reframe that cast-out skeleton under his Provenance!
And at this moment, she sent her message through.
|Master. Weavings of a grand record are being sent through your old scales of existence.|
|A record that seems to stem from... Vakochev himself.|
BOOM!
Noah’s eyes shone with a terrifying brilliance.
"Send it through."
He closed his eyes. And within a corner of his consciousness, a grand record was passed inward, and it bloomed!
His consciousness gave the record a stage, and the stage was an endless stellar blue sea.
Noah’s body manifested upon the still water, whole and standing, and opposite him, something else arrived.
A shrouded figure, seated.

It could not entirely be observed. The shape of it slid away from direct perception, and around it, obsidian waves rolled, black lightning crawling through them in slow crowns, immensity manifesting in tides that the blue sea absorbed without complaint!

A being that had covered Observable Existences and Dimensions and vast reaches of THE Infinite Carcosa and THE Source Lands with a single framework, rendered down into a recording, and still too grand to look at directly.
And then it spoke, and its voice boomed through the whole of Noah’s consciousness!
"I am Vakochev."
The obsidian waves rose with the name.
"And I am reaching out to all those who tried to do what I tried to do. I send this message through my Scales and other Scales, to the few with Boundless Potential."
The shrouded head lifted.

"I tried to go against Those Who Remain. I tried to level the playing field, for all of us. And I have failed. I have to retreat. I have come to the conclusion that this is not something I can do alone... because Those Who Remain are not alone."
The lightning stilled for a moment, and the voice came lower.

"I retreat in defeat. And I persevere. And you, who seek to do the same as me... Persevere. They are coming for me, and they will come for you. They will try to stifle every life and every possibility that could one day topple them. So forgive me, for the adversity you are about to have."
The figure’s shrouded gaze seemed to find him, across a recording, across existence.

"But even adversity is part of existence. If you die, this is also a part of existence. If you are brought into their folds, this too is a part of existence. So Persevere. Do not go gentle into the night."
The obsidian waves rose into a storm.
"Rage."
The sea shook.
"Rage."
The sky of his consciousness split with black light.
"RAGE!"
BOOM!

The figure stood, and the standing alone drove the stellar sea outward in a ring, and then it shot upward, a pillar of obsidian and lightning climbing out of the record and out of perception entirely!
And where it had sat, something remained.
A single obsidian crystal, small and dark and perfectly still, settling down through the blue water of Noah’s consciousness.
|The record has concluded.|
|Something has been left behind. Its nature is ???.|
Noah opened his eyes, shock still moving through him, the crystal settling somewhere deep and the last word still ringing in every corner of what he was!
He grasped the crystal, and all it had were question marks!
And in the next moment, all of existence began to shake.
The Dimension he stood in shook. And far across the dark, even THE Infiniverse began to shake, a Unique Transfinite Dimension trembling in her own step between Dimensions
It...was not isolated.
In a quiet Inner Dimension far across THE Infinite Carcosa, a man who wore the body of Achilles Adrastia was breaking a promise slowly, and doing it face to face.
"Until I am certain," he said, "that I control my existence... that this hand is mine when it moves, and this voice is mine when it speaks... I may have to leave you, Rose."
The woman before him had green hair that fell in loose waves, and a beauty so vivid it made the quiet garden around her seem painted was pained.
She was about to reply when...
Existence shook.

The garden swayed. The light bent. And the man who was half Achilles Adrastia and half something sealed and ancient had already appeared to wrap his arms around Rose as he looked around for any threat coldly!
Far away.
In an unknown Dimension of black stone and burning skies, THE Creature was at war.

Two Primeval Ones circled him, vast and old and bleeding, and his obsidian flames ran threaded with white-gold as THE MAW hung open at his shoulder and the shapeless Pantheon wore the battlefield itself. One of the Primevals struck!
Then existence shook.
All three ancient things stopped, mid-violence, in perfect unison.
And THE Creature turned his head upward, toward a sky that was not the source of anything, and the swirling white rivers in his eyes narrowed.
In a grand citadel of gold and glory, a thousand True Gilded Lifeforms looked up at once.

Not one after another. At once, in a single synchronized motion, a thousand brilliant heads tilting toward the ceiling in the same heartbeat, because not one of the motions was their own. Their amplified Egos burned in perfect, identical rhythm, an ocean of glory moving as one instrument.
For they were under the collective control of THE Great Usurper.
And around them, existence shook!
And in THE Serenaros, the shaking rolled through everything.
The purple gold mountains swayed upon their clouds. The cage-fields rattled for light years, columns of stacked prisons groaning, despondent captives lifting their heads.
And inside a pocket Dimension that was sealed against all of existence, the shaking arrived anyway.

The marble hall trembled. Wine pools shivered. Cured Descendants were on their feet in an instant, staring upward at a pretend sky, and the empty instrument that had been Yrsa stood placidly in the swaying hall awaiting instruction, and Descendant Mahishasura gazed around coldly.
Noah stood at the center of the trembling marble.
He looked around slowly and somberly as he thought about Vakochev’s words!
Rage. Rage. Rage!

chapters.title: Chapter 5633: The Provenance of Existence! I
paragraphs: The shaking deepened.
And beneath it, running under the quake of every surface, there came a sound that was not truly a sound!
A sensation of something cracking. Something vast and old and everywhere at once, fracturing along its whole length!

Noah looked around slowly. Across the trembling marble hall, the Descendants were doing the same, seven cured faces and one hateful one all tilted toward a pretend sky, because every one of them was feeling it too!
|A vast structure is breaking across existence.|
|Certainty is not possible, but weighed against everything in your records... that may be the fracturing of Vakochev’s Scales of Existence.|
The prompt was a heavy one, and existence went on quaking around it!

The Scales. The framework that covered Observable Existences and Dimensions and vast reaches of THE Infinite Carcosa and THE Source Lands. The ladder that even free beings paradoxically kept climbing, the measure so old that entire civilizations had never conceived of standing anywhere else!
He had heard its maker’s voice minutes ago, wrapped in obsidian lightning, admitting defeat.I retreat. I persevere. Rage!
And now the ladder itself was coming apart across the whole of everything.
At such a time, Noah heard nothing at all.
But through the Descendants his existence controlled, through seven Veiled lines and one bound Sovereign whose senses were his to share... he heard it.

A voice, echoing out within the lineages themselves. Booming and serene at once, feminine, filled with an immensity that made the fracturing sound small, arriving not through any air but through the blood, through the unbroken written lines running back through every ancestor, a message into existence itself of the kind that Descendants received once in a lifetime if they were fortunate.
Every Descendant in the hall went rigid as one.
|Rejoice, O Progeny of Immense Ones.|

|For you will be first to learn of the coming of the new Ruling of Existence itself. No Scales shall sit above anything ordained by THE Immense Ones, by Those Who Remain. There is only our Rulings, that all of existence shall follow and thrive from.|
|There is only, and will only be... THE Provenance of Existence.|
Noah’s gaze became terribly heavy.
Vakochev’s message, and then this, in the same hour!
That grand lifeform had failed at whatever his plans had been, had broadcast his defeat through a specific few, and Those Who Remain had answered his retreat by making their move at last!
A replacement of the measure of everything!
Just what did it entail?
THE Provenance of Existence.
They had taken the word Provenance!

The name of what THE First Lifeforms were, the name of what he was, the name of the one power in all of existence that owed nothing, borrowed nothing, and was granted nothing... and THE Immense Ones had taken it!
The voice went on. And what it delivered next, only the Descendants of all existence would receive freely!
Every other lifeform across every Dimension would feel the Ruling settle over their lives tonight and be given nothing at all, left to learn its shape by stumbling through it for Ages.
|Hear the mechanics of the Ruling, O Progeny.|

|Existence is woven of MANTLES. They have always been there: roles woven through the living since the living began. The Ruler. The Peasant. The Tyrant. The Mender. The Shield. The Blade. The Watcher. The Betrayer. The Wanderer. The Usurper. Every age and every Dimension has worn them, and until this day, wearing them earned nothing.|
|As of this day, the Ruling answers those who wear them.|

|When a lifeform wears a Mantle so truly, and for so long, that its own weavings and the Mantle’s weavings can no longer be told apart, existence shall record the union. That recording is an ORDINATION. The Ordained draw standing, power, and depth from the Ruling itself, owing nothing to any framework of authority, and so the humble may rise through their roles where no ladder of power would ever have carried them. This is the gift.|
Around the marble hall, seven cured Descendants stood frozen inside a message only their blood could hear, and Mahishasura had gone very pale!
"They have never done this before..."he said softly, to no one. "In all the records of all the lines. They have never once addressed us all!"
HUUM!
The voice was not finished.
|And know the two roads of the Ruling, for every lifeform shall walk one.|

|THE ORDERED are those who live their roles in service of the ordained order. Their EXISTENTIAL MOIRAI shall gather steadily: the favor of existence itself, chance leaning toward their steps and the door that opens at the needed hour. Their Dimensionality shall rise with their observance, slow and without ceiling. Existence favors stability. The Ordered ARE stability. They shall thrive from the Ruling, and the Ruling shall thrive from them.|

|THE WILLFUL are those who wear their roles for their own ends, or worse, who refuse all roles and author themselves. To them the Ruling gives its other face. Existence also has the undeniable fact of instability and entropy. Their power shall come fast and grand. And their Moirai shall burn or flicker without notice, and chance shall lean away from them like the unstable things they are. They shall thrive from the chaos of Existence. The Willful are permitted. The Willful are even needed.|
The hall was silent inside the quaking.
And Noah stood at the center of it, unheard-of things assembling themselves behind his cold eyes!
They had built an order that rewards its own believing and likely benefitted Those Who Remain!
His eyes flashed, and he turned THE Protagonist’s Omniscient Regard on the nearest Descendant.
|Descendant Baelgrim|:: VERITAS: 24. PROVENANCE: 0. POTENTIA: 23. PONDUS: 26. MOIRAI: 14. No role.|
There it was. A new line!
He swept the Regard across the hall. Sylvaine, MOIRAI: 11. Othrys, MOIRAI: 9. Kharvel, MOIRAI: 22!
Mahishasura, MOIRAI: 31, an Enforcer of order weighed richly by an order he had never heard of until this minute.
And then, slowly, Noah turned the Regard inward, upon himself.
|VERITAS: 25. PONDUS: 24. PROVENANCE: 23. POTENTIA: INFINITE.|
|MOIRAI: ???|
|The Ruling has attempted to weigh you unsuccessfully. The Ruling is still attempting.|

chapters.title: Chapter 5634: The Provenance of Existence! II
paragraphs: The quaking had begun to settle, but the questions had not.

A system did not become real by being announced. It became real by being tested, and Noah had a hall full of instruments, a bound Enforcer with thirty-one Moirai already weighed upon him, and no intention of learning the Ruling’s shape the way the rest of existence would learn it, by stumbling.
So he turned to the most richly weighed being in the room.
"Mahishasura.What have you done across your long life? What are you doing still? Proclaim it, and let us see what this new Ruling makes of you."
The Enforcer straightened his torn coat, and lifted his chin, and spoke!
"I am Mahishasura, Enforcer of THE Serenaros." The soft voice carried through the marble hall, and something in it began to resonate!

"I have held a mountain, and from that mountain I have ordered the Wardens sworn beneath me out into the reaches of existence. At my word, they have stripped the authority from countless lifeforms unworthy of holding it. I weighed them, and I found them unworthy, and I had them subtracted."
His amber eyes did not waver!

"I have taken the mighty out of the hands of the helpless. I have emptied the skies of appetites. I have caged what could not be reasoned with and carried it away from everything it would have eaten."
The hall held still.
And then, from above, out of a pretend sky that had no above to offer... a golden shield descended!
HUUM!

It was vast and slow and utterly silent, a sigil of deep gold in the shape of a great shield, turning gently as it came down through the air over the Enforcer’s head, and light poured off it in soft sheets, and every being in the hall felt existence itself lean toward the marble floor where one bound Descendant stood proclaiming.
|The Ruling has heard a proclamation, and weighed it against a life.|
|Descendant Mahishasura has been recognized. He now wears the Mantle of THE SHIELD.|

|THE SHIELD: the Protector’s role, worn by all who stand between harm and the held. What THE SHIELD guards, existence shall help him guard. His EXISTENTIAL MOIRAI shall gather from his actions and from the results of his actions: every harm turned aside, every held thing that endures, shall be weighed and paid. While he acts in accordance with his role, his power shall be amplified tremendously. And should a wearer of THE SHIELD face an opposing role in contest, existence itself shall lean, and probability shall bend, to ensure the victory of one of THE ORDERED.|
|Should Descendant Mahishasura truly and fully live his Mantle, deed upon deed upon deed... he may one day be granted his own unique Ordination.|

The golden sigil settled, sinking into the air above his shoulders until it hung there faint and turning, a quiet crest that did not fade. And Mahishasura stood beneath it surrounded by a grand descending light, gold pouring over the torn black coat and the pale hair, and for a moment the bound, hateful, coup-broken Enforcer looked almost exalted, a figure existence itself had chosen to illuminate!
Noah looked at him, and slowly shook his head.
His eyes flashed.
|Descendant Mahishasura|:: VERITAS: 40 (34). PROVENANCE: 0. POTENTIA: 40 (32). PONDUS: 40 (33). MOIRAI: 31, and gathering. He wears the Mantle of THE SHIELD.|
Forty. Across the board!

The parentheses held what the Descendant truly was, and the Ruling had simply written larger numbers over them, granted for nothing more than proclaiming a life and being found in accordance with a role.
His cold gaze swept the hall. "The rest of you. All of you. Proclaim what your existence has been doing so far! Let us see just what role, just what archetype, each of you holds!"
WAA!
Baelgrim went first.

"I am Baelgrim," the mountain rumbled. "I have no grand record of order. I have only this. For all my Ages, when something came for my kin, it found me in front of them. Before the curse, I stood in front. That is all I have ever done."
HUUM!
A second golden shield descended, vast and slow, and settled turning above the mountain’s shoulders, and Baelgrim looked up at his own crest with wonder.
|Descendant Baelgrim has been recognized. He now wears the Mantle of THE SHIELD.|
|VERITAS: 30 (24). POTENTIA: 30 (23). PONDUS: 30 (26). MOIRAI: 14, and gathering.|
Sylvaine stepped forward with her eyes set, and proclaimed a harder life!

"I was made to end things. I have ended tyrants and ended innocents and ended whatever my masters pointed me toward, and when the ire of THE Immense Ones made me feel every wound I authored, I authored them anyway, when the cause was worth the cutting. And...
Nothing descended.
The hall waited, and nothing happened as it seemed that one still needed to have had significant actions to back their claims, and could not simply bullshit their way to a Mantle!
Which left one being in the hall unaccounted for.
"Warden." Noah’s voice stayed level. "Proclaim what your existence has done."
The empty instrument that had been Yrsa stepped forward at the command and proclaimed in a voice with no resonance in it at all.

The hall waited.
Nothing descended again!
|The Ruling has weighed this proclamation.|
|It has found no one.|
Noah held the prompt in his cold gaze for a moment.
So the Ruling did not weigh bodies, or ranks, or obediences. It weighed selves!
And where a self had been erased, the grandest system Those Who Remain had ever imposed looked into a standing, speaking, breathing being... and found no one home to give a role to.
Noah watched the hall wordlessly after that.
Three Shields, a Blade, a Watcher, a Wanderer, a Mender. Golden crests turning over seven of his nine, one Descendant unweighed, one instrument unfounded!
Existence itself leaned into the room the way a patron leans into a shop it has decided to fund.

The boosts were terrifying! Under these new scales, these new Rulings of Those Who Remain, a proclaimed life was worth more, and if a wearer met one of the Willful in contest, probability itself would take a side.
Even he, standing outside every framework existence had ever offered him, looked at the boons... and was tempted.
But no.

He had cast out borrowed thongs and he had not done it to kneel at a newer, grander one. He had to generate something of his own. Even if he tapped into this vastness, and he might, because this was a new makeup of existence itself that even he could not deny, it would be on his terms, through his own works, worn as nothing existence could revoke.
Because that was the fact under all the gold: existence itself... deferred to this new system.
And even now, watching the crests turn above the proclaimed, Noah felt he was only beginning to grasp what Those Who Remain had imposed upon all of existence.

And should a wearer of THE SHIELD face an opposing role in contest, existence itself shall lean, and probability shall bend, to ensure the victory of one of THE ORDERED.|

The golden sigil settled, sinking into the air above his shoulders until it hung there faint and turning, a quiet crest that did not fade.

chapters.title: Chapter 5635: For Stability!
paragraphs: Noah thought about it for a while.
A new system had been laid over all of existence, and existence itself deferred to it.
He wanted to see...how far he could push it.
"Mahishasura." He turned to the Shield. "We...are going to visit another mountain. And when we arrive, you are going to make a proclamation of your own."
The amber eyes watched him with attentiveness at this time!

"You will tell the Enforcer of that mountain this. That for the stability of existence, your role as THE SHIELD requires more Enforcers and more Wardens acting directly beneath you, so that you may gather the Moirai to stabilize existence further as you see fit."

"Which means that Enforcer must bend the knee to you. And should they refuse..." He let it settle. "...then they stand against the stability of existence itself. And a Shield, in accordance with its role, is permitted to correct that."
Mahishasura understood as he shook his head with incredulity, because the plan was monstrous and elegant and used his own new Mantle as the knife!
They set off across THE Serenaros.

The Weft carried them, unseen, crimson threads bearing an emperor and his Shield out over the purple gold mountains and the cloud-seas and the gigaparsec cages stacked on each other, and Noah watched the Dimension move beneath them as they went.
It was in chaos, quietly.

The Ruling had settled over THE Serenaros the same hour it settled over everything, and even here, in the seat of the ones who served THE Immense Ones, no one had been told more than the Descendants had.
Many were trying to grasp this new system!
The masters of order, Noah observed, were as disordered as anyone tonight.
A little while later.
A mountain rose ahead of them, ringed in its own cages, and Mahishasura brought them down before its gates and called out.
"Enforcer Vorlag."
His soft voice carried across the terraces, and after a moment, powerhouses came out!

An Enforcer first, a broad Descendant with stone-gray skin and a brow-mark split like cracked stone, flanked by his Wardens. Noah’s eyes flashed across them as they emerged, cataloguing without a word.

One of the Wardens was a Descendant like her master. The rest were progeny, the mingled blood of Descendants and Primeval Ones, of Descendants and Infinite Lifeforms drawn in deep blue, of Descendants and old Source things, the mixed and mighty middle ranks that ran the machinery of THE PAX.
"Mahishasura!" Vorlag’s gray face was bright!
"You felt and heard the glorious change our Fathers have laid down?! Haha, even we are trying to figure it out right now!"
Mahishasura spread his hands, and the golden shield-crest turned faintly above his shoulders, and he made his proclamation.
"Yes, Existence has a new Ruling, Vorlag. You have felt it. I have grasped it." The crest brightened as he spoke in accordance with his role!

"I wear the Mantle of THE SHIELD, and my role is the protection of the ordained order, and the Ruling has shown me that to stabilize existence further, I require more hands acting beneath mine. More Enforcers. More Wardens. Yours among them."
His voice stayed courteous and warm.
"So bend the knee, and act beneath me for the stability of existence. Or refuse, and stand revealed as a thing that opposes stability itself."
BOOM!
Vorlag’s bright face began to darken toward anger.
"You have lost your damn mind! The fuck are you talking abou-...!"
Mahishasura attacked.
No further word. No warning!
The Shield simply moved, and the whole of THE Serenaros seemed to move with him!
Noah watched from the open air, and as the Shield struck, prompts rose before his eyes alone.
|A wearer of THE SHIELD is acting in full accordance with his role.|

|Descendant Mahishasura has framed this contest as the set order against a thing that opposes it. The Ruling has accepted the framing. Existence has begun writing a narrative around his existence and his role.|

Mahishasura crossed the distance in an instant, and his fist took Vorlag across the jaw. Forty attributes behind the blow, against a being who stood in the low thirties, and worse, far worse, existence itself leaned into it as it landed!
Noah watched probability bend in real time. Vorlag’s guard came up a fraction too slow. Every small chance that might have saved him tilted, quietly and completely, toward the wearer of THE SHIELD.
|Probability has bent to favor THE ORDERED. Result achieved: an opposing role staggered.|
|EXISTENTIAL MOIRAI of Descendant Mahishasura: 33.|
The Ruling was helping. It had chosen a side the instant Mahishasura framed the fight as order against disorder, and it did not choose halfway!
He fought with everything he was at once. His lineage gift woke, and where his hands passed, the mountain’s own defenses answered him instead of their master!

THE Argent Loom rose to him the way it rose to no one else alive, white rivers pouring up out and gathering into his open hands and hardening into weapons, into walls, into a hundred white blades that orbited him and struck where he looked!
Loom, and lineage, and forty attributes, and existence itself tilting the floor beneath his enemies!
It was not a fight.It was a demonstration of what THE ORDERED were built to be.
Vorlag went down alongside his forces as nobody else had to make a move!
Mahishasura floated there, gazing at his own hands as if he couldnt believe what he had done!
|Result achieved: an opposing cohort broken. Harm turned aside from the ordained order.|
|Existence continues to favor the accordant. EXISTENTIAL MOIRAI of Descendant Mahishasura: 33 to 37.|
|He is playing out his role to perfection.|
Oh!
In under a minute, Enforcer Vorlag and every Warden of his mountain lay broken across their own terraces, alive, ruined, uncomprehending.
Mahishasura turned toward Noah, breathing hard, and on his face as right now he showed...euphoria!
"Lock this place down." Noah’s voice went sharp and quick as he began to move towards the defeated!
The Veiled moved as darkness flowed all around.
And Noah descended toward the broken Enforcer and his broken Wardens, and his sanguine blades were already blooming along his hands, crimson gold and humming.
He crouched over the ruined Enforcer, blades bright, and got to the work of taking him.
It seemed that new possibilities were rising!
He could attain his goals much faster amidst the chaos of this new system...while also utilizing it and the terrifying power behind it to achieve his aims!
He would use this new Ruling of existence they had imposed to fuck them over tremendously, if he could!

chapters.title: Chapter 5636: Roles! I
paragraphs: Although the battle for the mountain had ended, the absolute weight of order remained heavy in the air.
Noah floated silently before the broken forms of Enforcer Vorlag and his cohort of Wardens, who all knelt in the ruined courtyards of their own fief after he had placed his Markers into them.
Around Noah, the veiled figures of Mahishasura, Kharvel, Sylvaine, and the other cured Descendants floated in immaculate stillness!
Noah looked at the kneeling forms, his eyes exceptionally bright as his mind catalogued exactly what had just occurred.
In truth, he was thinking more and more about THE Provenance of Existence and how this new system could be stretched, weaponized, and ultimately drained.

The most glaring vulnerability this Ruling came with was the Mantles, and the absolute reality that if an existence truly and fully played out their designated role, existence itself would side with them.
It was represented by Moirai. It acted akin to a localized destiny backing a lifeform simply because of what they stood for. Thus, Noah reasoned through the implications.

Could he design a grand narrative role for someone like Mahishasura to perform? Could he effectively turn the Descendant into a lead actor on a grand stage? Would the Moirai bend nearby existence to aid him in living out this newly authored role?
To truly fulfill this architecture, he needed complete operational control!

Noah did not speak a command aloud. Instead, he sent a concentrated portion of his own consciousness directly into the veiled weavings of Mahishasura, taking total, seamless control of the Descendant’s body and power.
Stepping into the vessel of a Descendant was a remarkably strange sensation.
Noah felt the unbending sentence written into the very blood of the lineage, humming with the cold dictation of Those Who Remain.
He felt the innate, effortless connection to THE Argent Loom, perceiving the boundless white threads of authority that stitched the Dimension together.
But most surprisingly, he felt the Existential Moirai surrounding this body. It was a buoyant, upward pressure.
It made him feel as though the physical surroundings themselves were actively lifting him up, eager to support whatever action THE SHIELD decided to take!
While his consciousness anchored into Mahishasura, Noah’s actual body moved backward.
He waved his hands casually, pooling crimson gold Sanguine Mana infused with stellar blue light to form a high, bloody throne.
Sitting back upon it, THE Precept of Solipsism washed over him, rendering him entirely unperceivable to anyone whose attributes fell below his own, and more due to his immense Dimensionality.
Below his throne, the Descendants lined up like perfect soldiers, an arrangement that allowed Noah to comfortably bask in the ambient awe and Moirai without ever exposing his own hands.

From the mouth of Mahishasura, Noah looked down at Enforcer Vorlag and the vastness of thid place. He needed to truly unleash the Mantle of THE SHIELD, and to do so, he required a speech that existence itself could not ignore!

"There was once a mortal man attempt to hold up a collapsing roof with a single wooden beam,"Mahishasura spoke, his voice echoing with a soft, precise, courteous lecturing warmth that carried an iron menace beneath.
"Many go on believing that a shield is just a piece of metal you hold in front of your own chest. But a true shield is an architecture."
Mahishasura paced slowly through the white threads of THE Argent Loom.

"To truly fulfill my Mantle as THE SHIELD, my ability is fundamentally limited if I cannot control all members of THE PAX across the entire Serenaros Dimension. To guard the order, I must bring every Enforcer on this Dimension under my fold. I must take control of the Arbiter. Except, the architects of this Dimension are terribly fond of their current, flawed design. They hoard authority while the roof collapses."
Mahishasura stopped pacing and opened his arms toward the purple gold skies, his amber gold eyes blazing as he addressed the firmaments of Existence directly!
"Will existence side with one of its children who stands faithfully as one of THE ORDERED? Will existence back me in this arduous accounting?!"
He lowered his gaze back to Enforcer Vorlag, his tone dropping the cosmic grandeur for a flat, terrifyingly simple conclusion.
"They do not deserve to hold the line. And frankly... neither do you."
BOOM!
The results arrived instantly. All of surrounding existence buzzed with a deafening, resonant frequency as the skies of THE Serenaros seemed to physically lean downward!
Cascading waves of pure Moirai gushed from the skies, pouring directly into the body of Mahishasura like a breaking dam!
Information flooded into the Descendant’s existence, a raw Existential validation that Noah immediately translated into crisp prompts within his own vision.
|You are one of the foremost existences utilizing THE Provenance of Existence to its fullest.|
|You are the first to trigger a Narrative of Existence.|
|THE Narrative of Existence, Political Crusade, has been triggered as you are one of the central Mantles.|

|Political Crusade: A triggered internal conflict to usurp rule against those deemed unworthy of their stations. Mahishasura, THE SHIELD, has been deemed The Leading Crusade. All Narrative Moirai flows around him, strengthening his existence and the Crusaders behind him to guarantee the highest probability of a successful crusade.|

|Existential Moirai begins to bud aggressively in THE Serenaros. If enough participants arise, and if different Mantles and roles join in this Narrative, an interested gaze from one of THE Immense Ones may be drawn over. Leading participants will gain unfathomable Existential Moirai in return.|
The returns were ridiculously out of his expectations!

Sitting unperceivable on his bloody throne, Noah gazed at the prompts through the eyes of Mahishasura, processing the sheer volume of Moirai exploding around the vessel. It was an absolute validation of his siege architecture!
The Ruling was not just paying for actions anymore; it was paying for the entire theatrical campaign!
|Descendant Mahishasura|:: VERITAS 41 / PROVENANCE 0 / POTENTIA 42 / PONDUS 43
Every attribute had crossed the threshold of forty, fueled entirely by the momentum of the crusade.
Noah felt the overwhelming density of the Descendant’s new standing, and he did not waste a single second of the narrative high.
Operating through Mahishasura, he raised one pale gold hand and pointed toward the distant, hazy silhouette of the next mountain in the inner ring.

"We march," Mahishasura commanded, his voice carrying the amplified, undeniable weight of The Leading Crusade. "We bring the order to the next peak. Anyone who resists is an enemy of stability itself!"
The Veiled Descendants moved in perfect unison, their figures snapping in the wind as they rallied behind their newly empowered vanguard.
And far behind this terrifying, righteous force, Noah rested his chin on his fist atop his throne of Sanguine Mana, directing the entire crusade from the absolute safety of the unseen!

chapters.title: Chapter 5637: Roles! II
paragraphs: <THE Creature>
Although the shaking of existence had paused the war for a brief moment, the violence in the unknown Dimension of black stone and burning skies was far from settled.

Two Primeval Ones circled THE Creature. They were vast, old, and bleeding, shimmering with hoarded authority, and entirely unaware that the foundation of their power had just rotted away beneath them!
In truth, existence had just undergone a violent restructuring.
When Vakochev’s Scales fractured across reality, the lineages of Descendants heard a booming voice delivering the new laws of THE Provenance of Existence. THE Creature heard nothing at all!
He did not need to hear a voice.

His Pantheon of All Existence was the surroundings themselves. When the physical and conceptual rules of the burning skies and black stone changed, the new grammar inscribed itself directly into his flesh and his Intent.

He felt the death of the old ladder. He felt the birth of Moirai. He understood instantly that existence was now weighing roles, measuring lives against Mantles, and preparing to fund those who played their parts perfectly!
The two Primeval Ones prepared to unleash their accumulated Ages of power. They still believed they were the apex of a static hierarchy!
THE Creature looked at them, his face a mask of cold obsidian flames threaded with white-gold.
"A true ruler does not float above the weight of his domain,"THE Creature spoke, his voice flat and unhurried, carrying the absolute density of inevitable payment.
"He places himself beneath it. He carries the cost of every life, every death, and every broken law. You have sat in the dark and hoarded authority without ever bearing its consequences."
He took a single step forward, and the black stone groaned.
"I am the one who carries," he continued, his tone devoid of any rising passion."I am the one who pays the cost. And I am the one who will dictate the order of what remains."
Existence listened!
Without a single visual notification or floating text as of now, a profound and heavy knowledge blossomed inside THE Creature’s mind.
Existence had weighed his life, his suffering, and his unyielding thesis of bearing, and it found him absolutely in accordance.
He felt an invisible, crushing weight of validation pour into his Pantheon!
He received the Mantle of THE RULER!

Pure Existential Moirai flooded his being. It did not arrive as a number he could read. It arrived as a localized destiny, a physical sensation of the surrounding Dimension actively lifting him up and bending its own probability to guarantee his success.
He was now one of THE ORDERED, and existence itself would lean to ensure his victory in this contest.
The Primeval Ones struck!

The black stone vanished in a blinding storm of dense golden Primordial Source and roaring blue Infinity. The two ancients poured the entirety of their hoarded Ages into a combined beam of annihilation meant to erase him from the Records entirely!
THE Creature did not dodge.
BOOM!
The annihilation beam struck the space inches from his chest and simply fractured, skipping off his aura like a thrown stone off a frozen lake.
The probability of their strike landing had been bent away by the Moirai of THE RULER. The Primeval Ones stared in absolute shock as their guaranteed execution failed to even singe his robes!
They did not understand the new Ruling. They did not know that authority was no longer enough!
They needed Roles!
THE Creature raised his hand.

THE MAW opened simultaneously in the burning sky, the obsidian floor, and the very air between the two Primevals. The invisible jaws clamped down on their flowing blue Infinity, devouring their attack and their Intent in a single, unhurried motion.
"Payment is due," THE Creature murmured.
THE Blank Caudal of the Unwritten Primeval whipped out from behind him wrapped with tendrils of THE Argent Loom.

The white-haired tail crossed the distance in a fraction of a nanosecond, carrying the amplified, undeniable weight of his new Mantle. It slammed into the chest of the first Primeval One with the force of countless collapsing Observable Existences!
CRACK!
The ancient lifeform folded perfectly in half, its Trueness rupturing outward as it was driven straight into the black stone floor.
The second Primeval One turned to flee, finally realizing that the rules of engagement had been entirely rewritten!
THE Creature extended his arm and applied THE Burden of Existence.
Every era of grief, every ounce of suffering he had ever carried, and every slaughtered life he had witnessed transferred instantly into the fleeing Primeval’s soul.
The ancient being screamed, its unblemished existence buckling under a weight it had never been trained to carry. It collapsed, crashing into the stone beside its broken companion.
THE Creature walked slowly toward them, his steps echoing in the sudden quiet of the burning domain.
He looked down at the two shattered ancients, their bodies trembling as they struggled to understand the insurmountable gap that had just opened between them.
He did not kill them. He had a use for their weight!
"Bend the knee," THE Creature commanded, his voice cold and final, "and you will be my first generals to form a grand Rule."

The two ancient beings, broken by the sheer disparity in standing, slowly pushed themselves up onto their trembling knees. They bowed their heads, shockingly pledging their very existences to the entity standing above them!
These were Primeval Ones, mind you!
Oh!

As their submission set into reality, two colossal, illusory statues carved of gray stone materialized within the borders of THE Creature’s existence. The Pantheon of All Existence was expanding its Hoard, turning their pledged weight into permanent fixtures of his domain.
THE Creature waved his hand.
"Rise."

Because his Dimensionality ran unfathomably deep due to the massive statue within him, he could perceive the white threads that stitched reality together and use them now. He reached into the unseen layer and commanded THE Argent Loom.

Brilliant white rivers of authority flowed from the surrounding Dimension directly into the shattered bodies of the two Primeval Ones, knitting their Trueness back together and reinforcing their broken frames with ancient density.
The two generals stood, their wounds bound by glowing white threads.
"Tell me everything you can regarding this Dimension," THE Creature instructed.

chapters.title: Chapter 5638: Roles! III
paragraphs: The two Primeval Ones looked at each other, the terror of their defeat still fresh in their glowing eyes. The larger of the two bowed its head respectfully.

"This is THE Vhelgaros," the General spoke, its voice carrying the heavy rumble of shifting tectonic plates. "It is a vast and ancient domain, filled with Primevals and True Lifeforms scattered across dozens of Observable Existences. But none of us rule it."

The second General continued, shivering slightly."A terrifyingly powerful Primeval One stands atop this Dimension. And worse, he is married to a Descendant of THE Immense Ones. Together, they hold an absolute monopoly."
THE Creature listened. A Primeval One claiming rulership simply by holding a Descendant’s hand, hoarding authority while demanding tribute from the lesser existences scattered below.
It was exactly the kind of unearned peace he despised.
"It seems... like the rulers of this Dimension need to change,"THE Creature said absentmindedly.
BOOM!

The instant the words left his mouth, existence seethed. The burning skies roared with a resonant frequency as cascading waves of pure Existential Moirai surged down, pouring directly into THE Creature’s body!
A flood of information blossomed in his mind. The Ruling had heard the declaration of THE RULER, and it was bending reality to accommodate his campaign.
The information came as behind THE Creature, the massive statue others couldn’t see smiled brutally as it translated the information into text!
|You have triggered a Narrative of Existence.|
|THE Narrative of Existence, The Grand Succession, has been triggered as you are one of the central Mantles.|

|The Grand Succession: A triggered external conflict to usurp a seated ruler through the sheer weight of bearing and territorial dominance. You have been deemed The Leading Conqueror. All Narrative Moirai flows around you, strengthening your existence and the generals behind you to guarantee the highest probability of a successful succession.|

|Existential Moirai begins to bud aggressively across THE Vhelgaros. If enough participants arise, and if the seated rulers are drawn into the contest, an interested gaze from one of THE Immense Ones may be drawn over. Leading participants will gain unfathomable Existential Moirai in return.|
THE Creature floated grandly above the black stone, his obsidian and white-gold flames expanding as he took all the information in!
He turned his masked face toward the two Generals standing beside him.
"Let us go gather more Generals so this Dimension can have its first Great Ruler."
WAA!
<Achilles Adrastia>
Although the quiet garden in THE Infinite Carcosa was meant to be a sanctuary, existence itself refused to remain still.
Achilles wrapped his arms tightly around Rose, feeling her tremble against his chest as her green hair fell in loose waves and the very light of the surroundings bent out of shape.
He felt the monumental changes through a bizarre, half-assimilated bridge in his soul.
Because one of the countless vessels of THE Sealed One was a Descendant, the booming serene feminine voice of the new Ruling echoed straight down the lineage and bled directly into Adrastia’s mind.
He learned of THE Provenance of Existence. He absorbed the sudden absolute laws of Mantles, of Ordination, and of the invisible currency known as Moirai!

Adrastia looked down at Rose, his thoughts cementing around his overwhelming desire to protect her and to secure his own identity. To ensure he remained himself, he knew he had to rely entirely on his own Trueness and his own expanding Dimensionality.
"I...will not be erased by the weight of an ancient ghost,"Adrastia spoke aloud, his voice steady and carrying the absolute certainty of his own survival.

"A man is not defined by the size of the ocean he drinks, but by the strength of the vessel that holds it. I assimilated a piece of a monster, and I am still standing. No matter how deep its Dimensionality runs, no matter how true its history claims to be, what truly matters is my own existence. I could assimilate the whole of existence itself, and I would still be Achilles Adrastia."
HUUM!
Existence buzzed with a deafening frequency in immediate response!

Because he outright refused to serve an imposed order and claimed a role purely for his own ends, cascading waves of invisible Moirai crashed into him, burning and flickering unstably as they recognized his defiance.
Crisp prompts bloomed across his vision, delivering the exact measure of his rebellion.
|You have taken a Mantle of THE WILLFUL.|
|You have claimed the Mantle of THE USURPER.|

|Due to being one of the first lifeforms to stand among THE WILLFUL, and possessing a unique connection to a Lifeform whose name is already etched in Narrative History (THE Sealed One), you have drawn the gaze of one of Those Who Remain.|
|THE Sealed One was among the first to be Ordained, bearing the Unique Ordination: The Zenith of Subjugation.|
|THE RAVENOUS ARCHITECT looks upon you with dark amusement. Support is granted to see how much you can devour before you break.|
BOOM!
A terrifying gaze landed heavily upon Adrastia, burning his entire existence as though he had stepped into a furnace!

Yet, instead of turning to ash, he felt his Dimensionality rapidly beginning to rise. He understood the mechanics immediately from the stolen memories of THE Sealed One, feeling his own existence gradually becoming more and more clear amidst the burning pressure.
But as his own standing deepened, he also felt the connected weavings of THE Sealed One shudder with unfathomable growth!
Far away, the monster was rising up tremendously in its own Dimensionality, benefiting from this new system of THE Provenance of Existence more than almost any other being.

Boundless Narrative Moirai surrounded THE Sealed One due to the heavy history it had established Ages ago and the conquests it was establishing now. Existence would heavily defer to the ancient terror, bending probability at every turn to help it achieve its aims!
Adrastia held Rose ever closer, his mind turning terrifyingly cold as he decided exactly what he had to do.

He was more closely connected with THE Sealed One than many others, having already successfully assimilated a portion of the being’s vessel. At this point, there was no room for doubt or fear. He would try to assimilate even more of this terrifying entity!
BOOM!
Moirai exploded around him, the unstable flames of THE WILLFUL flaring wildly as another prompt arrived.
|You have begun building a heavy Narrative Momentum. THE RAVENOUS ARCHITECT is delighted at this choice and watches on with high expectations.|
With shining eyes, he planned!

He turned his masked face toward the two Generals standing beside him.
"Let us go gather more Generals so this Dimension can have its first Great Ruler."
WAA!
<Achilles Adrastia>
Although the quiet garden in THE Infinite Carcosa was meant to be a sanctuary, existence itself refused to remain still.
Achilles wrapped his arms tightly around Rose, feeling her tremble against his chest as her green hair fell in loose waves and the very light of the surroundings bent out of shape.
He felt the monumental changes through a bizarre, half-assimilated bridge in his soul.
Because one of the countless vessels of THE Sealed One was a Descendant, the booming serene feminine voice of the new Ruling echoed straight down the lineage and bled directly into Adrastia’s mind.
He learned of THE Provenance of Existence.
He absorbed the sudden absolute laws of Mantles, of Ordination, and of the invisible currency known as Moirai!
Adrastia looked down at Rose, his thoughts cementing around his overwhelming desire to protect her and to secure his own identity.
To ensure he remained himself, he knew he had to rely entirely on his own Trueness and his own expanding Dimensionality.
"I...will not be erased by the weight of an ancient ghost,"Adrastia spoke aloud, his voice steady and carrying the absolute certainty of his own survival.
"A man is not defined by the size of the ocean he drinks, but by the strength of the vessel that holds it.
I assimilated a piece of a monster, and I am still standing.
No matter how deep its Dimensionality runs, no matter how true its history claims to be, what truly matters is my own existence.
I could assimilate the whole of existence itself, and I would still be Achilles Adrastia."
HUUM!
Existence buzzed with a deafening frequency in immediate response!

Because he outright refused to serve an imposed order and claimed a role purely for his own ends, cascading waves of invisible Moirai crashed into him, burning and flickering unstably as they recognized his defiance.
Crisp prompts bloomed across his vision, delivering the exact measure of his rebellion.
|You have taken a Mantle of THE WILLFUL.|
|You have claimed the Mantle of THE USURPER.|

|Due to being one of the first lifeforms to stand among THE WILLFUL, and possessing a unique connection to a Lifeform whose name is already etched in Narrative History (THE Sealed One), you have drawn the gaze of one of Those Who Remain.|
|THE Sealed One was among the first to be Ordained, bearing the Unique Ordination: The Zenith of Subjugation.|
|THE RAVENOUS ARCHITECT looks upon you with dark amusement.
Support is granted to see how much you can devour before you break.|
BOOM!
A terrifying gaze landed heavily upon Adrastia, burning his entire existence as though he had stepped into a furnace!
Yet, instead of turning to ash, he felt his Dimensionality rapidly beginning to rise.
He understood the mechanics immediately from the stolen memories of THE Sealed One, feeling his own existence gradually becoming more and more clear amidst the burning pressure.
But as his own standing deepened, he also felt the connected weavings of THE Sealed One shudder with unfathomable growth!
Far away, the monster was rising up tremendously in its own Dimensionality, benefiting from this new system of THE Provenance of Existence more than almost any other being.
Boundless Narrative Moirai surrounded THE Sealed One due to the heavy history it had established Ages ago and the conquests it was establishing now.
Existence would heavily defer to the ancient terror, bending probability at every turn to help it achieve its aims!
Adrastia held Rose ever closer, his mind turning terrifyingly cold as he decided exactly what he had to do.
He was more closely connected with THE Sealed One than many others, having already successfully assimilated a portion of the being’s vessel.
At this point, there was no room for doubt or fear.
He would try to assimilate even more of this terrifying entity!
BOOM!
Moirai exploded around him, the unstable flames of THE WILLFUL flaring wildly as another prompt arrived.
|You have begun building a heavy Narrative Momentum.
THE RAVENOUS ARCHITECT is delighted at this choice and watches on with high expectations.|
With shining eyes, he planned!

chapters.title: Chapter 5639: Ruling! I
paragraphs: <THE True Human Emperor>
Although the ongoings of existence had shattered every precedent, the quiet that followed inside THE Infiniverse was remarkably serene.

Noah floated silently atop the verdant blue-gold hills of his own domain. Far above him, the skies continued to bud and bloom with more and more Observable Existences, a cascading expansion that his people were granted access to open with the direct help of THE Infiniverse.

He looked out over the sprawling, nested realms, his vision piercing the boundaries of space to see the countless millions of humans, the exemplifiers, and his core party settling into their newly elevated stations.

In truth, a profound asymmetry hung between him and everyone else. While he was a Provenance Lifeform who generated his own standing, all of his people were not. They remained situated on the established weavings of existence, subject to the same frameworks and laws as all others.
Because of this, his people would inevitably be affected by THE Provenance of Existence. He had chosen to personally deny the new measure, refusing to kneel at a borrowed ladder!
Yet, he still needed to decide how he could utilize the way existence had violently changed to his own absolute advantage.

After all, Those Who Remain had just rewritten the rules so that roles and archetypes of existence were now the critical decider of power and standing. The imposition of Mantles meant that playing a part perfectly was now the heaviest currency in reality!
Noah considered his own history. He already possessed his own weavings of THE Protagonist. He had assigned many roles to himself long before this mandate ever arrived!

He even held the word PROTAGONIST locked firmly within his Osmontian Tongue. Operating under that absolute linguistic anchor was both THE Aura of THE Protagonist and THE Protagonist’s Omniscient Regard.
If Mantles and archetypes truly began acting as the heavy decider on the flow of existence, would he not be able to potentially bring the archetype of THE Protagonist to the forefront?
HUUM!
His entire existence buzzed at the thought alone!
This was a concept that was already his, generated from his own actions and his own identity, belonging to nobody else!
As he continued to turn the possibility over in his mind, he also knew he had to begin preparing heavy defensive measures.
The words and actions of Vakochev hung fresh in the air. The maker of the old Scales had explicitly warned that "they will come for you" before he retreated in defeat.

Furthermore, there was the obsidian crystal of unknown nature currently sitting silent and unmoving within Noah’s consciousness, left behind after Vakochev disappeared. There were lots of things to figure out but...

If Noah truly could bring forth THE Protagonist as a Mantle and force existence itself to support him, it would create an insurmountable bulwark. To have the sheer conceptual weight of THE Protagonist backed by the narrative weight of existence itself would allow him to weather whatever Those Who Remain sent his way!
Another piece of his vast arsenal clicked into place as there was also hisTrue Declarative Human Ruling.
It was a supreme authority granted by THE True Distinction of THE True Human Emperor, an asset he had carried but never found a proper use for, nor truly known what to do with.
And now, Those Who Remain had imposed a vast, overarching Ruling that was THE Provenance of Existence!
How astounding the symmetry of reality could be. It felt like many disparate pieces of his existence were suddenly clicking together!
He could now enact a grand vision with tools that had merely been waiting for the proper stage.

The thought alone filled him with an overwhelming immensity. He did not waste another second in contemplation. He instantly commanded his stellar blue Provenance Essence, letting his weavings ring out with absolute tyranny!
"Bring forth my weavings of the Protagonist as a Hidden Mantle," Noah commanded, his voice echoing across the verdant hills with the weight of an unbroken sovereign.

"I will finally utilize my True Declarative Human Ruling to usher in something that can interact with and benefit from THE Provenance of Existence, without ever being privy to Those Who Remain. A Mantle akin to a cheat in their own system, one that they do not know about. Generate them from the core of who I am, what I have been doing across existence, and what I am doing now."
WAA!
Existence answered him, not with the booming voice of an Immense One, but through the silent, generated authority of his own blood and will!

A cascade of grand and glorious prompts flooded his vision, detailing a grand ruling that stitched itself seamlessly into the fabric of reality while entirely bypassing the watchful eyes of the system’s architects.
|TRUE DECLARATIVE HUMAN RULING INITIATED.|

|Your unique weavings of THE Protagonist are being weaponized against the ambient laws of THE Provenance of Existence. You are bypassing the standard assignment of roles to carve your own definition into the Records of reality.|

|A Hidden Mantle is born. It is integrated into the flow of existence, yet utterly excluded from the gazes and attention of Those Who Remain. You will draw upon their established mechanics without ever registering on their ledgers.|

|Because you have lived as a Protagonist so truly, and because your very existence has always moved in perfect accordance with this role, you are not merely granted a Mantle. You gain your Ordination in this very instant.|
|ORDINATION ACHIEVED: THE Meta-Fictional Protagonist.|

|THE Meta-Fictional Protagonist: You are not merely an actor upon the stage of existence; you are the one who recognizes the script and holds the pen. Existence will aggressively defer to your narrative direction. You are granted the followinginitialgrand capabilities under this Ordination:|

|1. Narrative Override: You possess the capability to change the Narrative of any character who holds a Mantle into one that you choose. You may redefine an enemy’s role mid-battle, stripping them of their Moirai by forcing them into a script they cannot fulfill.|

|2. Existential Plot Armor: Any lethal strike, overarching curse, or sequence-ending event that does not align with the continuing story of THE Protagonist will be categorically refused by existence. Probability will bend to near absolute zero to ensure your narrative survives to its intended conclusion.|

|3. Scene Dictation: You may declare a localized region of space to be a closed narrative act. While this capability is active, all external interference, reinforcements, and ambient dimensional laws are nullified until THE Protagonist resolves the scene on his own terms.|
