chapters.title: Chapter 5640: Ruling! II
paragraphs: The sheer audacity of the prompts caused the air around Noah to grow heavy and dense!
He had taken the supreme measure of THE Immense Ones and generated his own name over the top of it, securing the benefits of their cruel currency without ever submitting to their authority!
BOOM!
The verdant hills shook violently as the physical manifestation of his new Ordination arrived.
Obsidian gold rivers of Osmontian Moirai surged into being from the empty air, roaring around him in a torrential, swirling storm of localized destiny.

Unlike the standard Existential Moirai that paid the obedient servants of the Pax, this Moirai belonged solely to him. It carried the dark, fiendish weight of his blood, completely superseding the normal rules of probability!
Noah stood at the center of the obsidian gold rivers, feeling the staggering upward pressure of a reality that was now actively conspiring to ensure his victory.
He breathed in the heavy, intoxicating current of his own generated destiny, his eyes glowing with quiet, unyielding dominance!
Although the obsidian gold rivers of his newly generated Osmontian Moirai had settled into a quiet, terrifying orbit around him, Noah did not let his momentum rest.
He remained suspended within the absolute clarity of his Reverie, floating atop the verdant hills of THE Infiniverse while the skies above him rippled with endless potential!

In truth, he was still dissecting the staggering capabilities granted by his Ordination as THE Meta-Fictional Protagonist. The prompt detailing Scene Dictation sat heavily at the forefront of his mind.

If he could declare a localized region of space to be a closed narrative act, nullifying all external interference and ambient dimensional laws until the scene resolved on his own terms, he possessed the ultimate absolute defense!
Of course, a scene required an ending. He needed a resolution condition so impossible, so unfathomably distant, that the scene would effectively never end until he explicitly chose to end it.
Noah looked up at the boundless skies of his domain.

"A true defense... is not a barrier of force. It is a boundary of script. If you want to keep the storm out, you do not build a higher roof. You simply write a play where the rain is not permitted to fall until the final act. I have the pen now. And I... am writing the walls."
WAA!
His tone dropped its warmth for flat, tyrannical certainty.

"I declare THE Infiniverse to be a closed narrative act. And this scene will only be resolved when THE Infiniverse obtains IT. The IT that THE Sealed One and all others seek will be the single, absolute condition that resolves this closed narrative!"
BOOM!
The response from existence was immediate and deafening!
A shockwave of pure narrative authority erupted from his fingertips, expanding outward at speeds that made light look entirely static!
The skies of THE Infiniverse did not physically alter their color, but a profound, unyielding conceptual lock clamped down over the entire Unique Transfinite Dimension.

The boundary of reality thickened noticeably. The rivers of Osmontian Moirai surged upward, weaving themselves into the very fabric of the space, turning the atmosphere heavy with the undeniable weight of an authored script!
Crisp, staggering prompts cascaded down his vision.
|SCENE DICTATION INITIATED.|
|THE Infiniverse has been declared a Closed Narrative Act.|
|Resolution Condition: The acquisition of IT by THE Infiniverse.|

|Effect: All external interference, hostile reinforcements, and ambient dimensional laws authored by Those Who Remain are categorically nullified. No authority, no Enforcer, and no Immense One may pierce this space or alter its internal logic until the Narrative Act reaches its stated resolution.|
Noah observed the flawless execution of his command, the sheer security of it filling his existence with a cold satisfaction!

The fortress was sealed tight against the prying eyes of ancient monstrosities. He felt an overwhelming urge to continue riding this soaring momentum, to fully capitalize on the sequence of unbroken victories he had carved out over the past hours.
After all, he had done a staggering amount of giving recently.
He had reached into the cursed lineages of Baelgrim, Sylvaine, Kharvel, and the others, granting them an impossible cure and absolute freedom from their ancient sentences.

He had forced the proudest Enforcers to kneel. He had even weaponized the new Ruling to gift a Narrative of Existence directly to Mahishasura, setting the Descendant as the lead actor in a grand epic of political crusade!
He had given grandly. And according to his Foundations, what he gave always returned to him grander.
"Release all the collected boons of THE Tide That Owes Nothing from my recent actions,"Noah declared into the quiet air.

He already knew exactly what he wanted the prizes to be. With the sheer volume of his people currently settling into their new power across his domain, he needed more space, more realms, and more structural foundation. His intention for the collected boons was entirely focused on THE Genesis Tesseracts, because with more Tesseracts, more Observable Existences could bloom within his protection!
The stellar blue-gold light of his Provenance Essence flared as the Tide answered his call, calculating the sheer weight of his recent salvation and conquest.
|THE Tide That Owes Nothing recognizes the salvation of ancient Descendants, the upending of established mountain fiefs, and the genesis of a grand Narrative of Existence among many acts of giving.|
|Calculated Boon Yield: 4,000 Genesis Tesseracts.|
|Wait. Anomaly detected within your Ordination.|
Noah narrowed his eyes slightly as the prompts flickered, shifting from the standard gold of the Tide to the dark, obsidian-gold hue of his Osmontian Moirai.
|Your Hidden Mantle of THE Meta-Fictional Protagonist has inherently triggered the Narrative Archetype of EXISTENCE BLESSED.|

|EXISTENCE BLESSED: Existence itself actively conspires in THE Protagonist’s favor. Natural disasters happen at the exact moment you need a distraction. Rare opportunities drop directly into your lap without effort. Lethal attacks miraculously miss your vitals by a hair’s breadth. Existence bends to ensure your continued rise.|
|For you, the boon of the Tide has been tripled.|
|12,000 Genesis Tesseracts have been brought to fruition.|
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5641: Ruling! III
paragraphs: The heavens above THE Infiniverse shattered into a display of unfathomable, dazzling beauty!
Twelve thousand hypercubes of deep blue-white light bloomed into existence simultaneously, hanging against the skies!
They spun slowly, humming with the raw, unshaped potential of entire Observable Existences waiting to be unpacked.
The sheer density of the gathered Tesseracts cast a brilliant, oscillating glow over the verdant hills, illuminating Noah’s face as he looked up at the staggering harvest!
It was a level of wealth that defied all logic, paid out by an Existence that was now mechanically forced to favor him!
As Noah watched the hypercubes drift in their majestic, silent orbit, the space beside him rippled gently.

Thalia Vasiliou stepped onto the grass, her white-blue robes shifting in the wind. She did not look at the magnificent display of Tesseracts right away. Instead, she looked at Noah, her expression clouded with a heavy, troubled weight.
She looked around at their surroundings, taking in the suffocating security of the Scene Dictation and the dazzling lights above, before she finally spoke.
"The Ruling of THE Provenance of Existence... was not supposed to be enacted until much later," Thalia said, her voice quiet but strained.
"In the future, you mentioned something to me about Vakochev right before everything came down. Did Vakochev reach out to you already? Because even that was supposed to happen much later."
Noah turned his gaze away from the blooming stars to look at the dazzling woman beside him.
His endlessly blue eyes shone brightly as he listened to her words.
They held terrifyingly heavy implications!

If THE Provenance of Existence was not supposed to come down right now, it meant Vakochev was not supposed to have lost his war so early. The maker of the Scales had retreated prematurely, triggering the Immense Ones to impose their new order long before the timeline dictated they should.
Why would things be playing out differently?

Noah evaluated the variables with cold precision. Did any of this have anything to do with his own aggressive actions across THE Krazhor-Nul and THE Ymnaros? Or did it stem from Thalia herself coming back across Dimensions and Time?
His recent movements against Those Who Remain could not have possibly triggered things to start playing out differently, right?
The past could not be changed. The loops of existence were closed, meaning everything that was happening now was exactly as it was always supposed to happen.
Yet, her clouded expression told a different story. If the loop was closed, why was she surprised by the timing?
Noah considered the paradox silently.
Existence was a script. If his actions were rewriting the timeline in real time, then the rules of causality she relied on were already breaking under his weight!
And if the rules were broken, then the future she was trying to prevent was no longer the future they were walking into.
Nothing was set in stone!
What she knew could or could not happen!
<THE Infinity Eater>
Existence is terribly fond of the illusion of freedom!
Terribly!
But the truth of any harvest is that someone always owns the field.

Many ancient beings believed they were the masters of their own domains. They cultivated boundless blue Infinity, climbed Vakochev’s Scales, and raised grand citadels across the observable and unobservable realms. In truth, they were merely crops left to fatten in the sun!
THE PAX existed to prune the weeds that grew too tall and disrupted the soil.THE Infinity Eater existed to reap the harvest when the season finally ended.

He sat in the center of a dying Dimension. It was a hollowed-out realm of gray dust and silent, hovering structures. Rivers of pure blue Infinity flowed continuously into his pale, elongated form, drawn from thr countless decillions of True Lifeforms scattered across adjacent Dimensions.
He did not look like a monster. He looked like a weary scholar draped in immaculate white robes, his eyes solid blue spheres without pupils.

He looked up at the tearing sky. Above him, the boundary of the Dimension was folded backward, revealing an eye that spanned the entire horizon. It was a presence that crushed the very concept of depth. It was one of THE Immense Ones.
"The new Ruling is remarkably loud,"THE Infinity Eater spoke. His voice was smooth and polite, carrying the precise annoyance of an accountant finding an error in the Records.

"You have handed Mantles to the absolute dregs of reality. You are paying them in Moirai for playing out their little roles. Why flood the market with currency when the old system kept them so predictably obedient? Vakochev was actually not so bad."
The eye above did not blink. A serene, feminine voice resonated directly within the structure of his existence, carrying the weight of ancient architecture.

"A river that never floods leaves the soil to turn to dust."Her voice sounded like grinding tectonic plates softened by velvet. "The water must be allowed to rise so that we may see what knows how to swim."
"It is inefficient," THE Infinity Eater countered. He raised a pale hand, observing the golden sign of his own Mantle rotating slowly above his palm. It was the shape of a curved scythe.
He had been weighed and Ordained in the very first nanosecond the Ruling descended. He held the Mantle of THE HARVESTER.

It was a role he had played for Ages, perfectly in accordance with the design of Those Who Remain. Existential Moirai flooded him constantly, a localized destiny ensuring that whatever he sought to consume would inevitably fall into his mouth.

"I have farmed these Dimensions for you since the earliest epochs," he continued."I let them build their Egos and their True bodies. Then I drink their Existence ever so slowly and send the yield upward. This new Provenance of Existence gives them hope in these roles. It gives them the illusion that they can author their own standing. Hope is a notoriously difficult crop to manage."

"Hope is not a crop,"the serene voice answered, shifting the pressure in the gray air. "Hope is the plow. It turns the earth. It makes the roots dig deeper. When the roots are deep, the fruit is heavy."
THE Infinity Eater frowned. The answers of THE Immense Ones were never truly answers. They were simply pronouncements of weather from beings who lived above the clouds!
He knew better than to ask for a plain explanation. He merely needed to ensure his own quota remained undisturbed.
"As long as my fields are protected, you may play whatever games you wish with their Existence," he said calmly.

He closed his solid blue eyes and reached out through his unfathomable senses, checking the intake valves of his vast, invisible network. He monitored the deep, hidden tethers that connected him to the countless decillions of Lifeforms across all Dimensions he had his network.
He expected the familiar, rushing torrent of blue Infinity.
He felt...less.
THE Infinity Eater opened his eyes. The serene composure broke for a fraction of a second, revealing the terrifying, endless void beneath his pale skin.
He checked the invisible tethers again. The lifeforms were still there. They were still drawing on a wellspring of power, still generating massive amounts of weavings of existence.
But the source they were drawing from was no longer him. It was no longer a current he owned!
Someone had seamlessly slid beneath his architecture. Someone had replaced his water with their own, turning his entire crop into dependents of a new, unknown wellspring!
"The fruit is suddenly growing on someone else’s tree," THE Infinity Eater murmured.
He looked back up at the colossal eye spanning the broken sky.
"Did you authorize another collector in the eastern Dimensions?" he asked.
"The wind blows where the pressure drops," the feminine voice replied softly. "If a house falls, it is because the wood was ready to break."
THE Infinity Eater let out a slow, cold sigh. These monstrous beings never gave straight answers!
He stood up. The gray dust around him swirled into a violent vortex as the immense pressure of his Dimensionality flared outward. The scythe of his Mantle pulsed with demanding, hungry gold light.
"I am THE HARVESTER," THE Infinity Eater declared. His polite tone completely vanished, replaced by the sheer, absolute gravity of a predator whose territory had been breached.
"And I have to go find out who is stealing from my farm of lifeforms and replacing me as the source."
The colossal eye above slowly faded into the dark, offering no blessing and no warning.
THE Infinity Eater stepped forward and vanished into the crossing, leaving the hollow Dimension to quietly collapse behind him.

Twelve thousand hypercubes of deep blue-white light bloomed into existence simultaneously, hanging against the skies!
They spun slowly, humming with the raw, unshaped potential of entire Observable Existences waiting to be unpacked.
The sheer density of the gathered Tesseracts cast a brilliant, oscillating glow over the verdant hills, illuminating Noah’s face as he looked up at the staggering harvest!
It was a level of wealth that defied all logic, paid out by an Existence that was now mechanically forced to favor him!
As Noah watched the hypercubes drift in their majestic, silent orbit, the space beside him rippled gently.
Thalia Vasiliou stepped onto the grass, her white-blue robes shifting in the wind.
She did not look at the magnificent display of Tesseracts right away.
Instead, she looked at Noah, her expression clouded with a heavy, troubled weight.
She looked around at their surroundings, taking in the suffocating security of the Scene Dictation and the dazzling lights above, before she finally spoke.
"The Ruling of THE Provenance of Existence... was not supposed to be enacted until much later," Thalia said, her voice quiet but strained.
"In the future, you mentioned something to me about Vakochev right before everything came down.
Did Vakochev reach out to you already?
Because even that was supposed to happen much later."
Noah turned his gaze away from the blooming stars to look at the dazzling woman beside him.
His endlessly blue eyes shone brightly as he listened to her words.
They held terrifyingly heavy implications!
If THE Provenance of Existence was not supposed to come down right now, it meant Vakochev was not supposed to have lost his war so early.
The maker of the Scales had retreated prematurely, triggering the Immense Ones to impose their new order long before the timeline dictated they should.
Why would things be playing out differently?
Noah evaluated the variables with cold precision.

His recent movements against Those Who Remain could not have possibly triggered things to start playing out differently, right?
The past could not be changed.
The loops of existence were closed, meaning everything that was happening now was exactly as it was always supposed to happen.

If the loop was closed, why was she surprised by the timing?

chapters.title: Chapter 5642: Power!
paragraphs: <Descendant Alcaeus>
A great number of lifeforms believe peace is the ultimate reward of a long life.
They would be ridiculously wrong.
The truth of any cage of peace is that eventually, the prisoner will beg for a war.
For those who lived across the deepest expanses of reality, stagnation was the only true death.

They climbed through the tiers of existence, gathered their authority, and built their citadels. Yet, when a being possesses the lifespan of an entire epoch, the quiet becomes an unbearable weight. To answer this endless boredom, certain Dimensions were authored exclusively for the harvest of violence.
THE Morior Dimension was one such place.

It was a vast, blood-soaked arena where the progeny of the highest authorities went to prove the weight of their lineages. Deaths that occurred upon its rusted soil were not recorded in the Records as permanent endings. The Dimension itself was a miraculous testing ground where shattered flesh and spilled Trueness were simply collected and remade, allowing the strong to fight without the inconvenient finality of a true death. It was a slaughterhouse that functioned as a stage.
In the center of a jagged canyon, Descendant Alcaeus stood like a monument to absolute brutality.

He was a colossal, muscular titan draped in the thick, golden pelt of a slaughtered Primeval beast. His skin was scarred bronze, and his eyes burned with a terrifying, unyielding joy. He did not care for politics or anything else. He cared only for the glory of battle!
Of course, the rules of his favored game had recently changed.

When Vakochev’s Scales fractured across reality, THE Provenance of Existence had descended. Alcaeus had not questioned the booming, serene voice that spoke into his lineage. He had simply proclaimed his life of violence loudly to the empty air. Existence had weighed his endless battles, measured his absolute devotion to conflict, and found him perfectly in accordance.
A golden sign shaped like a roaring lion’s visage hovered above his head. He was Ordained.He held the Mantle of THE CHAMPION.

Because of his staggering accumulation of victories, he had already triggered a Narrative of Existence.The information that resonated in his mind called it THE Endless Crucible. It was a triggered external conflict that paid him for every drop of blood he spilled. He did not need to retreat to a quiet peak to cultivate his power. He simply needed to fight, and the Ruling would fund his rise.
Existential Moirai surrounded him in a thick, golden aura. It acted as a localized destiny, actively lifting him up and bending probability to ensure his continued survival in the canyon.
He was not fighting alone.
Far above the rusted cliffs, the sky was not a sky at all. Three massive eyes hovered in the purple firmament, unblinking and terribly ancient!
They were three of THE Immense Ones, looking down to observe the proving grounds of their children. They watched the bloodsport in total silence, their mere presence crushing the air below.
"Come on!"Alcaeus roared, his voice shaking the canyon walls. "Is this all the depth you can muster?!"
Hundreds of other Descendants charged him from all sides. They carried massive weapons and roared with THE Argent Loom!
Alcaeus laughed joyfully.
He did not draw a blade. His Dimensionality ran terrifyingly deep. He understood that true power was not about how hard a thing could push, but where a thing truly stood!
He reached his massive hands up and physically grabbed the white threads of THE Argent Loom that stitched the air together.

Alcaeus grabbed the threads and pulled them down into his palms by brute force. He mixed the pristine white authority of The Argent Loom with his own roaring, bronze-colored power, and then flooded the mixture with the heavy golden Moirai granted by his Mantle.
He pressed his massive hands together.
The sheer, unfathomable PONDUS required to compress such authorities was staggering, but his muscles merely bulged as he forced the mixture to collapse inward!
The threads, the power, and the destiny condensed into a sphere no larger than a fist. It was a small, screaming, condensed dimension of pure kinetic force.
He formed a miniature Dimension with his own hands!
Alcaeus threw the compressed dimension directly into the charging army.
BOOM!

The miniature thing expanded instantly upon impact. It swallowed fifty Descendants in a localized singularity of white light and crushing pressure. Armor shattered. Weapons turned to dust. The roaring of his enemies was simply snuffed out as their bodies were unmade and swept out of the arena to be reconstructed later.
The survivors leaped through the settling dust, their power aimed at his neck and chest.
Alcaeus moved into the fray.
A spear of THE Argent Loom thrust toward his throat. Existence leaned. The Moirai of THE CHAMPION bent the probability of the strike away, causing the spear to glide harmlessly past his skin!

He caught a falling sword of THE Argent Loom with his bare hand, the blade biting into his palm. He squeezed his fist, shattering the weapon into fragments, and punched the owner so hard the air itself screamed.
He threw another compressed dimension!
BOOM!

The battlefield became a canvas of absolute destruction. For an hour, the canyon shook with the sounds of unmaking. Alcaeus fought with the chaotic, unyielding rhythm of a being who knew he could not lose. He did not fight to survive. He fought because fighting was the only language he truly understood.
When the dust finally settled, Alcaeus stood alone in the center of the crater.

The corpses of hundreds of defeated Descendants remained scattered across the broken ground, waiting for the Dimension’s laws to pull them back into the cycle. Those few who had survived in the periphery had already turned and run, their morale broken by the sheer, insurmountable depth of THE CHAMPION!
Alcaeus threw his head back and roared his triumph to the empty sky!
OOOOH!

The response from the new Ruling was immediate and staggering. Moirai gushed down from the heavens like a golden sea, pouring directly into his body. The sheer volume of the reward washed over his attributes, feeding his existence and solidifying his Mantle even further. He felt the heavy, intoxicating rush of am Existence that was actively paying him for his violence.
As he stood basking in the golden downpour, the sky changed.
One of the three massive eyes above him suddenly pulsed. It was a bloodshot, terrifying gaze that represented THE SLEEPLESS FIEND.
The atmosphere in the canyon dropped to an absolute, freezing silence. The other two eyes slowly drifted backward, allowing the Fiend’s gaze to dominate the firmament.
Alcaeus stopped laughing. He fell to one knee, bowing his head in sudden, total reverence.

The message did not arrive as a sound. It bypassed his ears completely and burned directly into the obsidian brow-mark on his forehead. It carried the impersonal, heavy weight of a Father addressing a useful tool.
|Something has grown bold enough to rewrite my curses.|
Alcaeus grimaced as the sheer density of the thought pressed into his skull.
|It has passed through THE Krazhor-Nul Dimension and THE Ymnaros Dimension. A Cure-Giver.|
The image of a broken curse, of Steeds running unchained, and of lines of writing being forcibly altered flickered through his mind. The Fiend was searching for the source of an impossible rebellion.
|Find it for me and ask it for me... what made it so bold?|
HUUM!
The burning sensation in his brow slowly faded. The massive eye in the sky stopped pulsing and drifted back into its silent, unblinking watch alongside the others.
Alcaeus remained kneeling for a long moment, the dust settling silently around him. He processed the weight of the command. A hunt!
A target that had somehow managed to undo the authored punishments of Those Who Remain. A being that operated across THE Krazhor-Nul and THE Ymnaros.
He looked up at the sky as a wide, terrifying grin spread across his face.

He laughed joyfully, the sound echoing through the canyon of corpses. He did not care about the politics of curses, or the implications of a broken sentence. He only cared that a target capable of such impossible feats would undoubtedly provide the greatest battle of his entire immortal life.
"As THE SLEEPLESS FIEND deems,"Alcaeus said.
Oh!
Existence was vast and filled with terrors.
One couldn’t even begin to imagine just what terrifying wonders were out there that they didn’t even know about!

chapters.title: Chapter 5643: A Thousand Origins
paragraphs: <A Thousand Origins>
What could not be perceived by the vast majority was always the most pristine.
Down in the mud of the lower frameworks, authority was loud. Egos clashed against each other in open displays of light and force.
Dimensions bled. Observable Existences were shattered to prove a point.Up in the terrifying depths of true Dimensionality, existence was a perfectly still lake!
To stand at the absolute summit of reality was not to shout. It was to become a ghost to everything beneath you.

In fact, there existed domains so deeply seated in the unseen layers of reality that even strong True Lifeforms and ancient Primeval Lifeforms could not perceive them. If a Cenozoic or Mesozoic master somehow managed to fly through the coordinates of such a place, they would see only empty space and silent dark.
THE Concord of a Thousand Origins was exactly one of these places.
It was a vast, staggering architecture that defied every natural law of existence!

Exactly one thousand individual Dimensions were clustered together into a single, breathtaking metropolis. They were bound to one another by colossal, physical bridges woven from pure white threads of THE Argent Loom.
From a distance, it looked like a Dimensional reef.
An axis Dimension of pure, shining purple gold sat at the center, acting as the anchor. Bolted onto its edges were realms of entirely different natures.

A Dimension consisting entirely of endless blue oceans was grafted directly into a Dimension of burning black obsidian. A realm of floating crystal towers fed seamlessly into a sprawling jungle of petrified wood.
Of course, a city built of a thousand Dimensions did not house peasants.
The thoroughfares of THE Concord of a Thousand Origins were filled with the absolute apex of Existence!

Colossal Primeval Lifeforms pulled massive barges of tribute across the void between realms. Ancient True Lifeforms traded the fates of lower Observable Existences as casually as mortals traded coins.
Most importantly, it was the supreme gathering place for the children of the architects. Descendants of every conceivable lineage mingled, schemed, and operated across the sprawling bridges.

This place was the original forge. It was known in hushed rumors as one of the primary locations where many Descendants were engineered, stitched together, and born in the earliest epochs. It was a sprawling laboratory of authority, acting as one of the few places in all of reality where Those Who Remain could actually be reached!
To step foot in a place like this was to have won in existence.

Since the fracture of Vakochev’s Scales and the descent of the new Ruling, THE Concord of a Thousand Origins had become a blinding storm of fate and destiny. Because it was heavily populated by the highest concentration of the Ordained, complex and grand Narratives of Existence had begun to bloom in every sector.
Existential Moirai poured down from the space in localized systems.Above the crowds, golden shields, white swords, and travelers’ staves hovered proudly over the heads of the most devoted actors.

Rival lineages fought proxy wars of succession. Grand crusades were funded by the very air they breathed. The entire cluster of a thousand Dimensions was vibrating with the euphoria of a place that was finally paying its rulers for their cruelty!
Despite the sheer, suffocating density of authority crowding the white bridges, some of the true apex of the Concord was entirely ignored.

In a bustling central region, a dazzling woman walked through a courtyard surrounded by towering Descendants. She moved with absolute, gliding silence. Her white-blue robes shifted gently in the ambient wind.
She was followed closely by a second woman.
The follower wore plain, unadorned gray garments. She radiated absolutely no power. She carried no Intent, no roaring blue Infinity, and no trace of THE Primordial Source or Argent Loom!

Yet, she held a terrifying pressure that physically warped the air inches from her skin. The sheer weight of her bearing was so immense that if she allowed even a fraction of it to express itself, the courtyard of Descendants would have been flattened into paste.
The Descendants around them did not even know they were there!

A colossal, bronze-skinned Descendant wearing the Mantle of THE TYRANT stepped directly into the path of the two women. He did not bump into them. He simply passed right through the space they occupied, completely unaware that he had just walked through the projected shadows of two beings whose depth made him look like a drawing on a piece of paper.
The Dimensionality of these women was that high!
Because they generated their own standing and did not rely on the ladders built by Those Who Remain, their power rendered them absolute ghosts in the most crowded room in existence.

Queenling Thalia!

Her striking, freckled face and deep red hair were exposed to a crowd of ancient monsters who could not perceive a single detail of her beauty!
She looked around the courtyard, taking in the golden signs hovering above the Ordained and the heavy, intoxicating smell of Moirai in the air.
She raised her hand to eye level.

Her pale skin was flickering. The edges of her fingers blurred in and out of existence, vibrating violently as if the hand was attempting to disappear. It looked as though her physical form was trying to merge with another version of her that absolutely should not be here!
Moving across Dimensions and Time carried an unfathomable cost. The rules of causality did not appreciate a closed loop being pried open!
The paradox of her presence was beginning to exact its toll, fraying the very edges of her Provenance.
Thalia looked at her flickering hand with complete, composed indifference.

"I have to talk to one of Those Who Remain in this place who owes us a favor,"Thalia said smoothly, her voice betraying none of the physical degradation she was enduring. "He can answer some of my questions regarding Vakochev and THE Provenance of Existence."
Two Provenance Lifeforms had appeared in this place.

It was not the first time such an impossible event had occurred in the deep history of existence, but it was certainly not something that happened openly. The sheer audacity of walking into the very forge where Those Who Remain engineered their children was a testament to the absolute grandness of their standing!

Vakochev had retreated too early. The new Ruling had descended long before the timeline dictated it should. The events she had traveled back to prevent were suddenly rushing forward, reacting to an existence that refused to play by the established script.
She needed to know why the timeline was breaking. She needed to know what the architects were rushing to prepare for.
Her aim here was a singular one!
Thalia lowered her flickering hand and moved forward, walking straight through the illusions of the mighty!

When an existence possesses the authority to rewrite reality and fears absolutely nothing, its appetites do not diminish as they actually inflate. The architects of existence, Those Who Remain, did not sit in quiet contemplation of Existence. They indulged!
They treated lower Dimensions like personal vineyards and ancient Primeval Lifeforms like disposable playthings, engineering lineages of Descendants out of sheer boredom and base desire.
Thalia Vasiliou walked through the deeper sectors of THE Concord of a Thousand Origins, her expression composed perfectly over a rising disgust.

She and her gray-robed escort passed through bridging Dimensions that showcased the absolute debauchery of the architects. They walked over a realm consisting entirely of oceans of wine where colossal Primeval Lifeforms drowned themselves for sport. They bypassed a floating continent where generations of Descendants were bred and discarded in endless, violent revelry.
Eventually, the dazzling lights of the Concord faded. Thalia arrived at the edge of a Dimension composed of pure, suffocating darkness.

In the center of the black expanse sat a towering temple of jagged obsidian. The grounds outside the temple were packed with thousands of kneeling Descendants. They pressed their knees against the cold stone, their bodies trembling in absolute reverence toward the open doors.
Thalia did not kneel as she walked straight through the kneeling masses, her white-blue robes cutting a pristine path through the dark, her escort following silently behind her.
They entered the temple.

The air inside was so dense it felt like walking through solid earth. There were no walls and no ceilings, only a central dais that defied all optical logic. Thalia stared directly into the center of the temple and saw what looked like countless event horizons stacked on top of one another!
The overlapping singularities leaked an air of terrible, suffocating power that warped the very concept of distance.
A voice echoed out from the stacked event horizons. It sounded wet, heavy, and slithering with ancient amusement.
"A Provenance Lifeform steps into my domain without an invitation."The voice pressed against the stone floor, forcing the ambient darkness to ripple.
"It is a rare thing for one of your kind to dare to come see one of THE Immense Ones unplanned."
Thalia stood perfectly straight. She did not let a single ounce of pressure force her gaze downward.

"You have worked with my Father before,"Thalia spoke, her voice ringing clear and cold through the suffocating temple. "I can do something as simple as seeking an audience. On behalf of my Provenance Lineage, I came to call upon the favor granted by THE SECRETIVE DEFILER ages ago."
HUUM!
The event horizons spun faster, grinding against one another as the being inside listened.
"I seek to know of the conflict involving Vakochev," Thalia continued, her tone completely devoid of fear.

"Nobody heard any musings of the battle that was supposed to occur. Nor did anyone predict the premature descent of the Ruling of THE Provenance of Existence, which was only a rumor for all of us until it happened. I seek to know what happened."
The darkness inside the temple deepened.

The stacks of event horizons began to part. THE Immense One materialized from the crushing gravity, forming into a hazy, colossal humanoid outline. Two massive obsidian horns curved upward from its shifting head!
The face held no distinct features, save for two eyes burning with a sickening, absolute power that devoured the light around them.
THE SECRETIVE DEFILER gazed down at Thalia’s pristine figure. The burning eyes dragged slowly over her white-blue robes, lingering with a heavy, unmistakable hunger.
"Vakochev simply could not measure up to the Narrative he sought to take down,"THE SECRETIVE DEFILER rumbled, his voice dripping with base desire.
"And the new Ruling fell. You wish to know the mechanics of all this...?"
The hazy, horned giant leaned forward.
"I will tell you everything I can regarding what happened," THE SECRETIVE DEFILER said, a cruel amusement lacing his words.

"Because things definitely got interesting. But knowledge of this depth requires a toll, little Queenling. Present yourself to me as a gift. Be given the honor to lay with me for a thousand years, and breed to produce at least a hundred Descendants for my halls. Do this, and you will have your answers."
A wave of absolute, freezing cold washed over the obsidian temple!

The gray-robed escort standing behind Thalia did not speak, but the terrifying pressure radiating from her frame spiked. The ambient darkness of the temple buzzed under the sheer weight of the escort’s anger, the stone floor spiderwebbing with hairline cracks beneath her plain shoes!
HUUM!
Thalia looked up at the hazy, horned outline of the ancient architect. Her freckled face was a mask of pure, absolute distaste.
"I would rather unmake my own Provenance and scatter my essence into the void."Thalia declared, her voice carrying the unyielding frost of an absolute sovereign!
And THE Immense One laughed as if he found this profoundly entertaining!
"Keep your secrets. I will find the truth from something that does not crawl in the mud."
She did not wait for a dismissal. Thalia turned on her heel, her white-blue robes sweeping over the fractured stone as she and her escort walked toward the exit.
THE SECRETIVE DEFILER did not strike her. He simply watched her go, his burning eyes narrowing with a cold, predatory amusement.
"Walk away, Queenling," THE SECRETIVE DEFILER boomed. "But do not forget that Provenance Lifeforms do not sit above THE Immense Ones. Do not forget who needs to suckle at the feet of whom."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5644: The Arbiter!
paragraphs: <The Arbiter>
The new ruling imposed by Those Who Remain was presented as a measure of stability.
It was, and yet any sudden freedom will simply removes the mask many wore before.
The Provenance of Existence did not merely grant people power as it allowed them to be exactly who they truly were and amplified it, regardless of how ugly that truth happened to be.
For the Arbiter of THE Serenaros Dimension, the truth was exceptionally ugly.

He stood as the leading figure of THE PAX across the entire Dimension. He held Mahishasura and many other Enforcers beneath his command. Yet, his private reality was far removed from the cold bureaucracy of the Shrouds!
For a while, he had maintained a habit of silently causing entire sections of locked-up Inhibited Lifeforms to disappear from the vast cage-fields.
He took them into his own sealed Pocket Dimension and devoured them.

He did not eat them like a beast. He crushed the physical bodies and the very existences of Inhibited True Lifeforms and Primeval Lifeforms into a fine, sparkling powder. He then snorted this powder directly through his nose!

In fact, his Intent was specifically shaped to transform the pulverized existence directly into his nerve receptors, allowing him to feel the condensed terror, power, and final emotions of the ground-up lifeforms all at once.
It gave him an unfathomable high. He was, fundamentally, an existential addict.

Since THE Provenance of Existence came down, he had been increasing the number of lifeforms he ground to dust. He had loudly claimed his vile habits and received a Willful Mantle. He was THE DECADENT!
The euphoria he received from the new currency was immense, and his power was rising up faster than it had in an entire Age.

Inside his private Dimension, the Arbiter stood over a struggling cluster of Gilded True Lifeforms. They were stripped of all authority, their Egos screaming as his crushing Intent wrapped around them.
CRACK!
The Gilded Lifeforms shattered. Their brilliant Trueness and their lingering blue Infinity were pulverized instantly, turning into a line of stellar white dust suspended in the air.
The Arbiter leaned forward and inhaled sharply.
HUUM!

The white dust rushed into his system. The pristine white threads of THE Argent Loom mixed with his Intent and his faint Pantheon, causing his entire body to seize and vibrate. His eyes rolled back into his head as he tweaked with absolute, unadulterated euphoria!

At exactly that moment, a dark-haired Descendant Enforcer stepped into the domain. She looked at the tweaking, shivering leader of her Dimension and kept her gaze perfectly straight, acting exactly as if she saw nothing unusual.

"Arbiter," the Enforcer addressed him smoothly. "Mahishasura seems to have taken the emergence of THE Provenance of Existence too literally. He is currently taking all other Enforcers under his banner. He seems to have received a terrifyingly strong Mantle, as the surrounding existence is heavily supporting him. What shall we do? More than half of all Enforcers within this Dimension now follow behind him like a unified force."
The Arbiter breathed in sharply, a harsh rattling sound echoing in his throat. He blinked his bloodshot eyes rapidly, his pupils dilated to the size of coins.

"Gather all the Enforcers remaining under me,"the Arbiter voiced out, his words rushing together in a frantic, manic rhythm."I didn’t expect rebellion within our own home! Other Arbiters of THE PAX don’t have to worry about this shit. But... haha!"
A wide, terrifying grin stretched across his face, exposing teeth stained with Existential dust.

"I can use this conflict as an excuse to grind down more and more Inhibited Lifeforms! If more than half of the Inhibited we hold were to suddenly disappear... nothing much would change in the Records during such chaotic times! Haha, let’s go! I actually need to thank Mahishasura for bringing this conflict to my door. Gather all those remaining!"
The dark-haired Enforcer bowed and stepped back, leaving the madman to his devices.
The moment she left, the Arbiter waved his hand frantically.
Dozens of massive metal prisons materialized in the air, filled with hundreds of defenseless True Lifeforms. The captives looked out in absolute terror at the tweaking giant.
The Arbiter did not hesitate as his Intent shot out like a collapsing Dimension, pulverizing the defenseless beings in a single, deafening crunch! They screamed, and then they were dust.

He snorted what their existence used to be with utter euphoria, his body violently shaking as he exhibited the base, desperate behaviors of an addict while simultaneously wielding the unfathomable power of a dimensional ruler. It was a horrible, grotesque combination!
As he consumed the harvest, the atmosphere of his pocket Dimension buzzed.
A flood of information erupted down his vision. He had triggered a Narrative of Existence!
|You have triggered a Narrative of Existence.|
|THE Narrative of Existence, The Hedonist’s Defense, has been triggered as you are one of the central Willful Mantles.|

|The Hedonist’s Defense: A triggered Willful Narrative centered on standing true to your ideals, your greed, and your absolute lust for existence’s highest pleasures. Those who seek to usurp your domain and take your harvest are your greatest enemies.|

|The more lifeforms you burn and pulverize while carrying out this narrative, and the more violently you clash against the incoming crusade, the more Existential Moirai will be generated for your Mantle.|
The Arbiter threw his head back and laughed. But the Ruling was not finished paying him!
Even more information cascaded down, carrying a suffocating, heavy weight that made the hairs on his arms stand up!
|One of THE Immense Ones is interested in your Narrative.|
|THE ECSTATIC FLAYER has begun to observe your movements.|
|If you put on a good show of pleasure and death, you will be granted even more power.|

The Arbiter stared at the final waves of information, his chest heaving as the ultimate high washed over him. The architects of existence themselves were watching his binge, and they were bringing more powder!
More! More! MORE!

|You have triggered a Narrative of Existence.|
|THE Narrative of Existence, The Hedonist’s Defense, has been triggered as you are one of the central Willful Mantles.|
|The Hedonist’s Defense: A triggered Willful Narrative centered on standing true to your ideals, your greed, and your absolute lust for existence’s highest pleasures.
Those who seek to usurp your domain and take your harvest are your greatest enemies.|

|The more lifeforms you burn and pulverize while carrying out this narrative, and the more violently you clash against the incoming crusade, the more Existential Moirai will be generated for your Mantle.|
The Arbiter threw his head back and laughed.
But the Ruling was not finished paying him!
Even more information cascaded down, carrying a suffocating, heavy weight that made the hairs on his arms stand up!
|One of THE Immense Ones is interested in your Narrative.|
|THE ECSTATIC FLAYER has begun to observe your movements.|
|If you put on a good show of pleasure and death, you will be granted even more power.|
The Arbiter stared at the final waves of information, his chest heaving as the ultimate high washed over him.
The architects of existence themselves were watching his binge, and they were bringing more powder!
More!
More!
MORE!

chapters.title: Chapter 5645: Narrative Vs Narrative! I
paragraphs: <THE True Human Emperor>

Noah floated in the unseen layers Dimensionality, seated comfortably upon a high, bloody throne of crimson gold Sanguine Mana. Below his suspended position, Mahishasura cut a heroic and terrifying figure!

The golden shield of his Mantle turned slowly and proudly above his head. He floated as a righteous vanguard, surrounded by the broken, unconscious bodies of hundreds of Descendants that were Wardens and Enforcers who had dared to stand against his glorious political crusade!
Of course, a grand crusade required a constant influx of soldiers. As the defeated members of THE PAX fell, Noah simply extended his fingers from the absolute safety of his throne.

He did not need to step down and issue verbal commands. Crimson gold blades of Sanguine Mana, laced with brilliant stellar blue light, slipped silently through the air. They cut effortlessly into the chests of the unconscious Enforcers and Wardens. Noah bypassed their physical flesh entirely, diving straight into the rigid, authored sentences written into their Descendant lineages.

He flooded them with his own grammar, ruthlessly cutting away their old loyalties to Those Who Remain and binding their existences directly to his will. They rose only moments later as perfectly Veiled puppets, their eyes devoid of any rebellion as they joined the growing, unified force standing behind THE SHIELD!
In truth, Noah was deeply contemplating exactly how far he could push his own newly generated architecture.

He now held the Hidden Mantle of THE Meta-Fictional Protagonist. Since he possessed the supreme capability to override narratives and dictate closed scenes, he wondered how he could best weave this conceptual power into the current war.

Could he completely author the outcome of Mahishasura’s crusade without ever drawing a weapon himself? Would existence itself continue to fund his conquest if he simply wrote the right script from the shadows?

The sheer momentum of his recent actions answered him with a heavy, surging weight within his own body. He felt the unpaused cycle of THE Infinite Provenance Baryogenesis roaring through his quarks, lifting his true standing tremendously with every passing second.
He called upon his own Regard to measure the exact depth of his rise.
|VERITAS: 28|
|PROVENANCE: 27|
|POTENTIA: INFINITE|
|PONDUS: 29|
|OSMONTIAN MOIRAI: 35|
|Hidden Mantle: THE Meta-Fictional Protagonist|
|Capabilities: Narrative Override, Existential Plot Armor, Scene Dictation|

Every attribute was rushing aggressively toward thirty. Furthermore, his Osmontian Moirai had already reached thirty-five. Unlike the standard Existential Moirai that paid the obedient servants of the order, this dark and fiendish currency was generated solely by his own Quintessential weight!
He was growing at a pace that defied all established measures of reality, his power compounding in total silence!
The crusade moved forward. Mahishasura led his newly acquired army of Veiled Enforcers into the sky, marching toward the next towering purple gold mountain in the inner ring.
They arrived to find the vast courtyards entirely empty.
There were no Wardens. There were no Loomwrought Shrouds. The mountain was a silent, hollow peak, completely devoid of the suffocating order that usually defined THE PAX.
Then, a booming voice echoed out from the distant, hazy clouds.
"Haha, Mahishasura, when did you grow so bold?"
The voice carried a manic, wet rattling sound that vibrated with pure instability. It did not sound like a composed ruler of order. It sounded exactly like a desperate addict finding a fresh vein!
"And who... is that fucker behind you on a throne? Is this your narrative, or his?"
HUUM!
Noah’s eyes pulsed violently!

Someone had seen him! A lifeform had peered right through the Unique Precept of Solipsism! Because his true Dimensionality ran so deep that it blinded even beings in the upper thirties, this meant whoever had just spoken possessed a depth that touched the absolute summit of Transfinite Dimensionality. No Enforcer had seen him so far. He had remained entirely unperceivable to the masses!
Noah squinted his eyes, peering intently through the purple gold skies to see what anomaly had arrived.
The distant clouds parted violently as...The Arbiter of THE Serenaros floated into view.

He was a towering, terrifying Descendant. His robes were immaculate, but his face was an absolute horror of twitching muscles and heavily dilated pupils. A layer of stellar white dust coated his upper lip and the fine collar of his garments. He shivered violently in the air, tweaking with an uncontainable, frantic energy that made the surrounding space warp and groan.

Behind him floated hundreds of elite Enforcers and Wardens, backed by thousands of perfectly silent Loomwrought Shrouds. They formed a massive, terrifying army, yet all of them kept a cautious distance from their own leader.

The moment he appeared, The Arbiter did not bother addressing Mahishasura again. He simply waved his pale, shaking hands toward a series of massive metal cages hovering in the periphery of the clouds.

Inside the cages, hundreds of defenseless Inhibited True Lifeforms looked up in sheer, unadulterated terror. They were Gilded and Source and Infinite lifeforms who had been stripped of their authority, their weavings completely silenced by their leashes!
The Arbiter smiled, exposing teeth stained with glowing white residue.
His Intent shot forward grandly. It slammed into the cages, crushing the physical bodies and the boundless Trueness of the captives in a single, deafening motion.
BOOM!
The defenseless lifeforms screamed for only a fraction of a second before they shattered entirely. They were instantly pulverized into a long, swirling line of sparkling white existential dust.

The Arbiter leaned forward and inhaled sharply. He waved his hands, guiding the pulverized existence of hundreds of beings directly into his nose. He snorted the crushed remains of the True Lifeforms with an expression of utter, deranged euphoria!

His entire body seized. Pure pleasure washed over his twitching face as the white threads of THE Argent Loom mixed directly with the stolen existences inside his veins. His power spiked visibly, his aura tearing at the fabric of the Dimension as he laughed at the sheer, overwhelming high of the consumption!
He was a being of unfathomable power exhibiting the lowest, most pathetic behaviors of a street addict!
Noah watched the display from his bloody throne.

His gaze turned impossibly cold. To witness such senseless cruelty, to see living, thinking existences treated as nothing more than an inhaled stimulant, offended the very core of his Quintessential human nature.
The sheer waste and indignity of it made the stellar blue light in his Sanguine Mana flare dangerously!
He did not move to strike. Instead, he activated THE Protagonist’s Omniscient Regard.
The details of the tweaking monster instantly cascaded down his vision.
|The Arbiter of THE Serenaros|
|VERITAS: 48|
|PROVENANCE: 0|
|POTENTIA: 45|
|PONDUS: 49|
|EXISTENTIAL MOIRAI: 50|
|Mantle: THE DECADENT (Willful)|
|Narrative of Existence: The Hedonist’s Defense|

|A triggered Willful Narrative centered on standing true to your ideals, your greed, and your absolute lust for existence’s highest pleasures. Those who seek to usurp your domain and take your harvest are your greatest enemies. The more lifeforms you burn and pulverize while carrying out this narrative, and the more violently you clash against the incoming crusade, the more Existential Moirai will be generated.|

Noah read the prompts with absolute, unblinking focus. But the Ruling was not finished delivering its terrible truths. Another heavy prompt descended, carrying the suffocating weight of the architects themselves.
|Through him, the gaze of one of THE Immense Ones has been drawn.|
|THE ECSTATIC FLAYER observes this Narrative of Existence with high expectations. If this Willful actor puts on a sufficient show of pleasure and death, he will be granted even more power.|
The situation had just become extraordinarily fragile!
The Arbiter was not merely a powerful addict hoarding authority. He was a lead performer on an existential stage, and one of Those Who Remain was sitting directly in the audience!
THE ECSTATIC FLAYER was actively watching this exact mountain, funding the slaughter with invisible currency.
If Noah stepped out from the unseen layers and executed The Arbiter himself, he would immediately draw the direct, unfiltered gaze of an Immense One.
He may expose his own generated standing, his Osmontian Moirai, and his hidden presence before his dimensional fortress was entirely complete!
He had to be extremely careful how he moved.
For now, this had to remain Mahishasura’s play. It had to be the grand epic of The Leading Crusade clashing violently against The Hedonist’s Defense.
Noah rested his chin on his fist, his expression smoothing into a mask of pure, tyrannical calculation.

He would use his own Mantle to scheme and steer from behind the scenes. He would pump Mahishasura full of hidden Sanguine Mana to bridge the massive attribute gap. He would use Narrative Override to quietly erase The Arbiter’s advantages, slowly starving the addict of his Moirai without ever stepping into the spotlight!
He would take control of this entire Dimension. He would claim this entire limb of THE PAX!
And he would do it while THE ECSTATIC FLAYER watched, completely unaware that the play they were enjoying had already been hijacked by a hidden director.

chapters.title: Chapter 5646: Narrative Vs Narrative! II
paragraphs: Noah observed the absolute chaos erupting across the purple gold skies of THE Serenaros.
The Arbiter of THE Serenaros struck out as he did not fight like a collected general of THE PAX. He fought like a rabid beast terrified of losing its next meal!
His body trembled violently as the stellar white dust of pulverized existences burned through his veins. He threw his arms wide, and his terrifying Intent erupted outward.

It exerted his own illusory Pantheonic Dimension directly onto the physical surroundings. Space and time warped sickeningly around him! Within a radius of a million light years, the flow of time dilated and stretched, designed expressly so that any pain inflicted upon his enemies would be experienced for what felt like an entire epoch.
"I am the peak of the high!"The Arbiter roared, his voice a manic, rattling shriek. "Give me your depth!"
HUUM!

He reached his pale, twitching hands into the pristine white rivers of THE Argent Loom that stitched the sky together. With a violent, tearing motion, he ripped the white threads from the fabric of reality and fused them with his own Intent.
The resulting manifestation was horrific!

Hundreds of massive, spinning vortexes of razor-sharp white Loom-threads materialized in the air, churning with the corrosive white dust of consumed existences. They swept forward like grinding wheels of slaughterhouse, shredding the purple gold clouds and annihilating the mountain peaks below. Every spinning vortex carried a PONDUS in the high forties, heavy enough to erase many simply by passing near it!
Descendant Mahishasura floated in the path of the onslaught.
The golden shield of his Mantle flared with brilliant, defiant light. He did not retreat!

Operating entirely within the role of THE SHIELD, Mahishasura raised his hands and projected a colossal fortress of woven Loom and golden Existential Moirai. Behind him, the Veiled Enforcers and Wardens poured their own boundless Intents and Dimensionality into his back, reinforcing the barricade!
The spinning white vortexes slammed into the golden fortress.
BOOM!

The impact shattered the local weavings of existence. Reality cracked like fragile glass, revealing the absolute dark of the crossing between Dimensions. Mahishasura grunted, his pale gold hair whipping wildly as the sheer kinetic weight of the Arbiter pressed down on him!

The gap in their attributes was simply too massive. Mahishasura sat in the lower forties, while The Arbiter brushed against the absolute summit of fifty. The golden shield began to fracture, hairline cracks spreading across the Mantle’s projection.
Noah watched the fracturing shield with a cold, unblinking gaze.

He could not allow The Arbiter to break the siege. If Mahishasura fell, the grand epic of the political crusade failed, and Noah would be forced to step out and handle the addict personally while an Immense One watched.
He leaned forward on his throne of Sanguine Mana. It was time to pull the strings of the play!

Noah activated one of the supreme capability of his Hidden Mantle, THE Meta-Fictional Protagonist. He targeted the active script of The Hedonist’s Defense, isolating the specific narrative beat that granted The Arbiter his terrifying momentum.
The addict was drawing power from the continuous consumption of existence. To starve him, Noah simply needed to rewrite the accessibility of the harvest.
|NARRATIVE OVERRIDE INITIATED.|
|Target: The Arbiter of THE Serenaros. Narrative: The Hedonist’s Defense.|
|Override Parameter: The script dictates that the hedonist’s stash is compromised.The existential dust of his harvest shall no longer yield euphoria, but ash. His reaches will find only the void.|

As the prompt locked into reality, The Arbiter laughed maniacally and reached his shaking hand toward another cluster of distant metal cages filled with Inhibited Lifeforms. He intended to pulverize them to fuel a second wave of Loom-vortexes.

His crushing Intent slammed into the cages. The bodies of the captives shattered perfectly, turning into a swirling line of stellar white dust. The Arbiter inhaled sharply, his eyes rolling back in anticipation of the overwhelming high.
The dust rushed into his nose, but the expected euphoria never arrived.

Because Noah had authored a local plot override, existence itself categorically refused to process the transaction. The pulverized existence turned into inert, tasteless ash the moment it entered The Arbiter’s veins. It carried no white threads of THE Argent Loom, no condensed terror, and absolutely no power.
The Arbiter choked. He coughed violently, his eyes snapping wide open in sheer, unadulterated panic as the sudden, agonizing withdrawal hit his system like a physical blow.
"Where is it?!"The Arbiter shrieked, clawing at his own throat. "Where is the emotion?! The immensity?! The high?!"
HUUM!

With the addict momentarily crippled by his own rewritten narrative, Noah shifted his focus to his vanguard. He extended his fingers, sending invisible, razor-thin threads of crimson gold Sanguine Mana directly into the back of Mahishasura’s neck.

He did not merely feed the Descendant raw power. Noah actively laced his dark, fiendish Osmontian Moirai directly into the golden Existential Moirai swirling around Mahishasura. The obsidian gold and pure gold blended seamlessly, masking Noah’s generated destiny inside the Ruling’s own currency.
Down in the sky, Mahishasura gasped.

He felt an unfathomable, terrifying surge of weight flood his limbs. He did not question the source, assuming the Ruling itself was paying him an absolute fortune for holding the line. His amber gold eyes burned with newfound tyranny.
"The Pax protects!"Mahishasura roared, his voice echoing with an unnatural, overlaid resonance.
Mahishasura pushed both hands forward before the opposing Enforcers and Wardens could even move, and it was hard for them to move due to the narrative storm that none of them had a hand in!

The golden fortress of his Mantle exploded outward as an offensive singularity. He compressed an entire gigaparsec of THE Argent Loom into a single, blinding white javelin wrapped in golden Moirai, and hurled it straight at the choking Arbiter.
The javelin crossed the distance instantly, carrying the full, amplified weight of Noah’s hidden backing and the ongoing Narrative!
CRACK!

The strike pierced straight through The Arbiter’s chest. The towering Descendant was thrown backward, crashing through three floating purple gold mountains before finally slamming into the grand, floating archive-peak of his own domain!
He lay pinned in the rubble, bleeding thick white existential dust and crimson Trueness, his body shivering uncontrollably from the wound and the narrative starvation.
Noah rested his hand back on his throne. The play was proceeding flawlessly. The Hedonist was breaking, and THE Political Crusade, The Leading Crusade, was standing tall!
But...existence rarely allowed things to work entirely undisturbed.

High above the broken mountains, the fabric of the sky suddenly ceased its natural movement. The purple gold clouds froze in place, and a sickening, heavy pressure descended over the entire Dimension. It was a pressure so dense that the ambient Infinity in the air physically plummeted to the ground!
Noah’s eyes narrowed as a cascade of heavy prompts flooded his vision.
|THE ECSTATIC FLAYER has deemed the performance of The Hedonist’s Defense to be lacking.|
|THE Immense One refuses to let a favored play end in starvation.|
|Direct interference detected. THE ECSTATIC FLAYER bypasses the standard generation of the Ruling and injects raw, unfiltered Existential Moirai directly into the Willful actor.|
|The Narrative is being forcibly mutated.|

The skies above the pinned Arbiter tore open like a weeping wound. A torrential sea of pure, blinding gold Moirai crashed down from the firmament, mixed with a sickening, vibrant purple light. It did not fall gently. It struck the broken addict with the force of an ocean dropping from orbit!
"YES!"The Arbiter screamed, his voice bubbling and distorting as the raw power of an Immense One flooded his empty veins. "GIVE IT TO ME! OH, GIVE IT TO ME!!!"
Noah watched in absolute, cold silence as the direct interference of Those Who Remain tore apart the established rules of their own system.

The Arbiter’s body underwent a grotesque, terrifying transformation. The immaculate robes of his office shredded into ribbons as his flesh expanded exponentially. His pale skin tore open to reveal weeping, fleshy tendrils of raw tissue that pulsed with an agonizing, ecstatic light.
Dozens of jagged, unhinged mouths ripped themselves open across his chest, his arms, and his elongated neck. His eyes swelled into massive, bloodshot orbs that radiated pure, concentrated madness.
He had become a towering, multi-limbed beast of absolute hedonism, a physical manifestation of a high that could never be satisfied.

The monstrous Arbiter let out a roar that shattered the eardrums of every Warden within a million miles. He did not look toward Mahishasura first. Instead, his dozens of mouths snapped wildly at the air, starving for immediate consumption.
He lunged backward into his own ranks.

The elite Enforcers and the thousands of perfectly silent Loomwrought Shrouds that had floated cautiously behind him had no time to react. The Arbiter’s fleshy tendrils whipped out, snatching hundreds of his own loyal soldiers. He shoved Enforcers, Shrouds, and Wardens into the jagged mouths across his chest, chewing through their physical flesh and their Trueness with horrifying, wet crunches!
"More!" the beast gurgled, its voices overlapping in a sickening chorus as it devoured its own army to fuel its mutation."MOTHERFUCKER, I NEED MORE!"
BOOM!

With every lifeform he consumed, the purple-gold light around him flared brighter. The monstrous Arbiter turned his massive, bloodshot eyes back toward Mahishasura, his tendrils thrashing the sky as he prepared to leap across the void!
His gaze became purely tyrannical. The stellar blue light within his Sanguine Mana burned with a lethal, absolute intensity!
He had authored a clean, tactical starvation, and an Immense One had simply dumped an ocean of raw currency onto the board to ruin it.
If he had closed off external intervention, he would have then definitely been locked onto by THE Immense One.
He activated THE Protagonist’s Omniscient Regard, his eyes scanning the mutating horror below.
The details that cascaded down his vision confirmed the terrifying reality of the Immense One’s interference.
|The Mutated Arbiter of THE Serenaros|
|VERITAS: 52|
|PROVENANCE: 0|
|POTENTIA: NULL|
|PONDUS: 55|
|EXISTENTIAL MOIRAI: ??? (Overloaded)|

The attributes had shattered the ceiling of fifty. The Arbiter had been artificially inflated past the bounds of THE TRANSFINITE VERSE...well, maybe. Noah still could not confirm if 50 was the bounds of THE TRANSFINITE VERSE!
And the POTENTIA had changed to NULL after this forced change. Did that mean the weavings of elevation of this lifeform were now...done?

Noah looked closely at the roaring beast. Before his very eyes, the physical form of the monstrous Arbiter began to flicker. One moment he was a towering mass of flesh and mouths, and the next, his edges blurred into the white threads of the Loom, rendering him completely transparent.
He was half-there and half-not, his existence vibrating at a frequency that was actively escaping the perception of normal reality.
His Dimensionality had been pushed so incredibly deep by the injection of Moirai!

Down below, Mahishasura raised his golden shield, his amber gold eyes widening as the unperceivable weight of the beast pressed down on him. Even with Noah’s hidden backing, the sheer density of an existence in the mid-fifties was enough to crack the foundation of his Mantle just by standing near it.
Noah did not move from his bloody throne. He did not panic!
He looked at the flickering, monstrous addict, and he looked at the weeping purple wound in the sky where THE ECSTATIC FLAYER watched its favored pet.
Noah reasoned that if Those Who Remain wanted to break their own rules to put on a better show, then he would simply have to step onto their stage and break the fucking actors!
