chapters.title: Chapter 5653: What Was Promised! I
paragraphs: <THE True Human Emperor>
Stepping off the edge of the map requires an entirely different set of keys than simply conquering the board.

Noah stood within the verdant blue-gold hills of his own Provenance Realm, watching Thalia Vasiliou prepare the doorway. She did not weave the white threads of THE Argent Loom, nor did she attempt to draw upon THE Primordial Source or Infinity or Causes or any Tongues.
Instead, she reached out with her bare, pale hands and physically grasped the fabric of his self-generated domain.

Her existence flickered violently, caught in the paradoxical strain of moving across Dimensions and Time, but her movements were flawlessly precise. She pulled her hands apart, tearing a seam not through space, but through the conceptual layer of existence itself.

"We are leaving the established frameworks entirely,"Thalia said, her voice quiet against the hum of the opening tear. "Hold my hand. If you step incorrectly here, you do not fall into the crossing-dark. You simply cease to be recorded...well, somewhat. You are strong enough to survive."
Noah took her hand without a fraction of hesitation.
They stepped through the tear.

The transition did not carry the raw kinetic violence of THE Dimensional Provenance Train of Existence, nor the unperceivable slide of a Hearthshift.It felt like walking from a crowded, deafening auditorium directly into a silent, boundless cathedral.
They arrived in a domain that defied every metric of existence held dear!
Towering arcs of moss-draped stone hung suspended in the sky, anchored only by localized, swirling gravities.
Colossal trees with trunks the width of continents spiraled upward, their canopies scraping an atmosphere that glowed with a deep, bioluminescent violet light. The air itself tasted pure!
"Within the Provenance Elsedimensions are scattered domains known as Elseworlds,"
Thalia explained, her white-blue robes shifting in the strange, vibrant winds.
"We have just arrived at the Vasiliou Elseworld. It is the original estate where the Provenance of the Vasiliou Provenance Lifeforms runs the strongest."

Noah swept his gaze across the breathtaking, alien horizon, his endlessly blue eyes analyzing the underlying architecture of the realm. A series of crisp prompts cascaded down his vision, confirming the sheer wonder of where they stood.
|You have entered an Elsedimension.|
|The underlying weavings of THE Argent Loom are virtually nonexistent here.|
|THE Provenance of Existence has a loosened grip upon this territory. The Rulings of THE Immense Ones are severely delayed and lack immediate enforcement within this Elseworld.|
|You stand in a blind spot of the architects.|

It was a staggering realization. The Immense Ones could force entire Dimensions into a linear gauntlet, but they could not easily peer into the sovereign Warrens of those who generated their own standing.

Thalia did not linger to admire the scenery. Her physical form vibrated with a sickening frequency, the paradox of her existence reaching a critical, breaking point. She held Noah’s hand tighter, leading him away from the towering stone arches and down toward a much lower, more intimate basin of the Elseworld.
The geography shifted into a serene, unfathomable expanse of water.

Endless, crystalline lakes spilled into one another over colossal cliffs, generating slow-motion waterfalls that caught the bioluminescent light. Floating atop the vast, perfectly still waters were massive luminous blue-gold lotuses, some the size of entire islands. The air here was heavy with a fragrant, ancient peace.
Thalia led him onto the surface of one of the grandest lotuses.
Waiting for them in the absolute center of the massive flower was another body.

Noah’s footsteps slowed. Sitting quietly on the blue-gold petals was a second Thalia Vasiliou. She wore the exact same white-blue robes, her striking, freckled face turned upward, her deep red hair cascading down her back as she looked...magnetic.
The seated Thalia looked at Noah with a soft, breathtaking smile.

"Existence does not like things moving across time," the seated Thalia spoke."I sensed my future self arrive in this era the moment she did. We have both been pulled towards each other ever since, destined to merge as one to close the loop."
The Thalia holding Noah’s hand stepped forward, her flickering form aligning perfectly with her seated counterpart.

"I may not have all my memories afterward," the flickering Thalia continued, her gaze dropping slightly. "But I may be able to talk more about what I remember as I will no longer be as bound. And... I may not even survive the resulting friction. For this, I need your help. I need an Anchor to hold my existence together in the way that my Provenance considers absolute."
Noah listened in total silence!

"And what my Provenance considers absolute..." Thalia finished calmly, though a rare, unmistakable shyness touched her features, "is an act of giving myself to My Provenance. You are my Provenance... so I do need you to anchor me and guarantee my survival as my present and future merge, okay?"
Noah looked at the two women in utter astonishment.
She was entirely serious. He evaluated the request with the same absolute focus he applied to any existential conflict. He was not a man who needed to be told such things twice!

He had not known her for a tremendous length of time in a linear, measurable sense. But time was a metric for mortals and the governed. She had known him in the future. She had bled for him, she had guided his mother, and she had looked at his daughter with genuine warmth.
Seeing how seamlessly she had integrated into the core of his existence, Noah found that every single reservation he might have held had completely vanished.
"I am right here," Noah said softly.
The flickering Thalia stepped into the seated Thalia.
The two bodies overlapped, and the merge commenced!
Immense, golden waves of Provenance began to seethe and erupt around her figure. The sheer force of the paradox collapsing in on itself threatened to tear her physical form apart!
Thalia looked up at Noah, her eyes misty with the agonizing strain and an overwhelming, desperate hope.
"My Provenance," Thalia whispered, her voice trembling under the weight of closing time itself. "Will you stabilize my Existence? Will you take what is yours now and in the future?"

Noah felt the call of her existence pulling at his own. He had to exert absolute, tyrannical control over his true depth, calling upon every single one of his billions of Provenance Telos Quarks to suppress his crushing Dimensionality and Egos!
He moved to her slowly, dropping to his knees on the blue-gold petals, and took her into his arms.

As their existences met, the massive golden lotuses around them reacted. The colossal petals folded upward, curling over them. They sealed the center of the lake in a dome of radiant light, ensuring that even the surrounding Elseworld would not bear witness to the act occurring within!

"We are leaving the established frameworks entirely,"Thalia said, her voice quiet against the hum of the opening tear.
"Hold my hand.
If you step incorrectly here, you do not fall into the crossing-dark.
You simply cease to be recorded...well, somewhat.
You are strong enough to survive."
Noah took her hand without a fraction of hesitation.
They stepped through the tear.

The transition did not carry the raw kinetic violence of THE Dimensional Provenance Train of Existence, nor the unperceivable slide of a Hearthshift.It felt like walking from a crowded, deafening auditorium directly into a silent, boundless cathedral.
They arrived in a domain that defied every metric of existence held dear!
Towering arcs of moss-draped stone hung suspended in the sky, anchored only by localized, swirling gravities.
Colossal trees with trunks the width of continents spiraled upward, their canopies scraping an atmosphere that glowed with a deep, bioluminescent violet light.
The air itself tasted pure!
"Within the Provenance Elsedimensions are scattered domains known as Elseworlds,"
Thalia explained, her white-blue robes shifting in the strange, vibrant winds.
"We have just arrived at the Vasiliou Elseworld.
It is the original estate where the Provenance of the Vasiliou Provenance Lifeforms runs the strongest."
Noah swept his gaze across the breathtaking, alien horizon, his endlessly blue eyes analyzing the underlying architecture of the realm.
A series of crisp prompts cascaded down his vision, confirming the sheer wonder of where they stood.
|You have entered an Elsedimension.|
|The underlying weavings of THE Argent Loom are virtually nonexistent here.|
|THE Provenance of Existence has a loosened grip upon this territory.
The Rulings of THE Immense Ones are severely delayed and lack immediate enforcement within this Elseworld.|
|You stand in a blind spot of the architects.|
It was a staggering realization.
The Immense Ones could force entire Dimensions into a linear gauntlet, but they could not easily peer into the sovereign Warrens of those who generated their own standing.
Thalia did not linger to admire the scenery.
Her physical form vibrated with a sickening frequency, the paradox of her existence reaching a critical, breaking point.
She held Noah’s hand tighter, leading him away from the towering stone arches and down toward a much lower, more intimate basin of the Elseworld.
The geography shifted into a serene, unfathomable expanse of water.
Endless, crystalline lakes spilled into one another over colossal cliffs, generating slow-motion waterfalls that caught the bioluminescent light.
Floating atop the vast, perfectly still waters were massive luminous blue-gold lotuses, some the size of entire islands.
The air here was heavy with a fragrant, ancient peace.
Thalia led him onto the surface of one of the grandest lotuses.
Waiting for them in the absolute center of the massive flower was another body.
Noah’s footsteps slowed.
Sitting quietly on the blue-gold petals was a second Thalia Vasiliou.
She wore the exact same white-blue robes, her striking, freckled face turned upward, her deep red hair cascading down her back as she looked...magnetic.
The seated Thalia looked at Noah with a soft, breathtaking smile.
"Existence does not like things moving across time," the seated Thalia spoke."I sensed my future self arrive in this era the moment she did.
We have both been pulled towards each other ever since, destined to merge as one to close the loop."
The Thalia holding Noah’s hand stepped forward, her flickering form aligning perfectly with her seated counterpart.
"I may not have all my memories afterward," the flickering Thalia continued, her gaze dropping slightly.
"But I may be able to talk more about what I remember as I will no longer be as bound.
And...
I may not even survive the resulting friction.
For this, I need your help.
I need an Anchor to hold my existence together in the way that my Provenance considers absolute."
Noah listened in total silence!
"And what my Provenance considers absolute..." Thalia finished calmly, though a rare, unmistakable shyness touched her features, "is an act of giving myself to My Provenance.
You are my Provenance... so I do need you to anchor me and guarantee my survival as my present and future merge, okay?"
Noah looked at the two women in utter astonishment.
She was entirely serious.
He evaluated the request with the same absolute focus he applied to any existential conflict.
He was not a man who needed to be told such things twice!
He had not known her for a tremendous length of time in a linear, measurable sense.
But time was a metric for mortals and the governed.
She had known him in the future.
She had bled for him, she had guided his mother, and she had looked at his daughter with genuine warmth.
Seeing how seamlessly she had integrated into the core of his existence, Noah found that every single reservation he might have held had completely vanished.
"I am right here," Noah said softly.
The flickering Thalia stepped into the seated Thalia.
The two bodies overlapped, and the merge commenced!
Immense, golden waves of Provenance began to seethe and erupt around her figure.
The sheer force of the paradox collapsing in on itself threatened to tear her physical form apart!
Thalia looked up at Noah, her eyes misty with the agonizing strain and an overwhelming, desperate hope.
"My Provenance," Thalia whispered, her voice trembling under the weight of closing time itself.
"Will you stabilize my Existence?
Will you take what is yours now and in the future?"
Noah felt the call of her existence pulling at his own.
He had to exert absolute, tyrannical control over his true depth, calling upon every single one of his billions of Provenance Telos Quarks to suppress his crushing Dimensionality and Egos!
He moved to her slowly, dropping to his knees on the blue-gold petals, and took her into his arms.
As their existences met, the massive golden lotuses around them reacted.
The colossal petals folded upward, curling over them.
They sealed the center of the lake in a dome of radiant light, ensuring that even the surrounding Elseworld would not bear witness to the act occurring within!

chapters.title: Chapter 5654: What Was Promised! II
paragraphs: And seconds began to pass.
In the middle of a grand act to anchor a Provenance Lifeform, to ensure her survival as the loops of time snapped shut, Noah’s mind suddenly exploded with a staggering influx of information.

His Provenance Essence flared violently. He was connected to the grand Provenance of another in an unfathomable way, and his existence was beginning to read the deepest, most heavily guarded secrets buried at the very root of her lineage.
Grand, blinding prompts surged into his vision!
|The existential union has reached the root. Two Provenance existences have touched where existences are not meant to touch. Something long-ripening has noticed the better vessel.|

|A latent Provenance stirs within Thalia Vasiliou. It has been ripening across the entire history of her lineage. It is not yet fully hers. It has never fully belonged to anyone. It has only been... awaited.|
Noah held Thalia closer, his breathing steady as he read the sheer scale of the revelation.

|THE Vasiliou Lineage has cultivated toward this Provenance for its entire existence. Generation upon generation refined, narrowed, and aimed, so that one day one vessel might be born able to hold it. That vessel is Thalia Vasiliou. She is their Queenling. She is the apex the whole lineage was a ladder toward.|
|And one of THE Immense Ones laid claim upon this Provenance before Thalia was ever born.|

|Looking down the length of the lineage’s potential, one of Those Who Remain reserved the harvest for itself. When the apex ripened, it would be taken. The Vasiliou were unwilling to part with or share such a Provenance, but conceded after many grand promises. A promise was made between one of Those Who Remain and The Vasiliou Provenance Lineage.|
The architects of reality had bred a harvest outside their own frameworks, and they had claimed it before it even had a name!
|You are not the vessel it was bred for. You are a purer, younger one.|

|The Provenance seeks the existence most able to bear it, and it has found one the lineage never designed and the claimant never accounted for: an existence of boundless potential, generated rather than granted, un-weighable, owing nothing to any framework. It reaches for you.|

|You may receive it. Doing so takes the purity of a Provenance reserved for one of THE Immense Ones. The claim will be broken by being fulfilled elsewhere. The awaited harvest will be reaped by a hand it was never promised to.|
Noah’s eyes burned with a terrifying, stellar blue-gold light in the enclosed dark of the lotus petals.
To take from Those Who Remain. To steal the reserved prize of the architects simply because his own generated existence was a superior, flawless vessel.
He did not even delay!
He held Thalia fiercely, accepting the union completely and drawing the latent, ripening authority directly out of her lineage and into his own unyielding Existence!
He felt his Provenance surge explosively, anchoring down something it absolutely should not anchor, claiming a theft of glorious proportions!
HUUUUM!

The surrounding existence outside the lotus petals trembled violently! The serene waterfalls shattered. The bioluminescent sky of the Vasiliou Elseworld flickered as if sensing the sudden, uncontainable rage of a distant, unimaginable terror!
It was the rage of one of Those Who Remain as however far they were...something they had claimed was being stolen!
But...it had no power here!
|An Immense One senses a severed claim.|
|A prize promised for Ages has been taken by an unknown hand.|
And in the midst of the shaking surroundings, as Noah secured the survival of the woman in his arms, the final, heaviest prompt locked itself permanently into his Records.
|THE Provenance of THE Immense Sovereign has settled into your existence.|
To steal from an architect is a crime. To steal a harvest reserved for an Immense One before they can even reach down to pluck it... is a genesis!

Noah knelt within the sealed, radiant blue-gold dome of the colossal lotus, holding Thalia Vasiliou tightly against his chest. The surrounding Vasiliou Elseworld was still shaking from the severed claim, but inside the petals, a far more terrifying violence was unfolding.
The latent authority drawn from Thalia’s lineage...the ripening prize that Those Who Remain had bred and waited Ages for, crashed into Noah’s existence like a falling Dimension.

It was a heavy, untamed weight. It carried the conceptual density of a sovereign right to rule, designed expressly to sit within the impossibly deep frameworks of the architects. But Noah did not possess their frameworks. His existence was entirely self-generated, owing nothing to any system.
So, when the unfathomable weight of THE Provenance of THE Immense Sovereign struck his core, it did not find a waiting throne. It found a grinder.
Noah’s endlessly blue eyes flared with absolute tyranny!

He called upon THE Hunger That Refines and THE Sovereign Existence. He refused to let this foreign, promised authority dictate his biology. Instead, he weaponized the sheer, crushing mass of the stolen harvest, using it as the ultimate catalyst for the grandest art he had ever authored.

THE Infinite Provenance Baryogenesis required the weight of existence to press down on his foundational particles, forcing them to survive and remake themselves into Provenance Telos Quarks. He had been converting them steadily, but the sudden influx of an Immense One’s prize acted like a billion Observable Existences detonating inside his veins all at once!
HUUM!
The first cycle of Baryogenesis accelerated infinitely.
Noah felt the agonizing, euphoric tearing of his own fundamental building blocks. It was a sensation of being unmade and perfectly reassembled in the same nanosecond.

The sheer friction of his body arguing with the size of the stolen Provenance caused his crimson gold Sanguine Mana, laced with stellar blue light, to erupt from his skin. It wrapped around Thalia, protecting her merging form while his own body became a crucible.
The count of converted quarks blurred past comprehension!
Fifty Decillion!
One Hundred Decillion!
One Hundred and Ninety Decillion!
Every single particle of his physical flesh, his bones, and his blood was subjected to the unyielding pressure of THE Immense Sovereign’s weight, and every single one of them survived!
BOOM!
A shockwave of absolute, unadulterated purity blasted outward, flattening the blue-gold petals of the lotus!

chapters.title: Chapter 5655: What Was Promised! III
paragraphs: Grand, cascading prompts flooded Noah’s vision as Existence rushed to record the birth of an anatomy that defied all established limits!
|The first cycle of THE Infinite Provenance Baryogenesis is complete.|
|All 200 Decillion Quarks have been successfully converted into Provenance Telos Quarks.|
|The First Tier of the Provenance Body has been forged.|
BOOM!
|THE Quintessential Provenance Skin is active. You have become structurally pristine.|
Existence was far from finished!
Because the 200 Decillion Quarks had been forged using the catalyst of the stolen harvest, THE Provenance of THE Immense Sovereign did not just settle into his existence.
It was violently digested, integrated, and repurposed by his Quintessential nature!
Noah gasped, his arms tightening around Thalia as a completely new, terrifyingly complex understanding of life itself bloomed in his mind.
He was suddenly looking at existence through a lens no ordinary True Lifeform or Primeval One could ever access. He could see... the literal, genetic markers of reality. He could see...he could see!
|THE Provenance of THE Immense Sovereign has been fully integrated and elevated by your unique architecture.|
|Capability Unlocked: EXISTENTIAL LIFELINE REVISION AND MARKER ATTAINMENT.|

|You have attained the authority to reach into the very genetic and existential markers of a lifeform.By utilizing THE Osmontian Tongue and your Infinite Sanguine Mana, you may completely edit, splice, isolate, or rewrite the foundational sequences of their existence.|
|You may extract and forge Genetic Markers of Existence. These sequences of Existential Code can be spliced into any lifeform and elevated to higher states of Dimensionality.|
|Initial isolations include the Infinity Genetic Marker, THE Source Genetic Marker, THE Provenance Genetic Marker, the Intent Genetic Marker, and THE Infinite Tongue Genetic Marker.|
|You and the Provenance Lifeform connected to you at the root may now act as PROVENANCE PROGENITORS.|
WAA!
The prompts carried a weight that shattered every known ceiling!
|You possess the sovereign right to author a new taxonomy of life. You may rewrite the existences of the bound and the shackled, stripping away their reliance on any other authority.|

|Through your editing, you may usher in Nova Provenance Elselifeforms. These are beings whose markers are entirely re-sequenced to generate their own standing, completely free from the frameworks of Those Who Remain.|
WAA!
To be a Progenitor!

Noah realized the sheer, unfathomable immensity of what he had just stolen. One of Those Who Remain had honed in on the Vasiliou lineage for Ages specifically to harvest this exact capability. It was the power to perfectly design, edit, and control the genetic foundation of existence itself. And Noah had simply snatched it from the vine and made it his own!

He could isolate the Infinity Genetic Marker and splice it into a being, allowing their existence to carry boundless Infinity without any rejection or the inevitable madness of the void! He could insert THE Source Genetic Marker to anchor them to the dense golden weight of THE Primordial Source, or THE Infinite Tongue Genetic Marker to grant them the capacity for supreme grammar. They were literal sequences of Existential Code, ready to be written, elevated, and deployed.
As this supreme authority settled into his newly forged Skin, his attributes violently adjusted to the new baseline of his existence.
|VERITAS: 45|
|PROVENANCE: 40|
|POTENTIA: INFINITE|
|PONDUS: 45|
|OSMONTIAN MOIRAI: 60|

His numbers had skyrocketed, crushing the limits of the mid-thirties and surging terrifyingly close towards whatever end of THE TRANSFINITE VERSE was. His Osmontian Moirai, the dark and fiendish currency generated by his own weight, hit sixty!
Within his arms, the golden waves of paradox surrounding Thalia finally settled!
The loops of time had snapped shut. Her present and future selves had merged perfectly, anchored by the sheer, unmovable gravity of Noah’s existence...and Dual Cultivation!
It saved lives!
Because their Provenances had touched at the absolute root during the theft, she had shared in the baptism of the Immense Sovereign’s integration.
Thalia Vasiliou took a long, trembling breath.

She opened her eyes, and the dim, scattered singularities within her depths had ignited into a blazing, unified constellation of pure authority. She looked up at Noah, her striking, freckled face flushed with a terrifying new vitality.
"You did it," Thalia whispered with brilliant wyes of adoration. "You anchored me. And... you took it all."
Noah did not speak immediately. He looked down at his own hands, and then at hers.
They had both physically changed.

The integration of the Progenitor authority had left a visible, breathtaking mark upon their pristine vessels.Orbiting the outer edges of Noah’s endlessly blue irises was a microscopic, floating double-helix of stellar blue-gold light. It looked exactly like a glowing genetic sequence, constantly unzipping and reweaving itself in real-time!
The exact same ethereal sequence orbited the irises of Thalia’s eyes.
But it was not confined just to their gaze.

Hovering a fraction of an inch off the skin of their wrists were delicate, glowing bracelets of the same blue-gold helix-weavings. The runes within the floating genetic strings pulsed with the undeniable, sovereign authority to create, edit, splice, and unmake life at the most fundamental level.
They no longer simply looked like powerful lifeforms. They looked like the architects of a brand new era. They looked like true Progenitors!
Noah slowly ran his thumb over the floating helix-weaving above Thalia’s wrist. The microscopic blue-gold runes shifted playfully under his touch, answering exclusively to his will.
He considered the tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of Descendants locked in the Dimensional Cabins, the lineages serving THE PAX, and the ancient Primevals.
He thought of his people.

He now held the literal, genetic keys to rewrite all of them into Nova Provenance Elselifeforms. He could build an army of un-leashed, self-generating terrors armed with spliced Existential Code that Those Who Remain would not even be able to read in the Records!
Noah’s lips curled into a slow, devastating smile.

The Vasiliou Elseworld outside the massive blue-gold lotus was still vibrating from the severed claim of THE Immense Ones. Inside the sealed petals, however, the violent golden waves of the time-loop closure had finally settled into a profound, breathless peace.

chapters.title: Chapter 5656: What Have You Done?
paragraphs: Thalia Vasiliou remained in Noah’s arms. Her striking, freckled face was flushed with the vitality of a fully stabilized Provenance Lifeform, but a sudden, heavy vulnerability clouded her expression. The microscopic, blue-gold genetic helix orbiting her irises spun slowly as she looked up at him.

"I am sorry," Thalia whispered, her voice cracking slightly in the quiet space. "I asked you to anchor me, and in doing so, I forced you to make a direct enemy of one of Those Who Remain. They will not forgive what you just took."
Noah looked down at her. He evaluated the sheer weight of her apology and found it entirely unnecessary. His expression remained an ocean of calm, tyrannical certainty.

"You did not force me to do anything," Noah said smoothly. "And nobody would have been allowed to take my Provenance. What was inside you was always going to belong to us. Let them be angry. I seem to be building a habit of offending them anyway."
Thalia stared at him. The sheer, unbothered arrogance of his claim broke right through the ancient tension weighing on her shoulders!

Small, crystalline tears spilled over her eyelashes. She did not bother wiping them away. A breathtaking smile broke across her face, carrying the profound relief of a woman who had spent her entire existence running from a predetermined cage. She reached up and embraced him tightly, burying her face into his shoulder.
Noah smiled softly. He wrapped his arms around her, his Sanguine Mana washing over them in a warm, protective current.

He allowed the silence to hold them for a long moment. He was human, and it was human to relax for a bit knowing of the coming storm. But his mind was already turning the newly acquired keys of their shared authority.
Noah pulled back just enough to look at the delicate, glowing bracelets of blue-gold helix-weavings hovering off the skin of their wrists.
"How much of this Provenance of THE Immense Sovereign can you utilize?"Noah asked.
"These Nova Provenance Elselifeforms....and everything else relating to these new possible weavings of existence."
Thalia took a slow breath.

"The lifeforms we can produce...they will be a bridge," Thalia explained, her voice regaining its melodic, resonant power. "They are not entirely Provenance Lifeforms, because their origin still requires our hands to edit and seat their foundations. And they are not entirely anything else that the Records currently hold."
She gently traced her fingers over the glowing helix on Noah’s wrist.
"To be a Nova Provenance Elselifeform is to be severed from the scales of all others but us. What you can do...I can do. I think..."
Noah looked at the floating genetic strings, thinking of Mahishasura, of Skallagrim, of the countless humans.
There was...boundless possibilities to think of!

He kept his arms wrapped protectively around Thalia Vasiliou. The golden waves of her stabilized time-loop had just settled. The microscopic blue-gold helixes orbiting their irises pulsed with the unfathomable authority of Progenitors.
For a fraction of a second, Existence belonged entirely to them.
It was...peaceful.
Then, the absolute peace within the lotus petals simply ceased to be.
HUUUM!

There was no spatial tear. There was no fluctuation of THE Argent Loom or ambient Infinity. Noah’s newly elevated Dimensionality, backed by attributes sitting heavily in the mid-forties, did not register an approach.
A woman simply materialized inches away from them, as if she had been standing there for the last epoch and had only now chosen to make herself visible.
Noah’s endlessly blue eyes snapped toward the figure, the stellar blue-gold Provenance Essence in his blood flaring dangerously before it calmed!
Because...

The woman looked like an older, terrifyingly grand version of Thalia. She possessed the same striking, deep red hair, though hers was woven with streaks of liquid gold. She was draped in immaculate, imperial white robes that seemed to carry the physical weight of entire Dimensions. Her posture was flawless, radiating a suffocating, ancient absolute.
But it was her eyes that commanded the space. They were filled with an immense, crushing disappointment as she looked down at the two of them.
Noah immediately activated THE Protagonist’s Omniscient Regard.
A heavy panel cascaded down his vision, bringing with it a profound realization of just how deep the Warrens of the Elsedimensions truly went!
|Rosalia Vasiliou|
|VERITAS: ???|
|PROVENANCE: ???|
|POTENTIA: ???|
|PONDUS: ???|
The entire panel was a wall of redacted ignorance!

Aside from her name, his sweeping authority could not weigh a single fraction of her existence. She was entirely unreadable, a being of such staggering age and depth that she bypassed the frameworks of his perception completely.
Rosalia Vasiliou did not even gaze at Noah. She kept her imperial eyes locked entirely on Thalia, her voice carrying a resonant, melodic sorrow.
"My child..." Rosalia whispered, the words vibrating through the very conceptual layer of the Elseworld. "What have you done?"
Thalia stiffened in Noah’s arms, the vibrant flush of her recent stabilization draining slightly from her freckled face.
"You think that generating your own standing means you owe nothing to the soil that grew you?" Rosalia continued, her tone admonishing and heavy with reprimand.

"But those with Provenance do not just think about themselves. Your lineage bled for Ages to cultivate the vessel you just broke. You acted only for yourself. You were selfish, Thalia, and in your selfishness, you have endangered every single Provenance Lifeform of our line."
Noah remained perfectly still as his eyes began to shine dangerously.

"Do you know what THE Immense Ones value above all else?"Rosalia asked, her voice dropping to a terrifying, intimate lecture."It is not authority. It is not the Scales. It is their honor. It is their dignity! To lose a promised bride, to have a reserved harvest stolen from their grasp... that is a slight that cannot simply be pushed aside! In existence, everyone has to make sacrifices. I made mine. Your father made his. We bent so that the Vasiliou could survive the architects."
She looked at the glowing blue-gold helix orbiting Thalia’s wrist, her disappointment deepening.
"How could you do this?"
Thalia slowly pulled herself out of Noah’s immediate embrace. She did not cower!
The time-loop had closed, and she had seen the absolute end of the road. She stood up on the blue-gold petals, her white-blue robes shifting as she met her mother’s imperial gaze.
"We are Provenance Lifeforms,"Thalia stated respectfully, but her voice had a grand, vibrating frequency that pushed back against her mother’s oppressive aura.
"We decide our fate. We decide our existence! Even Those Who Remain cannot definitively stand above us unless we bow our heads and offer them our necks!"
Thalia took a step forward, the stellar blue-gold light in her eyes flaring with the unmistakable, sovereign arrogance of a Progenitor.
"I am a Provenance Lifeform, mother. Are you?"
BOOM!
The words struck the inside of the lotus like a physical detonation!
It was a borderline blasphemous accusation, striking directly at the heart of Rosalia’s compromises! Thalia was angry. She was furiously rejecting everything!
Rosalia did not shout as her reaction was impossibly calm.
She simply turned her head, acknowledging Noah’s existence for the very first time.
Her unreadable, ancient eyes measured him up and down, dismissing his brilliance with a single, sweeping glance.

"A newly budding Provenance Lifeform who has attained what... the First Tier or Second Tier of the Provenance Body?"Rosalia mused coldly, her voice devoid of any actual curiosity. "Such a being beside you, or one of Those Who Remain. If you had both of them presented before you, the choice is clear."
Thalia did not miss a beat. Her voice rang out grandly, filled with absolute, unyielding pride!

"And I made that choice!" Thalia declared. "Between one of Those Who Remain and him... I have chosen him again and again! Across all Provenances, across time! As he would say in his own words... it is merely one of Those Who Remain. So what?!"
BOOM!
Noah looked up at Thalia in pure astonishment!
She had weaponized his exact arrogance and thrown it directly into the face of a terrifying, ancient matriarch!
She had defended him with a ferocity, standing between him and the oldest fears of her own bloodline.

Rosalia Vasiliou stared at her daughter for a long, heavy moment. The disappointment in her eyes finally hardened into a cold, pragmatic resolve. She shook her head as she let out a long, exhausted sigh.
"What is done is done,"Rosalia said flatly.

"And it cannot be taken back. So let us go. I have to convene with your father and the others of our Lineage to find a solution that does not involve your death, and all of our deaths. We may even have to reach out to the few friendly Immense Ones our Lineage shares some weavings with, to try and ensure that thing does not bring its unyielding rage down upon us."
She took a step closer, her imperial aura pressing against Noah’s Skin.
"We have to do all of this because the one you chose... cannot protect us," Rosalia stated.
She turned her eyes back to Noah, finally addressing the Emperor of THE Infiniverse directly. "Or can you do that?"
Noah felt the crushing weight of her unreadable Dimensionality pressing into his lungs.
"What can you do?"Rosalia asked, her cold words slicing through the absolute peace of the lotus. "What can you do better than one of Those Who Remain?"
Noah looked at this woman, his tyrannical mind momentarily amused by the sheer absurdity of existence. He never thought he would find himself facing down a disapproving mother!
He wanted to remain respectful. Thalia had just merged her existences, and this was her family. But Noah was fundamentally incapable of bowing his head to anyone who demanded it.

Noah rose to his feet. He brushed off his crimson-gold robes, his endlessly blue eyes locking directly onto Rosalia’s unreadable gaze. He did not flex his attributes, and he did not scream about his capabilities. His reply was calm, unhurried, and perfectly tyrannical.
"I will look at her, and all others of my people, as if they are equals," Noah said smoothly.
"Not like they are playthings that mean nothing. I will treat your daughter with respect. Not like a tool to be traded for a few Ages of peace from a master who only sees you as a harvest."
He stepped up beside Thalia, his shoulder brushing hers.
"That is what I do better."
Rosalia stared at him. The coldness in her eyes did not melt, and she did not seem remotely impressed by his declaration of humanity.
She simply harrumphed.
"Respect doesn’t mean shit if she is dead,"Rosalia snapped.
"Let’s go."
Rosalia Vasiliou simply waved her imperial hand.

A storm of blinding, ancient golden light raged instantly around them! The massive blue-gold petals of the lotus were violently blown backward as the sheer, conceptual force of her unreadable Dimensionality gripped both Noah and Thalia!
In a fraction of a second, the light swallowed the basin entirely, and all three of them disappeared from the Vasiliou Elseworld!

chapters.title: Chapter 5657: Nova! I
paragraphs: Respect doesn’t mean shit if she is dead.
The matriarch’s words followed Noah out of the lotus and across the Elseworld.
One body of him was gone with Thalia now, swallowed by golden light, carried deeper into the Warrens to be measured by a lineage older than the Scales.
He thought about Rosalia as he went.
She had looked at him and seen a First or Second Tier Provenance Body, a budding thing, a boy who had wandered into a house too old for him!
Him! A boy!
She had weighed him against one of Those Who Remain and found the scale tilted so far that the comparison was almost a courtesy. And she had not been wrong about the numbers.
By any measure of Ages and depth and accumulated dread, he was the smaller sum by an unfathomable margin.
The thing was, Noah had never once believed the numbers!

Standing before an Immense One, standing before the whole grim procession of Those Who Remain with their honor and their harvests and their bent and broken lineages, he had never for a single breath felt himself the lesser being.
He believed in himself that much!
And well.Sometimes a man had to fake it until he made it.
He almost smiled at that.
He had another one of his bodies sent into his Provenance Realm again as this body had come here for something quieter, and it was time to stop delaying it.
He called for his children.

They came into the Provenance Realm the way he opened for them, and the Realm’s blue-gold hills folded up around the three of them, and for a moment the war and the matriarch and the Train grinding through the crossing-dark were all somewhere else, and there was only this.

Henry arrived unhurried, blue-gold hair catching the light, wearing his father’s face years younger and none of his father’s weight. Seo-yeon arrived at a run and stopped short a pace away, her small face gone still and strange.
"You feel...a bit wrong, Aba" she said.
Noah crouched. "Wrong how, kiddo?"
She frowned, searching.
"Not bad wrong. Far wrong. Like you’re standing so far away from us in positioning...or existence. Ah, its hard to say!"
Noah smiled lightly at such words as he patted her head.
"I am a bit far, but I am also here, don’t worry."
Noah stood, and opened his hand, and looked at his son and daughter the way he now looked at all living things. All the way down.
Their Lifelines lay open to him.

It was still the strangest sight he had been given, and he had been given a great many. Henry’s existence unspooled as a long line of light, an unbroken code of Existential Markers running the whole length of what the boy was, and every locus of it was legible to him.

Here the marker that made him human. Here the marker of his birth, the Osmontian blood carried one generation forward, thinning and brightening through a single life. And here, all down the length of him, the markers of every gift he had ever accepted.
Beside him, Seo-yeon’s Lifeline ran shorter and stranger and, to a father, unbearably lovely, threaded through with the quiet marker that let her feel dying Causes.
Noah looked at the two of them laid open as editable grammar, and felt no hesitation, only a care that had sharpened itself to the finest edge he owned.
"This will not hurt," he said. "Hold still."
HUUM!
He began with what he was.

His Sanguine Mana rose off his hands, crimson gold laced with stellar blue, and it wrote. Under the guidance of THE Osmontian Tongue, the blood drew itself into a shape that had not existed in all of existence a moment before, because he was forging it now, in the open air of his own Realm, out of the deepest truth of himself.
|You are forging a Genetic Marker of Existence.|

|Source truth: your Nine Osmontian Causes, seated as Teloi through the whole of your matter. You are isolating the sequence that lets an existence carry Causes of its own. Aimed. Owned. Answerable to no framework.|
The marker turned between his fingers, a small helix of blue-gold light, and it hummed with the whole weight of what he was.
|THE OSMONTIAN CAUSES GENETIC MARKER has been forged.|
|It carries the rankings of Dimensionality as all things do. FINITE. TRANSFINITE. INEFFABLE. What you seat, you may seat at the depth the vessel can bear.|
He forged the second from the part of him that owed nothing to anyone.
|You are forging a second Marker.|
|Source truth: THE Provenance Essence you generate from within. You are isolating the sequence that makes an existence a source unto itself. Generating, not granted. Standing on nothing borrowed.|
|THE PROVENANCE GENETIC MARKER has been forged.|

Two markers turned above his open palms, one and then the other, the Causes and the Provenance, the aim and the source, the two truths that had made Noah more than a man who had merely been given things.
Henry watched them with his composure entirely gone. Seo-yeon reached toward the light without thinking, and Noah caught her small hand and folded it gently closed.
"Hold on,"he murmured. "The eldest one first."
He came to his son first.

Noah pressed the turning markers toward Henry’s open Lifeline, and where the light met the code, he wrote. The Tongue moved through him, not in Letters this time nor in Words but in the finer grammar beneath them, the grammar of splicing, and he excised as he wrote.
The dependence went first. Anything to do with Scales or external power!
His son felt many things leaving as he did not question!

Into the emptied ground, Noah wrote the new truth. THE Osmontian Causes Genetic Marker settled into the root of his son, and THE Provenance Genetic Marker settled beside it, and the boy became a man of wonder!
Because he had become a source.

Henry’s blue-gold hair blazed white at the roots. His existence, stripped of everything borrowed and reseeded with everything self-made, began to sing at a register it had never touched, and he threw his head back and breathed like a man surfacing from deep water as Causes woke inside him for the first time. His own!

INEFFABLE.
What you seat, you may seat at the depth the vessel can bear.|
He forged the second from the part of him that owed nothing to anyone.
|You are forging a second Marker.|
|Source truth: THE Provenance Essence you generate from within.
You are isolating the sequence that makes an existence a source unto itself.
Generating, not granted.
Standing on nothing borrowed.|
|THE PROVENANCE GENETIC MARKER has been forged.|

Two markers turned above his open palms, one and then the other, the Causes and the Provenance, the aim and the source, the two truths that had made Noah more than a man who had merely been given things.
Henry watched them with his composure entirely gone.
Seo-yeon reached toward the light without thinking, and Noah caught her small hand and folded it gently closed.
"Hold on,"he murmured.
"The eldest one first."
He came to his son first.
Noah pressed the turning markers toward Henry’s open Lifeline, and where the light met the code, he wrote.
The Tongue moved through him, not in Letters this time nor in Words but in the finer grammar beneath them, the grammar of splicing, and he excised as he wrote.
The dependence went first.
Anything to do with Scales or external power!
His son felt many things leaving as he did not question!
Into the emptied ground, Noah wrote the new truth.
THE Osmontian Causes Genetic Marker settled into the root of his son, and THE Provenance Genetic Marker settled beside it, and the boy became a man of wonder!
Because he had become a source.
Henry’s blue-gold hair blazed white at the roots.

His existence, stripped of everything borrowed and reseeded with everything self-made, began to sing at a register it had never touched, and he threw his head back and breathed like a man surfacing from deep water as Causes woke inside him for the first time.
His own!

chapters.title: Chapter 5658: Nova! II
paragraphs: |Henry Osmont is being rewritten.|

|External dependence excised. Borrowed frameworks removed. THE Osmontian Causes Genetic Marker and THE Provenance Genetic Marker seated at the root, at the deepest his vessel can bear and still have room to grow.|
|He no longer draws his standing from what he was given. He generates it.|

|The Markers he holds stand at the Finite Dimensionality Stage. The potential to grow is Average, the Attributes that can be reached are 10 at Maximum, and the growth rate is slow. The Markers can evolve with his own hand from being unfathomably true to himself, or from devouring Existential Treasures or Lifeforms as in every single Genetic Marker lies a passive Osmontian Devouring, a capability that allows it to bear the weight and devour thr surrounding Existence to grow.|
BOOM!

The light settled. Henry stood breathing in the blue-gold hills, and looked at his own open hands as though they belonged to someone he had just been introduced to, and around his irises, faint and unmistakable, a small helix of light had begun to turn.
|A NOVA PROVENANCE ELSELIFEFORM has been born. The first of its kind.|
Henry was quiet a long moment.
"I can feel...the Causes. Even closer than those backing me in THE Infiniverse..."
His eyes blinked with wonder as he looked at his father!
Noah only nodded at him and allowed him to feel as he knelt to his daughter.
Seo-yeon looked up at him with a trust so total it had never once occurred to her to withhold it.
He forged her rewrite gentler. What made her herself he kept with a care, and he wrote the new truth around it rather than over it.
"This one is yours,"he said, low, seating THE Provenance Genetic Marker into her first. "So that nothing you ever feel again can reach inside you and take."
He began splices thr two markers calmly as he slowly got the hang of rewriting genetic codes!
|Seo-yeon is being rewritten.|
|Native gift preserved and deepened. THE Provenance Genetic Marker and THE Osmontian Causes Genetic Marker seated at the root, at a Fine depth.|
|Another NOVA PROVENANCE ELSELIFEFORM has been born. The second of its kind.|

The helix kindled at the edges of her small eyes, matching her brother’s, matching her father’s, and she turned a slow circle on the petals to watch the light chase her gaze, smiling too damn happily as changes bloomed.
Noah stood between his two remade children, and existence answered what he had done.
|You have created the first two Nova Provenance Elselifeforms in existence.|
|Both descend from you at the root. Both carry your forged Markers. You are recorded not as a lifeform, but as a Progenitor with living descent.|
His Provenance Essence answered without being called.
It rose in him, seething upward from his newly pristine core!
|Assessment: Progenition generates. To seed a source is to prove yourself an origin, and the proof feeds the origin. Your Provenance Essence rises, and will rise with every lineage you author.|
|The more of existence that descends from you, the more of a source you become.|

Noah felt his own immensity lift as he smiled, his expression carrying a terrifying, unhurried absolute as he looked up toward the boundary of the realm. His secondary body had finally stopped moving. The storm of golden light across the Vasiliou Elseworld was dissipating.
They were arriving.
"Get acquainted with your new foundations,"Noah instructed his family, his voice dropping to a cool, commanding tone.
He had to go meet inlaws who very likely did not like him much!
But even as this occured, events in THE Dimensional Provenance Train of Existence also finally began to pick up.
<THE Serenaros Dimension>
A prison... only functions if the inmates actually believe the walls are solid.

Noah remained seated upon his high, bloody throne of crimson gold Sanguine Mana. Down below, the surviving Wardens and Enforcers knelt in absolute, Veiled obedience, their lineages seamlessly overwritten by his grammar.

Mahishasura floated just above the kneeling masses, projecting the composed, golden authority of THE SHIELD. He looked up toward the unseen layers, delivering his tactical assessment to the hidden emperor.
"We have confirmed the perimeters of the coupling," Mahishasura reported, his voice echoing with disciplined absolute!

"There are two massive thresholds at either end of the Dimension. The doorway behind us leads to a lower Dimensional Cabin in the rear. The doorway ahead leads to a higher Cabin toward the front. So far, neither threshold has shown any fluctuations."
Noah nodded slowly, his chin resting on his fist.

He was already running simulations on how to best hijack the momentum of THE Dimensional Provenance Train of Existence. He controlled an entire Cabin. He had the literal, genetic keys to rewrite lifeforms into Nova Provenance Elselifeforms. He was simply waiting for the perfect moment to deploy his newly acquired taxonomy.
But the architects of reality were not known for their patience.
HUUUUM!
The entire gigaparsec-wide Dimension suddenly buzzed with a deafening, structural frequency!

Noah sat up, his endlessly blue eyes narrowing as the rusted courtyards directly in the center of THE Serenaros violently fractured. The pristine white threads of THE Argent Loom snapped. The ground tore open, and a geyser of thick, obsidian crimson blood bubbled out from the very core of the Dimension!
It did not pool on the ground as the obsidian crimson blood shot upward, weaving and hardening into the shape of a massive, colossal stellar tree!

The blood-tree pulsed with a terrifying, ecstatic air of power and immensity. It radiated the undeniable, suffocating scent of an Immense One’s direct interference. It was an authority so heavy and ancient that the moment it bloomed, the thousands of Descendants and Wardens across the Dimension began to tremble!

Their physical bodies seized. The natural, instinctual response of their authored lineages commanded them to drop their heads and press their knees into the dirt. They wanted to kneel to the sheer, crushing weight of the architects!
But they did not.
WAA!
A brilliant, stellar blue light flared from beneath the skin of every single Veiled Enforcer and Warden!

Because Noah’s Infinite Sanguine Mana had already cut open their existences and rewritten their loyalties, his Quintessential absolute violently rejected the compulsion! The crimson gold threads in their blood roared to life, locking their knees and holding their spines perfectly straight! The Veiled did not bow to external beings!
Up on his throne, Noah’s gaze turned sharp as waves of heavy, blinding information rushed into the minds of everyone present.
|An Immense One has cast a seed upon the board.|
|Pure Blood Essence of an Immense One has been scattered across select Dimensional Cabins.|

|Within the center of THE Serenaros, the Essence has taken root. It will soon mature into a Pure Blood Fruit. If consumed, this Fruit will heavily elevate the Dimensionality and physical foundations of the victor.|
|To ensure a worthy harvest, the Pure Blood Essence releases a heavy, undeniable scent across all connected Dimensional Cabins.|
|Let the contenders gather.|
Noah read the prompts with a cold tyrannical smile.
A treasure and a poison had just bloomed within their Dimensional Cabin! The Immense Ones were not just waiting for the Cabins to fight; they were actively dropping bait to force a bloodbath!
And the bait worked flawlessly.
Almost the exact moment the obsidian crimson tree fully formed, a terrifying sound echoed from the front of THE Serenaros Dimension!

The massive, translucent doorway leading to the higher Dimensional Cabin ahead of them began to buzz violently! The thick, crystallized barriers separating the realms screamed under a sudden, overwhelming pressure!
BOOM!
|The Walls between Dimensional Cabins are coming down.|
The prompt dropped like an executioner’s blade!

The translucent doorway at the front of THE Serenaros began to slide open, and a heavy, suffocating aura immediately bled through the gap! It was a dense, crushing Intent that carried the weight of an apex predator who had smelled the Pure Blood Essence and was coming to claim it.
Down below, Mahishasura raised his golden shield, his amber gold eyes locking onto the opening doorway as the Veiled Enforcers raised their authorities in perfect unison!
But up in the unseen layers, Noah watched.

His endlessly blue eyes swirled with boundless Provenance. He had just finished transforming all 200 Decillion of his fundamental building blocks into Provenance Telos Quarks! He had just forged the First Tier of the Provenance Body and activated THE Quintessential Provenance Skin! He was structurally pristine, generating an Osmontian Moirai that sat heavily at sixty!
Noah looked at the opening doorway, feeling the suffocating weight of whatever was stepping through to claim the Immense One’s prize.
He was not afraid as instead, he was genuinely, intensely curious.
He simply wondered... just what level of Dimensionality could he withstand before he even had to try?

chapters.title: Chapter 5659: I Think, Therefore I Am! I
paragraphs: <THE True Human Emperor>
At times, the deepest shock of a breached door is rarely the monster you do not know. It is the presence you have already bled alongside!

Noah had his eyes locked on the front threshold of THE Serenaros Dimension. The thick, crystallized barriers separating their Dimensional Cabin from the one ahead were sliding open. He expected an apex predator, drawn by the undeniable scent of the Immense One’s Pure Blood Essence that was currently bubbling into a colossal stellar tree in the center of his rusted courtyards!
But as the heavy, suffocating aura bled through the gap, Noah’s eyes pulsed with sudden incredulity!

He felt the signature of life outside that door even before the physical bodies stepped in. He felt it because the weavings of his infinity, however cast out, were silently braided into the existences walking into his Dimension!
The doorway parted fully, and boundless waves of obsidian Paradox spilled into the realm.

Two figures emerged from the roaring abstract storms. The first was a massive obsidian titan, towering with the crushing density of a Primeval beast. Existence itself actively distorted and warped around his massive frame. Beside him walked a humanoid dressed in the threadbare rags of a peasant, his entire body burning quietly with faint, obsidian flames of pure anomaly.
They were beings Noah knew intimately, though they carried an entirely different weight at this moment.
It was THE Living Paradox and THE Primordial Paradox! The student and the teacher were both here!
Noah activated THE Protagonist’s Omniscient Regard, taking the measure of their growth across the different flows of time.
|THE Living Paradox|
|VERITAS: 11|
|PROVENANCE: 0|
|POTENTIA: Undefined|
|PONDUS: 12|
|THE Primordial Paradox|
|VERITAS: 15|
|PROVENANCE: 0|
|POTENTIA: Undefined|
|PONDUS: 18|

Of course, attributes sitting in the teens carried a profound, lethal weight for any standard True Lifeform. But even more astonishing than their arrival was the immediate realization that the heavy aura of oppression did not stem from them.
The true, suffocating weight came from the shadow walking behind them.

An old man stepped through the threshold. He wore the loose, immaculate garbs of an ancient philosopher, his bearing entirely devoid of the fanaticism of THE PAX or the primal rage of the Primeval Ones. He radiated a boundless regality and an intellect so sharp it felt physically abrasive!
His eyes were unfathomably deep, holding a paradoxical certainty that forced the surrounding laws of existence to quietly submit to his presence.
Noah gazed at him once, and the Records answered with a heavy weight.
|Descartes, THE Continuum Paradox|
|VERITAS: ???|
|PROVENANCE: 0|
|POTENTIA: 62|
|PONDUS: 65|
|EXISTENTIAL MOIRAI: 85|
An existence sitting deep in the sixties, carrying a VERITAS completely obscured by questions marks!

The moment this philosopher appeared, he swept his sharp gaze across the Dimension. He completely ignored the towering blood-tree budding at the center of the courtyards. He ignored the endless cages filled with inhibited lifeforms hovering in the sky. He instantly locked his gaze directly upon the unseen layers, finding Noah immediately.
The old man stared at the Progenitor, and he frowned.
Before the tension could escalate into a conflict of Rulings, a boisterous voice boomed out and shattered the quiet.
"Haha, Youngest? Youngest! How are you here? It has been months!"

The titanic figure of THE Primordial Paradox rushed forward, his obsidian body vibrating with genuine, unfiltered joy. Even the prideful and calculative visage of Erwin cracked with shock, the peasant-garbed anomaly offering a small, rigid nod of acknowledgment toward the bloody throne.
Seeing an old friend, a title that could truly only be applied to THE Primordial Paradox, as Erwin had once been an enemy he nearly killed, Noah waved his hand.

Down in the courtyards, the thousands of Veiled Descendants immediately stood down. They lowered their authority and stepped backward, every single one of them moving with the deliberate, synchronized precision of chess pieces as they formed neat, silent rows behind their emperor.
Noah rose from his throne.

He descended through the unseen layers, his crimson-gold robes trailing stellar blue light as he stepped onto the rusted ground. He met THE Primordial Paradox in the center of the courtyard, and the two of them dapped up!
HUUUM!

The physical collision of their hands caused the surrounding existence to violently buzz! Bursts of localized, obsidian paradoxical storms raged outward from their grip, clashing uselessly against the invisible barrier of Noah’s Quintessential Provenance Skin!

"Man, I still cannot see your depths,"THE Primordial Paradox laughed, pulling Noah into a heavy, crushing hug."I thought with time moving differently across Dimensions, I may have pulled ahead of you just a little, but it doesn’t seem like it. Oh..."

At that moment, THE Primordial Paradox scratched his massive obsidian head. He turned around, his boisterous demeanor instantly shifting into a posture of profound respect as he looked toward the old man behind them.
"Continuum Master," THE Primordial Paradox announced cleanly, "this is an old friend and benefactor of both of us. THE Youngest, Osmont!"
Continuum Master?
Noah was genuinely astonished. THE Primordial Paradox, an entity of absolute arrogance who had warred against the weavings of existence itself, actually referred to another being as his Master?

Noah looked closely at the old man. Descartes was filled with unfathomable power, yet he carried no greed. He had ignored the Immense One’s treasure entirely to focus his complete attention upon Noah.
Descartes looked back at him calmly. His voice, when he finally spoke, hd devastating weight of absolute logic.
"I think, therefore I am," Descartes stated evenly. "Do you think, Youngest?"
HUUM!
It was a simple question.

Yet shockingly, Noah felt his Provenance Essence violently pulse! An unbearable conceptual weight slammed down upon his shoulders, testing the very foundation of his identity. He felt entire seas of unfathomable paradox pressing down around him, seeking to measure the exact depth of the truth he claimed to hold!

His physical existence demanded a response. His 200 Decillion Provenance Telos Quarks screamed to defend him, urging him to erupt with Infinite Sanguine Mana and violently shatter the incoming suppression.
But his mind recognized the nature of the pressure. It was not a physical strike. It was a philosophical measurement!
Noah stood perfectly still under the crushing weight, his endlessly blue eyes locking onto the philosopher, and he replied using the absolute, undeniable root of his own Tongue.
"I AM!"
BOOM!
Instantly, the heavy, suffocating weight pressing down upon him faded away into nothingness.
Descartes held Noah’s gaze for a long moment, the sharp intellect in his eyes cooling slightly. The old philosopher gave a single, slow nod, finding the answer perfectly adequate!

It was a simple question.
Yet shockingly, Noah felt his Provenance Essence violently pulse!
An unbearable conceptual weight slammed down upon his shoulders, testing the very foundation of his identity.
He felt entire seas of unfathomable paradox pressing down around him, seeking to measure the exact depth of the truth he claimed to hold!
His physical existence demanded a response.
His 200 Decillion Provenance Telos Quarks screamed to defend him, urging him to erupt with Infinite Sanguine Mana and violently shatter the incoming suppression.
But his mind recognized the nature of the pressure.
It was not a physical strike.
It was a philosophical measurement!
Noah stood perfectly still under the crushing weight, his endlessly blue eyes locking onto the philosopher, and he replied using the absolute, undeniable root of his own Tongue.
"I AM!"
BOOM!
Instantly, the heavy, suffocating weight pressing down upon him faded away into nothingness.
Descartes held Noah’s gaze for a long moment, the sharp intellect in his eyes cooling slightly.
The old philosopher gave a single, slow nod, finding the answer perfectly adequate!

chapters.title: Chapter 5660: I Think, Therefore I Am! II
paragraphs: Descartes stood quietly in the center of the rusted courtyard, his unfathomable eyes sweeping away from Noah.

The old philosopher looked at the thousands of Veiled Descendants standing in perfectly ordered rows, and then he looked up at the massive floating metal cages filled with Inhibited True Lifeforms. He observed the grim, suffocating machinery of THE PAX without a fraction of shock.
"It is a logical inevitability," Descartes said smoothly.

"Those who forge chains for others are simply building the very links that will eventually bind them. To suppress another’s existence is to admit that your own standing is too fragile to survive their freedom. The masters of this order built an entire system of cages, and now they find themselves locked. A perfect, symmetrical consequence."
He turned his head slightly, addressing his towering obsidian disciple without raising his voice.
"Catch up," Descartes instructed THE Primordial Paradox, waving a perfectly calm hand. "We will move soon, as I am... interested in your friend here."

Descartes did not wait for an acknowledgment. He turned his back on the budding stellar blood-tree and the heavy aura bleeding through the vanguard doorway. He walked slowly toward the distant prisons, his hands clasped behind his back, and began to observe the Inhibited Lifeforms locked within the cages.
Noah watched the philosopher walk away.

His endlessly blue eyes shone with a profound, terrifying realization. He had just integrated THE Provenance of THE Immense Sovereign, elevating his attributes tremendously and establishing himself as a Progenitor. Yet the old man walking across the courtyard carried a density of paradox that made the surrounding physical laws actively submit to his footsteps.
"How the hell did you come to be a disciple of another?"Noah asked. "And to someone like that?"
Despite the sheer arrogance THE Primordial Paradox usually carried, the obsidian titan did not bristle at the question. He let out a heavy, rumbling breath that sounded like grinding tectonic plates.

THE Primordial Paradox offered a grim smile and shook his massive head. He looked over at Erwin, who stood quietly in his threadbare peasant rags, faint obsidian flames of anomaly burning across his skin.

"All this guy’s fault," THE Primordial Paradox said dryly. "As THE Information Paradox, when we were at our absolute wits, he pulled upon all information across the continuum and instead called upon... our Master there."
The titan raised his massive hand. "Ah, best if I just show you."
THE Primordial Paradox waved his fingers, condensing a heavy singularity of obsidian light. He tossed the record directly to Noah.
Noah reached up and caught the singularity calmly. He allowed the condensed information to slip past his Quintessential Provenance Skin, and the scenes instantly began playing out across his mind!
The rusted courtyards of THE Serenaros faded. Noah’s vision plunged into the abstract, tearing violence of a different timeline.

He saw a cluster of Observable Existences burning in the void. Countless Gilded Lifeforms lay shattered across them. Standing in the center of the ruin were THE Primordial Paradox and Erwin. Both were heavily wounded, their obsidian authorities flickering and failing!

"We were hunting a cluster of Gilded Lifeforms,"THE Primordial Paradox narrated directly into Noah’s consciousness, his voice completely stripped of its usual boisterous warmth. "And we stepped too deep. The noise drew the masters of the soil."

The space behind the two anomalies violently tore open. Three Primeval Lifeforms emerged from the crossing-dark. They were towering, impossible titans woven of raw Egos and petrified bone, carrying Egos of Superbius that crushed the remnants of the Observable Existences into dust simply by arriving.
"They were old," the narration continued. "They were heavy. We were completely outmatched and about to be collapsed into nothingness."

In the record, the Primeval Ones unleashed a tsunami of conceptual weight. Erwin dropped to his knees. The peasant-garbed anomaly reached his bleeding hands directly into the fabric of the continuum. He weaponized his own failing existence, spreading his paradoxical information across the furthest reaches of reality in a desperate, blind summons.
The void answered.
Descartes did not arrive with an explosion. The philosopher simply appeared between the dying anomalies and the raging Primeval Ones, wearing the exact same immaculate robes.
The Primeval Ones drove their massive, starlight-woven limbs downward, bringing the full, lethal weight of their Causes and THE Argent Loom directly onto the old man!
Descartes looked up, and he did something unique.
|The Continuum Paradox has rejected the sensory data of the attack.|
|He temporarily denies the certainty of the physical world. He doubts the existence of the blazing egos and the crushing bone.|
Because Descartes refused to acknowledge the physical reality of the strike, the unfathomable depth of his paradox forced Existence to agree with him!
The Primeval attacks struck his position and simply ceased to be true. The kinetic force and the conceptual weight passed entirely through him, rendered as nothing more than hollow, empty illusions!
The three Primeval Ones roared in absolute confusion!
Descartes countered. He simply spoke to them, applying the cruelest, most absolute logic existence could bear.

"You beasts rely on authority and Egos,"Descartes said in the memory, his voice echoing with devastating clarity. "But if an illusion deceives your eyes, and authority and emotions cannot strike true, what are you? I think, therefore I am. Do you think, or do you merely consume?"

|THE Continuum Paradox asserts absolute existence while eroding the certainty of the enemy. Without their power, the Primeval Lifeforms cannot prove their own cognition. Their existences begin to waver.|
The Primeval Ones shrieked as their massive bodies began to flicker. Their Causes unspooled!
Descartes stepped forward and delivered the execution!
|THE Continuum Paradox divides reality into two distinct substances: the non-physical thinking mind and physical extension in space.|
|The dualism is imposed violently upon the targets.|
Descartes segregated their minds from their matter. He tore their non-physical consciousness directly out of their physical forms!

The massive titans collapsed instantly. Their minds were cast adrift into the abstract void, completely severed from reality, while their towering bodies of Egos and bone rotted into dead, inert matter in a single second.
No physical blows were struck. No raw authority was exchanged. It was pure, lethal philosophy.

"Since that day that we were saved," THE Primordial Paradox concluded the narration, the obsidian singularity fading entirely from Noah’s mind. "We have been learning from him. Because when it comes to Paradox... none of us can compare."
BOOM!
Noah blinked, the rusted courtyards of THE Serenaros snapping back into focus.

His tyrannical mind raced, processing the sheer terror of an existence that weaponized existential doubt to unmake ancient beings. To simply deny an attack the right to be true, and to sever a mind from its flesh through absolute logic... it was a methodology of power that was unfathomably unique.
Noah turned his head, looking past his Veiled army.

He refocused his endlessly blue eyes on the distant, unbothered lifeform. Descartes was standing in front of the massive metal cages, calmly engaging the terrified, Inhibited True Lifeforms in conversation! Casually!

chapters.title: Chapter 5661: I Think, Therefore I Am! III
paragraphs: Descartes entered and left cages freely.

The sealed dimension was supposed to be completely under Noah’s lock and key. Yet, from the very cages that held the collected trophies of Mahishasura and others, he simply traversed in and out as by the time he was done...
Descartes approached Noah.
"Let us talk."
The voice was calm, holding no trace of any known authorities like Infinity or the dense Primordial Source.
Before Noah could formulate a response, the space rippled as two other figures stood on the periphery.
THE Primordial Paradox tilted his head and pointed toward Erwin.
"Continuum Master, can we listen in?"
Descartes did not turn around. He merely spoke to the empty air.
"Listen in, if you are able to. We are here, and not here."

The moment the words left his mouth, a shift occurred. To the perception of everyone else present in the dimension, Descartes and Noah vanished. They were simply subtracted from the perception of reality, entering a depth of Dimensionality that defied observation!
THE Primordial Paradox sighed with heavy frustration. Behind him, Erwin also sighed.
"Will that monstrous anomaly steal the show again? And here I thought we were making progress."
THE Primordial Paradox shook his head.
"We made tremendous progress. Just some beings in existence can be utter monsters. Come on, let us try to listen in as they should be here."
Noah looked at the two paradoxes with shining eyes. They truly could not perceive them simply from the words of Descartes.
Descartes settled his gaze on Noah.
"Do you agree with what Vakochev did? And the fact that he failed?"
BOOM!

The question carried the conceptual weight of a collapsing Dimension. Noah remained outwardly still, but astonishment cascaded through him. He analyzed this impossible entity. How did this being know about the failure of Vakochev? Was he also among those that the final message reached? Did he hold an obsidian crystal of his own?
Noah met the gaze of the strange man.
"It is only human to fail, and one can only try again."
He did not offer a defense of Vakochev, nor did he condemn him. He simply stated the bare reality of ambition. Then, Noah asked the only question that mattered.
"Who are you, really?"
"I am just a thinking thing."
The philosophical reply hung in the air, dense with an unreadable depth.
"Could I ask you a few questions, Young Friend?"
Noah nodded lightly.
Descartes began.
"If you completely strip away your name, your home, your family expectations, and your social status, what remains of the you that you are trying to be true to?"

Noah blinked did not answer immediately. He let the question sink into the bedrock of his existence. If he was not THE True Human Emperor, if he was not Amelia’s son or Henry’s father, what was left? He looked inward.

"A... tyrannical desire to thrive. What remains is the sheer, unadulterated will to impose its own order on a chaotic void. What remains is a hunger that refuses to let anyone else hold the pen that writes my story."
Descartes accepted the answer without judgment. He asked the next.
"How do you know that your passions, cravings, and deepest desires are actually your own, rather than mere mechanical reflexes and chemical tricks of your physical body?"
Noah found himself genuinely thinking. It was a terrifying concept, the idea that his very drive might be a scripted chemical reaction. He weighed it against his own choices. He decided on his truth.

"Because I am the one who pays the price for them. If my body tricks me into a desire, I devour the trick. I take ownership of the reflex. A craving is only a trick if you are a slave to it. If you weaponize it to climb to the peak of existence, it becomes a tool. And tools belong to the hand that wields them."

"A heavy claim," Descartes mused. "But consider this. If an invisible force or internal psychological bias is actively deceiving you into believing a beautiful lie about your character, how do you verify that your self-image is not a complete illusion? What objective proof do you have that your authentic self is a reality and not a comforting ego defense mechanism?"
Noah felt the weight of the question pressing against his VERITAS!
Objective proof. Was there such a thing?

"There is no objective proof. Existence is terribly fond of novelty, and it will offer you a thousand mirrors to show you a thousand different lies. My proof is not found in a mirror. My proof is found in consequence. If my authentic self is an illusion, I will enforce that illusion upon reality until existence itself has no choice but to accept it as the ultimate truth. The proof...is the reality I leave behind."
Descartes offered a slow nod.
"When you are fast asleep and dreaming of a completely different life, body, and existence, which version of you is the true one, and why do you prioritize the waking one?"
Noah thought of the endless crossings, the dimensions, the lives he could have lived.

"The true one is the one that wakes up. I prioritize the waking one because it is the one that has to bear the weight. The dreaming one gets to escape. I have been a Dreamer. I have met Great Dreamers. I have even dreamed an endless Dream, but I always wake up. The waking one has to protect its people, face THE Immense Ones, and build a home. The waking one is true because it does the work."
WAA!
By the time he finished answering the final question, a pristine state of clarity washed over him. The very fabric of his existence resonated!
|VERITAS: 46|
|VERITAS: 47|
|VERITAS: 48|
His Trueness began to shoot up, tearing through the walls of the forties. Just from thinking about and answering questions about himself!
Descartes looked upon the blooming stellar blue light.

"To be true to oneself in existence is more than enough to overcome everything. It is how Those Who Remain became so powerful. Whether vile or good, whether they built sanctuaries or slaughtered Existences, they lived so absolutely true that now, even existence cannot argue with them."
BOOM!
