chapters.title: Chapter 5675: Vasiliou! I
paragraphs: Noah turned his endlessly blue eyes from the city to the woman holding his hand.
Every measurement he held of Thalia Vasiliou had been taken during a catastrophe. There was the day she fell out of a white pool, bleeding on his grass.
There was the hour her edges flickered, causality collecting its toll. There was the moment she wept because he did not remember her.
All of his data came from her worst hours.
Here, she was home, and whole, and merged!
So he activated THE Protagonist’s Omniscient Regard. For the first time since the pool, her existence answered him.
|Thalia Vasiliou|
|VERITAS: 99|
|PROVENANCE: 99|
|POTENTIA: 99|
|PONDUS: 99|
|(Current values are weakened. The toll of movement across Dimensions and Time continues to suppress the True standing of this existence.)|
He read the panel once. Ninety-nine, four times, and beneath the columns a parenthesis stating that the numbers were a floor.
The woman whose hand sat warm in his stood thirty points above him on every axis while actively suppressed. Her true standing lived somewhere he had not yet learned to measure!
He had gotten himself a powerful woman!
He thought of THE TRANSFINITE VERSE and THE INEFFABLE VERSE when he looked at these numbers.

What was one hundred? Was one hundred where the shore ended and the Verse simply began? Did an existence at one hundred stop touching THE INEFFABLE and start standing inside it? Was the woman beside him one point of suppression away from a different order of reality?
He did not know!
Rosalia turned around.
Her unreadable eyes went to their joined hands, to her daughter’s fingers laced through the fingers of a supposed First Tier vessel, and she shook her head once, slowly.
Mothers had performed this motion for as long as daughters had chosen someone they did not approve of. Rosalia performed it too! Then she waved her imperial hand.
WAA!

The road was gone soon after. The three of them became streaks of light, and Noah observed their trajectory with mild interest, because the streaks did not bend toward the climbing tiers of Vasileia or the red-gold fortress at its crown.
They arced past the entire city, toward the mountain behind it.
They stood on bare dark stone at the mountain’s foot. Above them, the falls of essence descended without sound.

Ahead, spanning the base of the mountain from end to end, a boundary of solid golden light rose out of the ground in a single sheer curtain, taller than the city’s highest tower, its surface moving with slow internal currents that had not stopped moving since before the rulings were weighed.

Stellar gold trees grew across the approach in quiet groves. Their canopies burned softly with the essence the mountain shed, and the light came down through the branches and lay on the stone in slow-moving patches.
Among the trees, spaced in silent intervals before the boundary, Provenance Lifeforms floated like statues.
There were five of them. There did not need to be more!

Each one hung motionless above the ground, facing outward. Long shining red hair, loose past the shoulders. Armaments of white gold, plate and pauldron and long-hafted glaives, worked plain, without one ornament.
Beneath the armor their bodies burned, a continuous quiet fire of stellar gold Provenance rising off their skin, so that each guard stood inside a low corona of their own generation!
None of them moved. None of them looked at the arrivals. Their eyes remained ahead, on nothing, on everything.
Beside him, the warmth left Thalia’s presence.
"Mother." Her voice was level. "Why are we at the Provenance Vasiliou Elsemountain? Father and the others should be gathered in the Provenance Tower. That is where the Lineage receives."
Rosalia did not even turn around.

"Very few Provenance Lifeforms can enter the Vasiliou Elsemountain,"Thalia continued, and her grip on his hand tightened by a measurable degree. "Even of our own lineage. The boundary admits extremely high Dimensionality, or a unique Provenance, and nothing else. It does not care for names. It does not care for blood."
She took one step forward.
"Are you trying to embarrass us, Mother?"
Rosalia turned then, without hurry. Her gaze passed over her daughter and settled on Noah.
"The least he can do,"Rosalia said, "is be exceptional enough to enter a mountain."
HUUM!

"If he cannot do even this, then you have already chosen wrong, and it is better that everyone learns it at the door instead of in the hall. I told your Father and the Vasiliou Provenance Elders that I would bring you here. So everyone has gathered here."
She gestured at the boundary. A small motion, almost gracious.

"I sure do hope this will not be the last place your chosen is able to step into. It is only passing through a barrier and entering a mountain. A simple task, surely, for someone who is supposedly a grander choice than an Immense One. Right?"
Noah listened to all of it with perfect calm.
Rosalia had moved the entire gathering from the Tower to the Elsemountain after her daughter defied her.
A mother, outsourcing her judgment to a mountain!
The theatrics did not interest him.

There was a preschool office, decades ago, on a small blue world that no longer existed in its original form, and he had stood in its corner. A teacher had slid a pamphlet across a desk. A tired woman who worked night shifts closed her hand around a small boy’s hand and said he was fine, and that she would take care of him, and walked him out into the parking lot sunlight.

Noah had watched the stakes on that cheap desk, and they were higher than anything in this valley, because the woman defending the boy had nothing else, and the beings gathered in this mountain had everything and were frightened anyway.

Ceremony was the tax long-lived beings paid one another to avoid saying plain things plainly. He had stopped paying it when he stopped keeping his worth in other people’s accounts. His worth resided in two hundred Decillion Provenance Telos Quarks, and every one of them was presently calm!
What he cared about stood on the other side of the light.
The Elders of an entire Vasiliou Lineage gathered ahead of him, behind a boundary that filtered existence by depth and uniqueness.
Somewhere past it were beings who remembered Ages the Records had forgotten, and the answer to the question he had carried since a matriarch first sneered at his so called First Tier.

What were the sovereign and the architect to each other, truly? Livestock did not receive favors. Rivals did not get harvested. The beings who had lived the answer were waiting inside a mountain to look down at him!
Noah looked at the slow golden currents of the boundary. He was not worried and he was not offended. He was curious!

sentences.text: Noah turned his endlessly blue eyes from the city to the woman holding his hand.
Every measurement he held of Thalia Vasiliou had been taken during a catastrophe.
There was the day she fell out of a white pool, bleeding on his grass.
There was the hour her edges flickered, causality collecting its toll.
There was the moment she wept because he did not remember her.
All of his data came from her worst hours.
Here, she was home, and whole, and merged!
So he activated THE Protagonist’s Omniscient Regard.
For the first time since the pool, her existence answered him.
|Thalia Vasiliou|
|VERITAS: 99|
|PROVENANCE: 99|
|POTENTIA: 99|
|PONDUS: 99|
|(Current values are weakened.
The toll of movement across Dimensions and Time continues to suppress the True standing of this existence.)|
He read the panel once.
Ninety-nine, four times, and beneath the columns a parenthesis stating that the numbers were a floor.
The woman whose hand sat warm in his stood thirty points above him on every axis while actively suppressed.
Her true standing lived somewhere he had not yet learned to measure!
He had gotten himself a powerful woman!
He thought of THE TRANSFINITE VERSE and THE INEFFABLE VERSE when he looked at these numbers.
What was one hundred?
Was one hundred where the shore ended and the Verse simply began?
Did an existence at one hundred stop touching THE INEFFABLE and start standing inside it?
Was the woman beside him one point of suppression away from a different order of reality?
He did not know!
Rosalia turned around.
Her unreadable eyes went to their joined hands, to her daughter’s fingers laced through the fingers of a supposed First Tier vessel, and she shook her head once, slowly.
Mothers had performed this motion for as long as daughters had chosen someone they did not approve of.
Rosalia performed it too!
Then she waved her imperial hand.
WAA!
The road was gone soon after.

The three of them became streaks of light, and Noah observed their trajectory with mild interest, because the streaks did not bend toward the climbing tiers of Vasileia or the red-gold fortress at its crown.
They arced past the entire city, toward the mountain behind it.
They stood on bare dark stone at the mountain’s foot.
Above them, the falls of essence descended without sound.

Ahead, spanning the base of the mountain from end to end, a boundary of solid golden light rose out of the ground in a single sheer curtain, taller than the city’s highest tower, its surface moving with slow internal currents that had not stopped moving since before the rulings were weighed.
Stellar gold trees grew across the approach in quiet groves.
Their canopies burned softly with the essence the mountain shed, and the light came down through the branches and lay on the stone in slow-moving patches.
Among the trees, spaced in silent intervals before the boundary, Provenance Lifeforms floated like statues.
There were five of them.
There did not need to be more!
Each one hung motionless above the ground, facing outward.
Long shining red hair, loose past the shoulders.
Armaments of white gold, plate and pauldron and long-hafted glaives, worked plain, without one ornament.
Beneath the armor their bodies burned, a continuous quiet fire of stellar gold Provenance rising off their skin, so that each guard stood inside a low corona of their own generation!
None of them moved.
None of them looked at the arrivals.
Their eyes remained ahead, on nothing, on everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 5676: Vasiliou! II
paragraphs: The massive golden boundary of light separated the exterior reality from the interior immensity of the Vasiliou Elsemountain.
"Each of you must cross with your own power,"Rosalia declared, her voice slicing through the heavy air as dense golden light spilled from the peaks above.
"Your own Provenance must prove your weight."
Thalia’s Vasiliou Bloodline boiled as she seemed about to erupt, her pristine features tightening in sheer defiance!
Noah observed the spike in her biological and conceptual aggression. He made no objection to her anger, merely raising his hand to gently squeeze hers.
"Go ahead," Noah said.

Thalia looked at him before she stepped forward as the golden boundary actively resisted! It was an arduous, crushing weight as vibrant waves of her own golden Provenance flared brilliantly to push back against the rigid laws of the Elsemountain.
She tore through the light, stepping onto the grass on the other side as she breathed hard, her chest heaving as she glared back at her mother.
In the next nanosecond, Rosalia stepped through without a fraction of a delay or effort as the barrier simply parted for her.

Noah looked at the older woman. His Protagonist’s Omniscient Regard returned only a wall of question marks. He knew he could exert THE PRECEPT OF THE WAKING DREAM to pull her information from the continuum, but it would require a temporary drain of his Essence. He evaluated the exchange rate and determined the knowledge was currently unnecessary.
He stepped forward.
He did not brace for impact or flare an aura. He simply closed his glowing blue eyes and exerted THE Provenance of THE Human Dreamer upon the localized weavings of the boundary.
He dictated that the golden barrier was not a rigid law of reality. He dictated that it was merely a dream, and he was the dreamer walking through it!
WAA!
|THE PRECEPT OF THE WAKING DREAM is active.|
|2 Provenance Essence is held in reserve to overwrite the reality of the Vasiliou Boundary.|
|You are passing through the simulation.|
Noah walked through the empty air as if the golden light did not even exist! He stepped onto the pristine grass beside Thalia, and he ceased the exertion.
|The alteration of reality is released.|
|2 Provenance Essence is returned from reserve and ready for usage again.|
The silent shock on Rosalia’s face was absolute as she stared at THE True Human Emperor!
Noah looked toward her and nodded.
"I thank mother-in-law for the test of my worth on this mountain,"Noah stated, his tone polite but echoing with a mocking, absolute-zero certainty.

"I hope you do not take this as a challenge and are more reasonable towards the lifeform your daughter chose. Because just maybe, her words of me being better than an Immense One, for her at least... they may hold some truth."
Thalia inhaled sharply in shock as Noah boldly wrapped his stellar blue-gold arm around her waist, anchoring the vastness of the moment to the small, true warmth of her body.

He began walking forward, leaving Rosalia behind as the older woman’s eyes shone brilliantly! She looked at his back, and Noah could see her mind genuinely reevaluating the terrifying anomaly walking beside her daughter!
Would she actually be reasonable?
Thalia looked up into his endlessly blue eyes, her own filled with a mixture of worry and absolute alarm as she transmitted her voice solely for him to hear.
"You... you didn’t already unlock the identity of your Provenance, right? That would also be happening much earlier!"
It was a heavy question, and Noah processed its weight perfectly. He permitted a smile to break across his clinical features in silent affirmation as he looked ahead.
He had to look ahead.
Multiple terrifying gazes from different elevations of the mountain had already begun to lock onto them!

This was a glorious, unfathomable scene! Atop massive golden pillars carved directly into the slopes of the Elsemountain, Vasiliou Provenance Lifeforms could be seen sitting or floating in absolute majesty!
Each one pulsed with golden waves of Provenance that swirled around them like miniature galaxies!
Noah felt a tremendous, crushing pressure descending from one pillar in particular.
He looked up and observed a man with a crimson goatee and wild red hair floating atop the highest gold pillar, looking down at him with an authority that sought to flatten reality itself.
Noah processed the genetic markers and the spatial positioning, assuming immediately that this was Thalia’s father.

He kept his hand firmly around Thalia’s waist. He looked up at these apex predators, knowing with absolute certainty that none of them would show anything but question marks to his current Weavings, but he stood his ground! He was a localized simulation of an unreadable depth!

He felt Thalia steadying against his side. Her face became entirely firm as her own Provenance began to buzz with a vibrant, dangerous frequency. She looked up at the dozen powerful Provenance Lifeforms governing this mountain as Rosalia materialized on the golden pillar directly behind the man with the crimson goatee.
Thalia’s voice erupted, grand and explosive, echoing across the entire Vasiliou Elsemountain!

"Father, Mother, Elders,"Thalia declared, her words rolling with supreme confidence. "I greet you on this grand day because I have found my other half. I also greet you to bring the news that my Provenance has shown me glimpses of the future. The future that Those Who Remain never like others glimpsing, as they curse many who even have the capability."
Noah’s endlessly blue eyes pulsed briefly. He thought of Ulf.
"I have seen glimpses of multiple futures,"

Thalia continued vibrantly, her conviction absolute as her golden aura flared. "And any future where our cultivated Provenance, where my Provenance...is given to an Immense One, leads to our degradation and decimation!"
The words struck the golden pillars like thunder!
"So I have taken it upon myself to change this,"Thalia roared.
"I stand here today to say that for the Provenance of the Vasiliou Lineage to prosper, we do not need to have the favor of an Immense One... we need to birth an Immense One among us!"
BOOM!
The declaration shattered the heavy silence of the mountain!

Noah’s eyes shone with a dreamy, terrifying brilliance as he looked at the woman leaning against his side. She was navigating the rigid codes of her lineage with the exact same tyrannical ambition he possessed.
Truly, she was capable!
Seeing her like this made his own weavings surge as his own emotional and tyrannical side seemed to flare up from its slumber!

chapters.title: Chapter 5677: Introduce Myself!
paragraphs: The vibrations of Thalia’s explosive declaration struck the massive golden pillars of the Vasiliou Elsemountain!
Noah stood flawlessly beside her as he thought about the conceptual weight of the shocking statements Thalia had just made.
The birth of an Immense One!
Was such a thing so easy to do?
He was a human who dreamed of rewriting the board as this dream she just mentioned was a grand one, but damn!
As her golden aura flared brilliantly, the environment of the Elsemountain reacted! The golden waves of Provenance swirling around the massive pillars stagnated and slowed.
Noah observed the twelve Vasiliou Provenance Lifeforms positioned above them.

The gaze of Rosalia Vasiliou lost its sharp edge and became deeply somber as she looked at the man beside her and the other Provenance Lifeforms. They exchanged glances that carried the heavy, crushing weight of a shared and terrible secret. They looked at Thalia as if they knew something fundamental about the architecture of reality that she did not.

At the apex of the highest golden pillar, Thalia’s father actually lost his hardened, tyrannical expression. The man with the crimson goatee and wild red hair stared down at his daughter as if staring at someone much younger who had made a catastrophic mistake without even realizing it.
"My dear daughter," the Vasiliou Patriarch said imposingly as his voice held the sorrowful weight of entire extinguished timelines.

"You are the very light of my existence, but you are young, so you do not know. It is expected that you do not know. Even among the elders here, and the vast majority of existence do not know, but... the path towards becoming an Immense One is closed off. Shattered and broken."
Noah’s eyes pulsed! The path was closed!

"The last person to confirm this was none other than the one who had laid out his scales across existence,"her father continued, the golden light around him dimming with the sheer gravity of his words.

"Vakochev was the last and final confirmation of what many Provenance Lineages had already known. The Immense Ones that are here now are the only Immense Ones there will ever be. They made sure of this."
BOOM!
The words were ridiculously heavy as an immense silence settled over the mountain!
Noah felt the woman beside him tensing up as her biological and conceptual pathways buzzed.
He looked at the ancient sovereigns floating on their pillars. To them, this was a tragic, undeniable law of existence!
To him, they were merely biological structures operating on outdated code. They were not his seniors!
He raised his head and looked at the Provenance Lifeforms.
"Forgive me for intruding here," Noah stated, his voice booming out and echoing with absolute power that cut through the somber atmosphere without a fraction of heat.

"But we are Provenance Lifeforms. If any path was shattered, so what? I have not been a Provenance Lifeform for long, but the one singular thing I have come to understand is the fact that we generate our own weavings of existence. We decide what our existence is capable of or not. If any path is shattered, it does not really matter to us. We simply continue on forging our own paths."
Noah delivered the explosive words with chilling, immovable certainty!
The moment his words finished, all twelve Provenance Lifeforms instantly rose up from their golden pillars!
WUU!
An immense weaving of suffocation and terrifying immensity began to permeate over everything as their sovereign authorities crashed together!
Noah permitted a faint smile to form on his clinical features. It was a mechanical expression of absolute tyranny. He knew exactly why they were reacting with such overwhelming force.
He had purposefully said something that he was curious about and wanted to confirm.

He had stated that he had not been a Provenance Lifeform for long. This made it extremely clear that, not long ago, he was something else. He was probing them to understand whether what he did was considered statistically impossible by the standards of genuine sovereigns. Based on how all of them had risen at this exact moment, he had his answer.
Rosalia Vasiliou stared down at him with a heavy, disbelieving gaze as the golden barrier behind them hummed violently!

"Are you saying something as outlandish as the fact that you were another form of life in the past, and you simply became a Provenance Lifeform?"Rosalia asked, her voice tight with unfathomable somberness. "You were not born one?"
Was it truly something so unique?
Noah was even more curious now. He felt his woman tensing beside him.
Noah looked around innocently. The innocence was a calculated, mocking facade covering a tyrant who possessed the unending reserves of Infinite Sanguine Mana.
"What reason have I to lie?"Noah reasoned aloud, his detached attitude rolling over the ancient beings!

"I have no lineage of Provenance Lifeforms behind me. I have myself because I generated myself and my own immensity. I am THE True Human Emperor. I Am THE Human Dreamer. I have taken Thalia Vasiliou as my woman here as I came here today to introduce myself for those of you that do not know me. It is nice to finally meet you, Father-in-law and Mother-in-law, and the elders of the Vasiliou Elseworld."
He stepped forward, his stellar blue-gold body glowing with an unyielding, macro-scale dominance that refused to acknowledge their superiority!
"I am Noah Osmont, and I am burdened by glorious purpose."
BOOM!
The twelve Vasiliou Elders became utterly quiet!

Their collective immensity stalled as they looked at the True Human Emperor gravely! Noah gazed back at them, analyzing their silence. They had assumed he was an arrogant thing. Now, they were running simulations of an anomaly they couldn’t quite place!
The man with the crimson goatee exchanged a heavy, silent communication with the other Elders atop the massive golden pillars. He then turned his crushing gaze toward his daughter.
"Thalia, go with your mother and the other Elders to prepare," her father commanded imposingly."I will converse with the one who is burdened by glorious purpose."
BOOM!

"What reason have I to lie?"Noah reasoned aloud, his detached attitude rolling over the ancient beings!
"I have no lineage of Provenance Lifeforms behind me.
I have myself because I generated myself and my own immensity.
I am THE True Human Emperor.
I Am THE Human Dreamer.
I have taken Thalia Vasiliou as my woman here as I came here today to introduce myself for those of you that do not know me.
It is nice to finally meet you, Father-in-law and Mother-in-law, and the elders of the Vasiliou Elseworld."
He stepped forward, his stellar blue-gold body glowing with an unyielding, macro-scale dominance that refused to acknowledge their superiority!
"I am Noah Osmont, and I am burdened by glorious purpose."
BOOM!
The twelve Vasiliou Elders became utterly quiet!
Their collective immensity stalled as they looked at the True Human Emperor gravely!
Noah gazed back at them, analyzing their silence.
They had assumed he was an arrogant thing.
Now, they were running simulations of an anomaly they couldn’t quite place!
The man with the crimson goatee exchanged a heavy, silent communication with the other Elders atop the massive golden pillars.
He then turned his crushing gaze toward his daughter.
"Thalia, go with your mother and the other Elders to prepare," her father commanded imposingly."I will converse with the one who is burdened by glorious purpose."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5678: Atlas! I
paragraphs: Thalia hesitated. Her golden aura spiked defensively as Rosalia floated over, placing a pale hand on her daughter’s shoulder.
The Patriarch clenched his fist! He descended from his golden pillar as a massive golden doorway tore open on the mountain grounds directly where Noah and Thalia stood!

Heavy steam instantly released from the fracture. It was a blistering, conceptual heat that could scorch anything below fifty attributes to absolute ash! The Patriarch stood beside the doorway and motioned toward it, demanding the human to enter.
Noah looked at Thalia.
"I should be okay," Noah stated. "We will just go talk."
He did not wait for her to object as he stepped forward and walked through the scorching doorway fearlessly as behind him, Thalia’s eyes shone with absolute conviction!
Noah appeared in a localized pocket of extreme conceptual density.

It was a type of primordial spring filled with scorching steam! Golden waters bubbled violently like liquid lava, glistening with raw Provenance! As Noah looked around, he felt tremendous power radiating from the environment. He looked through the clear golden waters and saw dozens of pristine golden skeletons resting at the bottom!

The Patriarch came through the doorway. His ornate robes fell away, replaced by a simple white towel wrapped around his waist. He walked directly into the blistering spring, revealing a towering, wildly muscular figure scarred by epochs of conflict.
He sat down grandly as the golden lava washed over his chest.
He relaxed back against the rocky edge as heavy waves of steam spilled out and closed his eyes.
"What are you doing?"The Patriarch’s voice boomed out. "Get in, my supposed son in law."

Noah did not delay. He gazed at the ancient skeletons down below as he took on the full, unbothered majesty of THE PROVENANCE DREAM FRAME. His stellar blue-gold body glowed with absolute authority as he stepped into the liquid gold.
Cascading prompts immediately flooded his vision!
|You have entered THE Vasiliou Primordial Spring.|
|The pristine golden skeletons below are the remnants of extremely powerful Provenance Lifeforms of the Vasiliou Lineage.|
|Any entity possessing attributes below 50 will be scorched out of existence.|
|Bathing in these waters allows one to steadily raise their attributes by a maximum of 5 in all areas.|

Noah felt the burning liquid attempt to invade his pathways. It was a massive transfer of thermal and conceptual energy. He assimilated it flawlessly. He felt nothing but the biological data of rising temperature.
Ahead of him, the Patriarch opened his eyes.
"I am Aurelius Vasiliou," the man introduced himself, his voice holding the crushing weight of a sovereign.

"I am the current arbiter of the Vasiliou Provenance. I am burdened with my own glorious purpose. But it does not matter. You have said some interesting things regarding your origins. You may not even understand what it actually means to say that you were not born a Provenance Lifeform."
Aurelius leaned forward as his crimson goatee glistened with golden steam.
"Have you heard of Atlas?"
Noah observed the golden liquid. He saw prompts detailing his attributes slowly beginning to rise while within the spring.
|VERITAS is increasing.|
|PONDUS is increasing.|
"No," Noah replied, his tone perfectly flat and devoid of awe."I do not know of any Atlas."
Aurelius exhaled a breath of heavy golden vapor.
"Atlas was a Provenance Lifeform who engineered, invented, and built impossibilities,"Aurelius detailed, his words constructing a terrifying visage within the misty cavern.

"Even though he was not one of Those Who Remain, he moved around them as equals. He engineered the very concept of Elsedimensions. He invented the art of cultivating tiers of Provenance Bodies and many other arts. He forged weapons that could extinguish Provenance Lifeforms with a single swing!"
The Patriarch’s eyes locked onto Noah with blazing intensity!

"Through his ingenuity and absolute inventions, he was even able to aid an existence to become an Immense One. But the most unique thing about this being was that he held no lineage of Provenance Lifeforms behind him. He was completely alone. The one secret that was known across the highest echelons of reality was that he was not born a Provenance Lifeform. He left behind many things as they can be found in Elseworlds that no Immense Ones can enter."
Noah processed the data. A sovereign engineer who built the foundations of modern existence and challenged the architects!
He was analyzing the historical weight of a being who defied the rigid code of the continuum.
"Where did he go?"Noah asked calmly.
Aurelius let out a harsh, booming laugh that shook the cavern!

"He never went anywhere,"Aurelius replied grandly. "He was too illustrious and grand. Multiple Immense Ones used their absolute power to snuff out his brilliance and his existence entirely! But that was a lifeform that was not born a Provenance Lifeform and instead became one. One of the last things that he left behind was a message."
The golden waters bubbled violently as the Patriarch recited the ancient words!

"A cryptic message. He said... Existence is grander and more illustrious than all of you imagine! And when someone like me arises in the future, find and grasp what I left behind! And you can see and share just how illustrious existence is, as I never got the chance to. Find My Provenance!"
BOOM!
The scorching steam of the Vasiliou Primordial Spring rolled across the rocky ceiling.

Aurelius Vasiliou sat in the bubbling golden lava. The declaration regarding Atlas hung in the heavy atmosphere as the Patriarch did not pause to allow the weight to settle. He pressed forward, his voice echoing with absolute, terrifying grandeur.
"Atlas was an anomaly that defied the strict architecture of the architects," Aurelius boomed, the golden waters thrashing against his massive chest.
"He was known to be the one who gazed upon IT. There are even hidden Records within the deepest Elseworlds suggesting he was the one who designed IT."
BOOM!
Atlas, a grand lifeform whose existence was decimated by Immense Ones...may have been the one who engineered IT?

chapters.title: Chapter 5679: Atlas! II
paragraphs: "Many Provenance Lineages across existence scour his Elsedimensions for what he left behind,"Aurelius continued vibrantly, his eyes burning with ancient ambition.

"And many are entirely unsuccessful. It was theorized by our oldest predecessors that it has to be someone exactly like him. It must be someone who was not born a Provenance Lifeform, but became one. Only a being with that specific, impossible trajectory could find what he left behind."
The Patriarch locked his crushing gaze onto the stellar blue-gold figure of THE True Human Emperor.

"If you truly are someone like that, or if you hold even a fraction of a possibility of it, I can use my connections to hold off the Immense One that we made an agreement with many, many years ago. You have ruined my agreement and disrupted my Lineage today. I want something in return. If you can find any weavings or components of what Atlas left behind, it may be enough to give my lineage sufficient power to stand by ourselves. We are both burdened with glorious purpose. Let us see what we can put our purpose to use for."
WAA!
|VERITAS has increased by 1.|
|PONDUS has increased by 1.|
Noah observed the prompts materializing in his vision. The biological and conceptual heat of the spring was steadily overwriting his baseline architecture.
He evaluated the proposition. It was a transactional exchange of sovereign weight!
The Vasiliou Patriarch offered existential and temporal shielding, and Noah was required to offer salvage from a dead engineer.

He looked at the towering, scarred man sitting in the golden lava. He did not feel intimidated by the volume of the Patriarch’s voice or the immensity of his aura. He was a tyrant sitting in another man’s throne room, completely unbothered by the owner.
"That is an interesting story," Noah said. "Your agreement was flawed because it relied on subordination. I do not subordinate. But I am also curious about many things."
Noah tilted his head, his endlessly blue eyes analyzing the pristine golden skeletons resting at the bottom of the spring.
"Are Immense Lifeforms all such dicks?"Noah asked clinically, delivering the profanity with absolute zero temperature!

"And why are they also called Those Who Remain? If they remained, they remained from what? Were there others who left? If they left to go, where? How many Provenance Lineages are there, and just what is the exact nature of their relationships with Those Who Remain?"
BOOM!
The questions struck the depths of the Vasiliou Elsemountain with staggering conceptual weight.
Aurelius stared at the anomaly before him. The Patriarch let out a harsh, booming laugh that caused the liquid gold to erupt in massive, scalding geysers.
"Are they all suchdicks?" Aurelius repeated, his laughter echoing like thunder. "Power at that scale requires the absolute consumption of competing truths. They do not view reality the way we do."
The Patriarch leaned forward as the golden lava cascaded down his heavily scarred chest, his voice dropping into a register of terrifying, ancient history.

"To understand them, you must understand THE First Sundering. There was an era before this current continuum. It was a vast expanse where lifeforms reached an apex and came to grand and unfathomable realizations. The strongest among them exceeded any known Dimensionality. They shattered the highest boundaries of their existence as they became beings we can only imagine."
Aurelius raised a massive, dripping hand and pointed toward the ceiling of the cavern.

"The apex lifeforms who failed to exceed themselves in that grand Era, the ones who were too weak or unable to do what others like them did... They are Those Who Remain. Because they failed to attain power others like them in that era grasped. And after that era, it was an impossibility to grasp that power again. So many of them...dont particularly have good natures as they are effectively beings that failed. Many actually dont like the name ’Those Who Remain’ as they called themsleves Immense Ones. They have done many things since then. They locked the door behind the others to ensure no one else could ever exceed them. They built the rigid codes. They treat the continuum as...theirs."
Noah listened with shining eyes as many gaps in knowledge filled themsleves!

"As for the Lineages," Aurelius declared grandly, his golden aura pulsing with a mixture of sorrow and defiance."There are approximately three hundred and forty-two recognized Provenance Lineages across the expanse. And our relationship with them is complex and highly fractured."
The golden waters thrashed violently as the Patriarch stood up, revealing his towering, muscular frame burning with apex authority.
"Some of the Immense Ones actually stemmed from certain ancient Lineages,"

Aurelius explained, his eyes locking onto Noah. "They maintain a twisted, elevated patronage over their people. Others treat Lineages entirely like playthings. They harvest our unspent Provenance and claim our sons and daughters to use whenever they require raw material. Some cull us to ensure we never generate enough combined weight to challenge their thrones."
Aurelius took a heavy step through the golden lava.

"And a rare few Lineages are treated almost as peers. They sit on a terrifying knife’s edge of mutual benefit, balancing their own unfathomable authority against the architects in a silent war of borders. We are navigating an ecosystem designed to keep us contained. In The Elsedimensions, we live...and we are contained."
HUUM!
The Vasiliou Patriarch stood entirely exposed in the blinding golden steam, his chest heaving as the raw, unfiltered truth of existence flooded the cavern.

Noah sat perfectly still in the bubbling lava. He looked at the exact count of three hundred and forty-two Lineages. He looked at the concept of the First Sundering. He looked at the locked door of existence.
He identified a human emotion rising within his pathways. It was an absolute, cold ambition!

’They locked the door now, did they?’ Noah thought quietly to himself, his endlessly blue eyes looking past the Patriarch and into the unwritten future.’It would merely be a door that I am going to break down!’
BOOM!
